    <script type="module" src="/@vite/client"></script>

 

    <meta charset="UTF-8">

    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=5.0">

    <title>Volt &amp; Vox — Karaoke Speakers &amp; Solar Generators</title>

    <meta name="description" content="Mobile-first e-commerce storefront for commercial karaoke sound systems and portable LiFePO4 solar mini generators with instant WhatsApp, Viber, and Telegram ordering.">

    <meta property="og:title" content="Volt &amp; Vox — Karaoke Speakers &amp; Solar Generators">

    <meta property="og:description" content="Mobile-first e-commerce storefront for commercial karaoke sound systems and portable LiFePO4 solar mini generators with instant WhatsApp, Viber, and Telegram ordering.">

    <meta property="og:type" content="website">

    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">

 

    <!-- Google Fonts: Outfit (Display), Plus Jakarta Sans + Noto Sans Georgian (Body), JetBrains Mono (Tabular Specs) -->

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">

    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;600;700&amp;family=Noto+Sans+Georgian:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;family=Outfit:wght@600;700&amp;family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

 

    <!-- Tailwind CSS via CDN for Single-File Portability -->

    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>

 

    <style>

      :root {

        --theme-primary: #d97706;

        --theme-primary-hover: #b45309;

        --theme-primary-soft: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.12);

        --theme-primary-border: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.32);

        --theme-primary-text-on: #ffffff;

      }

 

      body {

        font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Noto Sans Georgian', sans-serif;

        background-color: #fafaf9;

        color: #18181b;

        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;

        overflow-anchor: none;

      }

 

      .font-display {

        font-family: 'Outfit', 'Noto Sans Georgian', sans-serif;

      }

 

      .font-mono-num {

        font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

      }

 

      .tabular-nums {

        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

      }

 

      .theme-bg {

        background-color: var(--theme-primary);

        color: var(--theme-primary-text-on);

      }

      .theme-bg:hover {

        background-color: var(--theme-primary-hover);

      }

 

      .theme-text {

        color: var(--theme-primary);

      }

 

      .theme-bg-soft {

        background-color: var(--theme-primary-soft);

      }

 

      .theme-border {

        border-color: var(--theme-primary-border);

      }

 

      .theme-ring:focus-visible {

        outline: 2px solid var(--theme-primary);

        outline-offset: 2px;

      }

 

      .text-balance {

        text-wrap: balance;

      }

 

      /* Smooth fast settling curve <= 200ms */

      .fast-transition {

        transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),

          opacity 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),

          background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),

          border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),

          box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

      }

 

      .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {

        display: none;

      }

      .no-scrollbar {

        -ms-overflow-style: none;

        scrollbar-width: none;

      }

 

      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

        *,

        ::before,

        ::after {

          animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;

          animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;

          transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;

          scroll-behavior: auto !important;

        }

      }

 

      /* Customer View Mode (?view=customer): hides all owner/admin editing controls */

      body.customer-view-mode #theme-panel-toggle,

      body.customer-view-mode #theme-customizer-panel,

      body.customer-view-mode #open-control-panel-btn,

      body.customer-view-mode #owner-admin-toolbar-row,

      body.customer-view-mode #quick-add-product-btn,

      body.customer-view-mode [data-direct-card-upload-label],

      body.customer-view-mode [data-quick-edit-id],

      body.customer-view-mode #modal-direct-5photo-label,

      body.customer-view-mode #modal-edit-product-btn,

      body.customer-view-mode #home-chat-role-seller,

      body.customer-view-mode #modal-chat-role-seller,

      body.customer-view-mode #footer-admin-btn,

      body.customer-view-mode #enter-customer-view-btn,

      body.customer-view-mode #open-site-code-modal-btn {

        display: none !important;

      }

    </style>

@layer base {

  *, ::after, ::before, ::backdrop, ::file-selector-button {

    box-sizing: border-box;

    margin: 0;

    padding: 0;

    border: 0 solid;

  }

  html, :host {

    line-height: 1.5;

    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;

    tab-size: 4;

    font-family: var(--default-font-family, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji");

    font-feature-settings: var(--default-font-feature-settings, normal);

    font-variation-settings: var(--default-font-variation-settings, normal);

    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;

  }

  hr {

    height: 0;

    color: inherit;

    border-top-width: 1px;

  }

  abbr:where([title]) {

    -webkit-text-decoration: underline dotted;

    text-decoration: underline dotted;

  }

  h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {

    font-size: inherit;

    font-weight: inherit;

  }

  a {

    color: inherit;

    -webkit-text-decoration: inherit;

    text-decoration: inherit;

  }

  b, strong {

    font-weight: bolder;

  }

  code, kbd, samp, pre {

    font-family: var(--default-mono-font-family, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace);

    font-feature-settings: var(--default-mono-font-feature-settings, normal);

    font-variation-settings: var(--default-mono-font-variation-settings, normal);

    font-size: 1em;

  }

  small {

    font-size: 80%;

  }

  sub, sup {

    font-size: 75%;

    line-height: 0;

    position: relative;

    vertical-align: baseline;

  }

  sub {

    bottom: -0.25em;

  }

  sup {

    top: -0.5em;

  }

  table {

    text-indent: 0;

    border-color: inherit;

    border-collapse: collapse;

  }

  :-moz-focusring:where(:not(iframe)) {

    outline: auto;

  }

  progress {

    vertical-align: baseline;

  }

  summary {

    display: list-item;

  }

  ol, ul, menu {

    list-style: none;

  }

  img, svg, video, canvas, audio, iframe, embed, object {

    display: block;

    vertical-align: middle;

  }

  img, video {

    max-width: 100%;

    height: auto;

  }

  button, input, select, optgroup, textarea, ::file-selector-button {

    font: inherit;

    font-feature-settings: inherit;

    font-variation-settings: inherit;

    letter-spacing: inherit;

    color: inherit;

    border-radius: 0;

    background-color: transparent;

    opacity: 1;

  }

  :where(select:is([multiple], [size])) optgroup {

    font-weight: bolder;

  }

  :where(select:is([multiple], [size])) optgroup option {

    padding-inline-start: 20px;

  }

  ::file-selector-button {

    margin-inline-end: 4px;

  }

  ::placeholder {

    opacity: 1;

  }

  @supports (not (-webkit-appearance: -apple-pay-button))  or (contain-intrinsic-size: 1px) {

    ::placeholder {

      color: currentcolor;

      @supports (color: color-mix(in lab, red, red)) {

        color: color-mix(in oklab, currentcolor 50%, transparent);

      }

    }

  }

  textarea {

    resize: vertical;

  }

  ::-webkit-search-decoration {

    -webkit-appearance: none;

  }

  ::-webkit-date-and-time-value {

    min-height: 1lh;

    text-align: inherit;

  }

  ::-webkit-datetime-edit {

    display: inline-flex;

  }

  ::-webkit-datetime-edit-fields-wrapper {

    padding: 0;

  }

  ::-webkit-datetime-edit, ::-webkit-datetime-edit-year-field, ::-webkit-datetime-edit-month-field, ::-webkit-datetime-edit-day-field, ::-webkit-datetime-edit-hour-field, ::-webkit-datetime-edit-minute-field, ::-webkit-datetime-edit-second-field, ::-webkit-datetime-edit-millisecond-field, ::-webkit-datetime-edit-meridiem-field {

    padding-block: 0;

  }

  ::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator {

    line-height: 1;

  }

  :-moz-ui-invalid {

    box-shadow: none;

  }

  button, input:where([type="button"], [type="reset"], [type="submit"]), ::file-selector-button {

    appearance: button;

  }

  ::-webkit-inner-spin-button, ::-webkit-outer-spin-button {

    height: auto;

  }

  [hidden]:where(:not([hidden="until-found"])) {

    display: none !important;

  }

}

              მაღაზიის მართვის პანელი — ყველაფრის ხელით მართვა

        function createHeroComboSvg(accentHex, angleIdx = 0) {

          const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 495" width="720" height="495">

        // Normalize a product's images array so it always has 5 slots: ['', '', '', '', '']

        // and replace legacy 'პიკური სიმძლავრე' spec labels with 'სიმძლავრე ვატი'

        function ensureFiveImagesArray(product) {

          const arr = ['', '', '', '', ''];

          if (Array.isArray(product.images)) {

            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {

              arr[i] = typeof product.images[i] === 'string' ? product.images[i].trim() : '';

            }

          }

          if (!arr[0] && product.customImage && typeof product.customImage === 'string') {

            arr[0] = product.customImage.trim();

          }

          product.images = arr;

          if (Array.isArray(product.specs)) {

            product.specs.forEach((s) => {

              if (s && s.label === 'პიკური სიმძლავრე') {

                s.label = 'სიმძლავრე ვატი';

              }

            });

          }

          return arr;

        }

 

        // Get resolved image URL for a specific slot (0..4) of a product

        function getProductSlotImageSrc(product, slotIndex, accentHex) {

          const arr = ensureFiveImagesArray(product);

          if (arr[slotIndex] && arr[slotIndex].length > 0) {

            return arr[slotIndex];

          }

          const tag = (product.sku || 'PRO').slice(0, 10);

          const sub = (product.shortMeta || '').slice(0, 15);

          if (product.category === 'solar') {

            return createSolarSvg(tag, sub || 'LiFePO4 220V', accentHex, slotIndex);

          }

        // Resolves a product object localized for current language

        // CRITICAL: All 5 images, prices, IDs and configurations are strictly preserved!

        function getLocalizedProduct(product, lang) {

          if (lang === 'en') {

            const enData = CATALOG_TRANSLATIONS_EN[product.id];

            if (enData) {

              return {

                ...product,

                name: enData.name || product.name,

                categoryLabel: enData.categoryLabel || product.categoryLabel,

                badgeText: enData.badgeText || product.badgeText,

                shortMeta: enData.shortMeta || product.shortMeta,

                description: enData.description || product.description,

                specs: Array.isArray(enData.specs) ? enData.specs : product.specs,

                youtubeCaption: enData.youtubeCaption || product.youtubeCaption,

                tiktokCaption: enData.tiktokCaption || product.tiktokCaption,

                instagramCaption: enData.instagramCaption || product.instagramCaption

              };

            }

            // Custom product uploaded by owner in Control Panel

            return {

              ...product,

              name: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(product.name),

              categoryLabel: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(product.categoryLabel),

              badgeText: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(product.badgeText),

              shortMeta: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(product.shortMeta),

              description: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(product.description),

              specs: Array.isArray(product.specs)

                ? product.specs.map((s) => ({

                    label: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(s.label),

                    value: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(s.value)

                  }))

                : product.specs,

              youtubeCaption: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(product.youtubeCaption),

              tiktokCaption: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(product.tiktokCaption),

              instagramCaption: autoTranslateGeorgianToEnglish(product.instagramCaption)

            };

          }

 

          if (lang === 'ru') {

            const ruData = CATALOG_TRANSLATIONS_RU[product.id];

            if (ruData) {

              return {

                ...product,

                name: ruData.name || product.name,

                categoryLabel: ruData.categoryLabel || product.categoryLabel,

                badgeText: ruData.badgeText || product.badgeText,

                shortMeta: ruData.shortMeta || product.shortMeta,

                description: ruData.description || product.description,

                specs: Array.isArray(ruData.specs) ? ruData.specs : product.specs,

                youtubeCaption: ruData.youtubeCaption || product.youtubeCaption,

                tiktokCaption: ruData.tiktokCaption || product.tiktokCaption,

                instagramCaption: ruData.instagramCaption || product.instagramCaption

              };

            }

            // Custom product uploaded by owner in Control Panel

            return {

              ...product,

              name: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(product.name),

              categoryLabel: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(product.categoryLabel),

              badgeText: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(product.badgeText),

              shortMeta: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(product.shortMeta),

              description: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(product.description),

              specs: Array.isArray(product.specs)

                ? product.specs.map((s) => ({

                    label: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(s.label),

                    value: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(s.value)

                  }))

                : product.specs,

              youtubeCaption: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(product.youtubeCaption),

              tiktokCaption: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(product.tiktokCaption),

              instagramCaption: autoTranslateGeorgianToRussian(product.instagramCaption)

            };

          }

 

          return product;

        }

        // Current 5-image buffer inside the Control Panel Edit Form

        // Dedicated local image backup vault so uploaded photos never get wiped out

        function loadLocalImagesBackupMap() {

          try {

            const raw = localStorage.getItem('vv_product_images_backup_v1');

            if (raw) {

              const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);

              if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') return parsed;

            }

          } catch (e) {}

          return {};

        }

 

        function saveLocalImagesBackupMap(map) {

          try {

            localStorage.setItem('vv_product_images_backup_v1', JSON.stringify(map));

          } catch (e) {}

        }

 

        function recordProductSlotInLocalBackup(productId, slotIdx, url) {

          if (!productId || slotIdx < 0 || slotIdx >= 5) return;

          const map = loadLocalImagesBackupMap();

          if (!Array.isArray(map[productId])) {

            map[productId] = ['', '', '', '', ''];

          }

          map[productId][slotIdx] = url || '';

          saveLocalImagesBackupMap(map);

        }

 

        function mergeImagesMapIntoProductsList(list, externalMap) {

          if (!Array.isArray(list)) return;

          const backupMap = loadLocalImagesBackupMap();

          let backupChanged = false;

 

          list.forEach((prod) => {

            if (!prod || !prod.id) return;

            ensureFiveImagesArray(prod);

            if (!Array.isArray(backupMap[prod.id])) {

              backupMap[prod.id] = ['', '', '', '', ''];

            }

            const extSlots = externalMap && Array.isArray(externalMap[prod.id]) ? externalMap[prod.id] : null;

            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {

              const cur = (prod.images[i] || '').trim();

              const ext = extSlots && extSlots[i] ? String(extSlots[i]).trim() : '';

              const bkp = (backupMap[prod.id][i] || '').trim();

              const resolved = cur || ext || bkp;

              if (resolved) {

                prod.images[i] = resolved;

                if (backupMap[prod.id][i] !== resolved) {

                  backupMap[prod.id][i] = resolved;

                  backupChanged = true;

                }

              }

            }

          });

 

          if (backupChanged) {

            saveLocalImagesBackupMap(backupMap);

          }

        }

 

        // 1. Check if state was baked into the HTML file (#baked-store-state)

        let bakedImagesMap = null;

        try {

          const bakedEl = document.getElementById('baked-store-state');

          if (bakedEl && bakedEl.textContent) {

            const bakedData = JSON.parse(bakedEl.textContent);

            if (bakedData && bakedData.hasSavedState) {

              if (bakedData.storeSettings) {

                storeSettings = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, bakedData.storeSettings);

              }

              if (Array.isArray(bakedData.productsList) && bakedData.productsList.length > 0) {

                productsList = bakedData.productsList;

              }

              if (bakedData.themeColor) {

                activeThemeColor = bakedData.themeColor;

              }

              if (bakedData.imagesMap && typeof bakedData.imagesMap === 'object') {

                bakedImagesMap = bakedData.imagesMap;

              }

            }

          }

        } catch (e) {}

 

        // 2. Check localStorage (merge rather than overwrite images)

        try {

          const savedSettings = localStorage.getItem('vv_store_settings_v1');

          if (savedSettings) {

            storeSettings = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, JSON.parse(savedSettings));

          }

          const savedProducts = localStorage.getItem('vv_store_products_v1');

          if (savedProducts) {

            const parsed = JSON.parse(savedProducts);

            if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {

              // Preserve any images already in productsList before adopting savedProducts

              parsed.forEach((sp) => {

                if (sp && sp.id && Array.isArray(sp.images)) {

                  sp.images.forEach((img, idx) => {

                    if (img && String(img).trim()) {

                      recordProductSlotInLocalBackup(sp.id, idx, String(img).trim());

                    }

                  });

                }

              });

              productsList = parsed;

            }

          }

          const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('vv_theme_color');

        function syncPriceDropUI(productId) {

          const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('price-drop-toggle-btn');

          const subscribedBanner = document.getElementById('price-drop-subscribed-banner');

          const formBox = document.getElementById('price-drop-form-box');

          const phoneInput = document.getElementById('price-drop-phone-input');

          const errorMsg = document.getElementById('price-drop-error-msg');

          const subTextEl = document.getElementById('price-drop-subscribed-text');

 

          if (!toggleBtn || !subscribedBanner || !formBox) return;

 

          // Clear any validation error

          if (errorMsg) {

            errorMsg.textContent = '';

            errorMsg.classList.add('hidden');

          }

 

          if (!productId) {

            toggleBtn.classList.remove('hidden');

            subscribedBanner.classList.add('hidden');

            formBox.classList.add('hidden');

            return;

          }

 

          const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

          const existingAlert = priceDropAlerts[productId];

          if (existingAlert && existingAlert.phone) {

            toggleBtn.classList.add('hidden');

            formBox.classList.add('hidden');

            subscribedBanner.classList.remove('hidden');

            if (subTextEl) {

              const baseText = strings.priceDropSubscribedText || 'შეტყობინება ჩართულია: {phone}';

              const cleanPhone = String(existingAlert.phone || '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, '');

              subTextEl.innerHTML = baseText.replace(

                '{phone}',

                `<span id="price-drop-active-phone" class="font-mono-num font-extrabold text-emerald-950">${cleanPhone}</span>`

              );

            }

          } else {

            subscribedBanner.classList.add('hidden');

            toggleBtn.classList.remove('hidden');

            formBox.classList.add('hidden');

            // Pre-fill phone if user previously entered one elsewhere

            if (phoneInput && !phoneInput.value) {

              const rememberedPhone = localStorage.getItem('vv_price_drop_phone') || '';

              if (rememberedPhone) phoneInput.value = rememberedPhone;

            }

          }

        }

 

        // Sync state to Baked DOM Script, localStorage, and Backend API (/api/store)

        let isServerStateLoaded = false;

 

        function syncBakedStateTag() {

          const bakedEl = document.getElementById('baked-store-state');

          if (bakedEl) {

            bakedEl.textContent = JSON.stringify({

              hasSavedState: true,

              storeSettings,

              productsList,

              themeColor: activeThemeColor

            });

          }

        }

 

        async function saveStateEverywhere(extraOpts = {}) {

          mergeImagesMapIntoProductsList(productsList, null);

          syncBakedStateTag();

          try {

            localStorage.setItem('vv_store_settings_v1', JSON.stringify(storeSettings));

            localStorage.setItem('vv_store_products_v1', JSON.stringify(productsList));

            localStorage.setItem('vv_theme_color', activeThemeColor);

          } catch (e) {

            console.warn('localStorage write warning:', e);

          }

 

          if (!isServerStateLoaded) {

            return false;

          }

 

          try {

            const resp = await fetch('/api/store', {

              method: 'POST',

              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

              body: JSON.stringify({

                storeSettings,

                productsList,

                themeColor: activeThemeColor,

                ...extraOpts

              })

            });

            if (resp.ok) {

              const resData = await resp.json();

              if (resData && resData.ok && Array.isArray(resData.productsList)) {

                productsList = resData.productsList;

                productsList.forEach(ensureFiveImagesArray);

                mergeImagesMapIntoProductsList(productsList, resData.imagesMap || null);

                try {

                  localStorage.setItem('vv_store_products_v1', JSON.stringify(productsList));

                } catch (e) {}

              }

              return true;

            }

          } catch (err) {

            console.error('Failed to sync state to server:', err);

          }

          return false;

        }

        // Helpers

        function hexToRgb(hex) {

          const clean = hex.replace('#', '');

          const num = parseInt(clean, 16);

          return {

            r: (num >> 16) & 255,

            g: (num >> 8) & 255,

            b: num & 255

          };

        }

 

        function darkenHex(hex, factor = 0.82) {

          const { r, g, b } = hexToRgb(hex);

          const toHex = (n) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(n * factor))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');

          return `#${toHex(r)}${toHex(g)}${toHex(b)}`;

        }

 

        function formatGel(amount) {

          return Number(amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US') + ' ₾';

        }

 

        function formatPhoneDisplay(digits) {

          const clean = String(digits || '995551588579').replace(/\D/g, '');

          if (clean.length === 12 && clean.startsWith('995')) {

            return `+995 ${clean.slice(3, 6)} ${clean.slice(6, 8)} ${clean.slice(8, 10)} ${clean.slice(10, 12)}`;

          }

          return '+' + clean;

        }

 

        function extractYoutubeId(input) {

          if (!input) return 'M7lc1UVf-VE';

          const trimmed = input.trim();

          const regExp = /^.*(youtu.be\/|v\/|u\/\w\/|embed\/|watch\?v=|&v=|shorts\/)([^#&?]*).*/;

          const match = trimmed.match(regExp);

          return match && match[2].length === 11 ? match[2] : trimmed;

        }

 

        function normalizeTiktokEmbedUrl(input) {

          if (!input) return 'https://www.tiktok.com/embed/v2/7234567890123456789';

          const trimmed = input.trim();

          if (trimmed.includes('/embed/')) return trimmed;

          const match = trimmed.match(/video\/(\d+)/);

          if (match && match[1]) {

            return `https://www.tiktok.com/embed/v2/${match[1]}`;

          }

          if (/^\d{15,22}$/.test(trimmed)) {

            return `https://www.tiktok.com/embed/v2/${trimmed}`;

          }

          return trimmed;

        }

 

        function normalizeInstagramEmbedUrl(input) {

          if (!input) return 'https://www.instagram.com/p/C-DefaultReel/embed';

          const trimmed = input.trim();

          if (trimmed.includes('/embed')) return trimmed;

          const match = trimmed.match(/instagram\.com\/(?:p|reel|tv)\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)/i);

          if (match && match[1]) {

            return `https://www.instagram.com/reel/${match[1]}/embed`;

          }

          return trimmed;

        }

          updateCategoryTabCounts();

          if (typeof syncWeatherStateFromSettings === 'function') {

            syncWeatherStateFromSettings();

          }

          if (typeof applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets === 'function') {

            applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets();

          }

        }

 

        function updateCategoryTabCounts() {

          const allCount = productsList.length;

          const krkCount = productsList.filter((p) => p.category === 'karaoke').length;

          const slrCount = productsList.filter((p) => p.category === 'solar').length;

          const bndCount = productsList.filter((p) => p.category === 'bundle').length;

 

          const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

          const catAllBtn = document.getElementById('cat-btn-all');

          const catKrkBtn = document.getElementById('cat-btn-karaoke');

          const catSlrBtn = document.getElementById('cat-btn-solar');

          const catBndBtn = document.getElementById('cat-btn-bundle');

          const cpTotal = document.getElementById('cp-total-count');

 

          const lblAll = currentLang === 'ka' ? (storeSettings.catAll || strings.catAll) : strings.catAll;

          const lblKrk = currentLang === 'ka' ? (storeSettings.catKaraoke || strings.catKaraoke) : strings.catKaraoke;

          const lblSlr = currentLang === 'ka' ? (storeSettings.catSolar || strings.catSolar) : strings.catSolar;

          const lblBnd = currentLang === 'ka' ? (storeSettings.catBundle || strings.catBundle) : strings.catBundle;

 

          if (catAllBtn) catAllBtn.textContent = `${lblAll} (${allCount})`;

          if (catKrkBtn) catKrkBtn.textContent = `${lblKrk} (${krkCount})`;

          if (catSlrBtn) catSlrBtn.textContent = `${lblSlr} (${slrCount})`;

          if (catBndBtn) catBndBtn.textContent = `${lblBnd} (${bndCount})`;

          if (cpTotal) cpTotal.textContent = String(allCount);

 

          const catWlLabel = document.getElementById('cat-wishlist-label');

          if (catWlLabel) catWlLabel.textContent = strings.catWishlist;

          document.querySelectorAll('.wishlist-count-badge').forEach((badge) => {

            badge.textContent = String(wishlistIds.size);

          });

        }

 

        function applyThemeColor(hex, hoverHex, shouldSave = true) {

          preserveScroll(() => {

            activeThemeColor = hex;

            activeThemeHover = hoverHex || darkenHex(hex, 0.82);

            const { r, g, b } = hexToRgb(hex);

 

            const root = document.documentElement;

            root.style.setProperty('--theme-primary', activeThemeColor);

            root.style.setProperty('--theme-primary-hover', activeThemeHover);

            root.style.setProperty('--theme-primary-soft', `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, 0.12)`);

            root.style.setProperty('--theme-primary-border', `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, 0.35)`);

 

            customColorPicker.value = activeThemeColor;

            activeHexReadout.textContent = activeThemeColor.toUpperCase();

            const cpSetThemeColor = document.getElementById('cp-set-theme-color');

            if (cpSetThemeColor) cpSetThemeColor.value = activeThemeColor;

 

            document.querySelectorAll('.theme-preset-btn').forEach((btn) => {

              const btnHex = btn.getAttribute('data-theme-color');

              if (btnHex && btnHex.toLowerCase() === activeThemeColor.toLowerCase()) {

                btn.classList.add('border-zinc-900', 'bg-stone-100');

                btn.classList.remove('border-zinc-200');

              } else {

                btn.classList.remove('border-zinc-900', 'bg-stone-100');

                btn.classList.add('border-zinc-200');

              }

            });

 

            if (heroShowcaseImg) {

              heroShowcaseImg.src = createHeroComboSvg(activeThemeColor, 0);

            }

            renderProducts();

            if (activeModalProduct) {

              renderModalGalleryState();

            }

            if (shouldSave) {

              saveStateEverywhere();

            }

          });

        }

 

        function updateSingleProductCardInPlace(product) {

          const cardEl = productGridEl.querySelector(`[data-product-id="${product.id}"]`);

          if (!cardEl) {

            preserveScroll(() => renderProducts());

            return;

          }

          const loc = getLocalizedProduct(product, currentLang);

          const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

          const savings = Math.max(0, Number(product.oldPrice) - Number(product.newPrice));

          const customCount = countCustomUploadedImages(product);

          const imgEl = cardEl.querySelector('.card-img-el');

          const photoCountEl = cardEl.querySelector('.card-photo-count-el');

          const catEl = cardEl.querySelector('.card-cat-el');

          const badgeEl = cardEl.querySelector('.card-badge-el');

          const titleEl = cardEl.querySelector('.card-title-el');

          const metaEl = cardEl.querySelector('.card-meta-el');

          const newPriceEl = cardEl.querySelector('.card-new-price-el');

          const oldPriceEl = cardEl.querySelector('.card-old-price-el');

          const savingsEl = cardEl.querySelector('.card-savings-el');

          const wlBtn = cardEl.querySelector('[data-wishlist-toggle]');

 

          if (imgEl) imgEl.src = getProductImageSrc(product, activeThemeColor);

          if (photoCountEl) {

            photoCountEl.textContent = customCount > 0

              ? strings.cardPhotosCount.replace('{count}', customCount)

              : strings.cardUpload5Photos;

          }

          if (catEl) catEl.textContent = loc.categoryLabel || (currentLang === 'en' ? 'Product' : 'პროდუქტი');

          if (badgeEl) badgeEl.textContent = loc.badgeText || (currentLang === 'en' ? 'Special Offer' : 'აქცია');

          if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = loc.name;

          if (metaEl) metaEl.textContent = loc.shortMeta;

          if (newPriceEl) newPriceEl.textContent = formatGel(product.newPrice);

          if (oldPriceEl) oldPriceEl.textContent = formatGel(product.oldPrice);

          if (savingsEl) savingsEl.textContent = `-${formatGel(savings)}`;

 

          if (wlBtn) {

            const isWishlisted = wishlistIds.has(product.id);

            wlBtn.className = `wishlist-toggle-btn absolute top-3 left-3 z-10 w-9 h-9 rounded-xl ${

              isWishlisted

                ? 'bg-white text-rose-600 shadow-md ring-2 ring-rose-500/50'

                : 'bg-white/90 hover:bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:text-rose-600 shadow-sm'

            } flex items-center justify-center fast-transition cursor-pointer active:scale-90`;

            wlBtn.title = isWishlisted ? strings.wishlistRemoveTip : strings.wishlistAddTip;

            wlBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', isWishlisted ? strings.wishlistRemoveTip : strings.wishlistAddTip);

            const svgEl = wlBtn.querySelector('svg');

            if (svgEl) {

              if (isWishlisted) {

                svgEl.classList.remove('fill-none', 'stroke-current');

                svgEl.classList.add('fill-rose-600', 'text-rose-600');

              } else {

                svgEl.classList.remove('fill-rose-600', 'text-rose-600');

                svgEl.classList.add('fill-none', 'stroke-current');

              }

            }

          }

        }

 

        // Render Product Cards Grid

        function renderProducts() {

          const prevScroll = window.scrollY;

          updateCategoryTabCounts();

          const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

          const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

 

          let filtered = productsList.filter((item) => {

            const matchesCategory =

              activeCategory === 'all'

                ? true

                : activeCategory === 'wishlist'

                ? wishlistIds.has(item.id)

                : item.category === activeCategory;

            const locItem = getLocalizedProduct(item, currentLang);

            const matchesQuery =

              !query ||

              (locItem.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||

              (locItem.shortMeta || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||

              (locItem.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||

              (locItem.categoryLabel || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||

              (item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||

              (item.shortMeta || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||

              (item.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||

              (item.categoryLabel || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||

              (item.sku || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);

            return matchesCategory && matchesQuery;

          });

 

          if (sortMode === 'price-asc') {

            filtered.sort((a, b) => a.newPrice - b.newPrice);

          } else if (sortMode === 'price-desc') {

            filtered.sort((a, b) => b.newPrice - a.newPrice);

          } else if (sortMode === 'discount') {

            filtered.sort((a, b) => b.oldPrice - b.newPrice - (a.oldPrice - a.newPrice));

          }

 

          resultsCountLabel.textContent = strings.resultsCount.replace('{count}', filtered.length);

 

          if (filtered.length === 0) {

            if (activeCategory === 'wishlist') {

              emptySearchEl.classList.add('hidden');

              productGridEl.innerHTML = `

                <div class="col-span-full py-14 px-6 text-center bg-white rounded-3xl border border-zinc-200/90 shadow-sm max-w-xl mx-auto my-4 space-y-4">

                  <div class="w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center text-3xl shadow-sm">

                    ❤️

                  </div>

                  <h3 class="font-display text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold text-zinc-950">${strings.wishlistEmptyTitle}</h3>

                  <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-600 leading-relaxed max-w-md mx-auto">

                    ${strings.wishlistEmptyDesc}

                  </p>

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    id="wishlist-empty-browse-btn"

                    class="theme-bg px-6 py-3 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold shadow-md hover:shadow-lg active:scale-95 fast-transition cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-2"

                  >

                    <span>${strings.wishlistExploreBtn}</span>

                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3">

                      <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M14 5l7 7m0 0l-7 7m7-7H3"/>

                    </svg>

                  </button>

                </div>

              `;

              const emptyBrowseBtn = document.getElementById('wishlist-empty-browse-btn');

              if (emptyBrowseBtn) {

                emptyBrowseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setCategoryFilter('all'));

              }

              window.scrollTo({ top: prevScroll, behavior: 'instant' });

              return;

            }

            productGridEl.innerHTML = '';

            emptySearchEl.classList.remove('hidden');

            window.scrollTo({ top: prevScroll, behavior: 'instant' });

            return;

          }

 

          emptySearchEl.classList.add('hidden');

 

          const cleanDigits = String(storeSettings.phoneDigits || '995551588579').replace(/\D/g, '') || '995551588579';

          const contactName = String(storeSettings.contactName || 'გოჩა').trim() || 'გოჩა';

          const displayPhone = formatPhoneDisplay(cleanDigits);

 

          productGridEl.innerHTML = filtered

            .map((rawProduct) => {

              const product = getLocalizedProduct(rawProduct, currentLang);

              const savings = Math.max(0, Number(rawProduct.oldPrice) - Number(rawProduct.newPrice));

              const imgSrc = getProductImageSrc(rawProduct, activeThemeColor);

              const customCount = countCustomUploadedImages(rawProduct);

              const isWishlisted = wishlistIds.has(rawProduct.id);

              const photoBtnLabel = customCount > 0

                ? strings.cardPhotosCount.replace('{count}', customCount)

                : strings.cardUpload5Photos;

 

              return `

                <article

                  data-product-id="${rawProduct.id}"

                  tabindex="0"

                  role="button"

                  aria-label="${product.name} - ${strings.cardOrderBtn}"

                  class="product-card group bg-white rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200/90 hover:border-zinc-300 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 fast-transition flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden cursor-pointer text-left theme-ring relative"

                >

                  <div>

                    <!-- 4:3 Studio Hardware Image Container -->

                    <div class="relative bg-stone-100/90 p-4 border-b border-zinc-100 aspect-[4/3] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">

                      <!-- 1-Click Wishlist Heart Button (Top-Left of Image) -->

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        data-wishlist-toggle="${rawProduct.id}"

                        class="wishlist-toggle-btn absolute top-3 left-3 z-10 w-9 h-9 rounded-xl ${

                          isWishlisted

                            ? 'bg-white text-rose-600 shadow-md ring-2 ring-rose-500/50'

                            : 'bg-white/90 hover:bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:text-rose-600 shadow-sm'

                        } flex items-center justify-center fast-transition cursor-pointer active:scale-90"

                        title="${isWishlisted ? strings.wishlistRemoveTip : strings.wishlistAddTip}"

                        aria-label="${isWishlisted ? strings.wishlistRemoveTip : strings.wishlistAddTip}"

                      >

                        <svg class="w-5 h-5 pointer-events-none ${isWishlisted ? 'fill-rose-600 text-rose-600' : 'fill-none stroke-current'}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2">

                          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 21.35l-1.45-1.32C5.4 15.36 2 12.28 2 8.5 2 5.42 4.42 3 7.5 3c1.74 0 3.41.81 4.5 2.09C13.09 3.81 14.76 3 16.5 3 19.58 3 22 5.42 22 8.5c0 3.78-3.4 6.86-8.55 11.54L12 21.35z"/>

                        </svg>

                      </button>

 

                      <img

                        src="${imgSrc}"

                        alt="${product.name}"

                        referrerPolicy="no-referrer"

                        loading="lazy"

                        class="card-img-el w-full h-full object-contain group-hover:scale-[1.02] fast-transition"

                      />

                      <!-- Direct 1-Click 5-Photos Multi-Upload + Quick Edit Buttons -->

                      <div class="absolute top-3 right-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">

                        <label

                          data-direct-card-upload-label="true"

                          title="${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Select up to 5 photos to upload at once' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Выберите до 5 фото для одновременной загрузки' : 'ერთი გახსნით მონიშნეთ 5 ფოტო და ატვირთეთ ერთდროულად'}"

                          class="min-h-[36px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg theme-bg text-white text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm cursor-pointer active:scale-95 fast-transition"

                        >

                          <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2">

                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-8l-4-4m0 0L8 8m4-4v12" />

                          </svg>

                          <span class="card-photo-count-el">${photoBtnLabel}</span>

                          <input type="file" accept="image/*" multiple data-direct-card-upload="${rawProduct.id}" class="hidden" />

                        </label>

 

                        <button

                          type="button"

                          data-quick-edit-id="${rawProduct.id}"

                          title="${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Edit product details' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Редактировать данные товара' : 'პროდუქტის მონაცემების ჩასწორება'}"

                          class="min-h-[36px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white/95 hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 hover:text-white border border-zinc-200 text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm fast-transition"

                        >

                          <span>${strings.cardEditBtn}</span>

                        </button>

                      </div>

                    </div>

 

                    <!-- Card Body -->

                    <div class="p-5 space-y-2.5">

                      <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-500">

                        <span class="card-cat-el font-medium text-zinc-700">${product.categoryLabel || (currentLang === 'en' ? 'Product' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Товар' : 'პროდუქტი')}</span>

                        <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>

                        <span class="card-badge-el theme-text font-semibold">${product.badgeText || (currentLang === 'en' ? 'Special Offer' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Акция' : 'აქცია')}</span>

                        <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>

                        <span class="font-mono-num">${strings.cardFivePhotosBadge}</span>

                      </div>

 

                      <h3 class="card-title-el text-base font-semibold text-zinc-950 leading-snug line-clamp-2 group-hover:underline decoration-zinc-400 underline-offset-2">

                        ${product.name}

                      </h3>

 

                      <p class="card-meta-el text-xs text-zinc-500 font-mono-num truncate">

                        ${product.shortMeta}

                      </p>

                    </div>

                  </div>

 

                  <!-- Dual Pricing ("ძველი ფასი" above crossed-out price & green "ფასდაკლება" right next to it), Phone & Screenshot/Share -->

                  <div class="px-5 pb-5 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 space-y-2.5">

                    <div class="flex items-end justify-between gap-2">

                      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">

                        <div>

                          <div class="text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 leading-tight mb-0.5">${strings.cardSalePrice}</div>

                          <span class="card-new-price-el font-mono-num text-xl font-bold theme-text leading-none">

                            ${formatGel(rawProduct.newPrice)}

                          </span>

                        </div>

 

                        <div>

                          <div class="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 leading-tight mb-0.5">${strings.cardOldPrice}</div>

                          <span class="card-old-price-el font-mono-num text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-600 line-through decoration-red-600 decoration-2 leading-none" style="text-decoration-color: #dc2626; text-decoration-thickness: 2px;">

                            ${formatGel(rawProduct.oldPrice)}

                          </span>

                        </div>

 

                        <div>

                          <div class="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-600 leading-tight mb-0.5">${strings.cardDiscount}</div>

                          <span class="card-savings-el text-xs sm:text-sm font-extrabold text-emerald-600 font-mono-num leading-none">

                            -${formatGel(savings)}

                          </span>

                        </div>

                      </div>

 

                      <span class="theme-bg min-h-[40px] px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap shadow-sm">

                        <span>${strings.cardOrderBtn}</span>

                        <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3">

                          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7" />

                        </svg>

                      </span>

                    </div>

 

                    <!-- Compact Full-Visibility Contact Person "გოჩა" + Phone Number Directly Under Price -->

                    <a

                      href="tel:+${cleanDigits}"

                      data-card-phone-call="true"

                      class="pt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 group/phone"

                      title="${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Call' : 'დარეკვა'} (${contactName}): ${displayPhone}"

                    >

                      <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-700 whitespace-nowrap">

                        <span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-md theme-bg flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0">

                          <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4">

                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3 5a2 2 0 012-2h3.28a1 1 0 01.948.684l1.498 4.493a1 1 0 01-.502 1.21l-2.257 1.13a11.042 11.042 0 005.516 5.516l1.13-2.257a1 1 0 011.21-.502l4.493 1.498a1 1 0 01.684.949V19a2 2 0 01-2 2h-1C9.716 21 3 14.284 3 6V5z" />

                          </svg>

                        </span>

                        <span>${strings.cardContactLabel} <strong class="card-contact-name-el theme-text font-extrabold">${contactName}</strong></span>

                      </span>

                      <span class="card-phone-digits-el font-mono-num text-xs sm:text-sm font-extrabold theme-text tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap group-hover/phone:underline">

                        ${displayPhone}

                      </span>

                    </a>

 

                    <!-- 1-Click Message Seller, Screenshot & Share Buttons on Product Card -->

                    <div class="pt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 space-y-2">

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        data-card-chat="${rawProduct.id}"

                        class="w-full min-h-[38px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 fast-transition whitespace-nowrap shadow-sm cursor-pointer"

                        title="${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Message the Seller directly on site' : 'მისწერე გამყიდველს პირდაპირ საიტზე'}"

                      >

                        <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400 shrink-0" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3">

                          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M8 10h.01M12 10h.01M16 10h.01M9 16H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h14a2 2 0 012 2v8a2 2 0 01-2 2h-5l-5 5v-5z" />

                        </svg>

                        <span>${strings.chatTitle || 'მისწერე გამყიდველს'}</span>

                      </button>

 

                      <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">

                        <button

                          type="button"

                          data-card-screenshot="${rawProduct.id}"

                          class="min-h-[36px] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 border border-emerald-200 text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 fast-transition whitespace-nowrap"

                          title="${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Take product screenshot with 5 photos and phone number' : 'პროდუქტის სქრინშოტის გადაღება ფოტოებით და ნომრით'}"

                        >

                          <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-700 shrink-0" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2">

                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3 9a2 2 0 012-2h.93a2 2 0 001.664-.89l.812-1.22A2 2 0 0110.07 4h3.86a2 2 0 011.664.89l.812 1.22A2 2 0 0018.07 7H19a2 2 0 012 2v9a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V9z" />

                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15 13a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />

                          </svg>

                          <span>${strings.cardScreenshotBtn}</span>

                        </button>

 

                        <button

                          type="button"

                          data-card-share="${rawProduct.id}"

                          class="min-h-[36px] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 border border-blue-200 text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 fast-transition whitespace-nowrap"

                          title="${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Share product' : 'პროდუქტის გაზიარება'}"

                        >

                          <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-700 shrink-0" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2">

                            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M8.684 13.342C8.886 12.938 9 12.482 9 12c0-.482-.114-.938-.316-1.342m0 2.684a3 3 0 110-2.684m0 2.684l6.632 3.316m-6.632-6l6.632-3.316m0 0a3 3 0 105.367-2.684 3 3 0 00-5.367 2.684zm0 9.316a3 3 0 105.368 2.684 3 3 0 00-5.368-2.684z" />

                          </svg>

                          <span>${strings.cardShareBtn}</span>

                        </button>

                      </div>

                    </div>

                  </div>

                </article>

              `;

            })

            .join('');

 

          if (typeof renderMoveHandlesOnAllBlocks === 'function' && isMoveBlocksModeActive) {

            renderMoveHandlesOnAllBlocks();

          }

          window.scrollTo({ top: prevScroll, behavior: 'instant' });

        }

 

        // Render the 5-Image Gallery inside the Product Detail Modal

        function renderModalGalleryState() {

          if (!activeModalProduct) return;

          const urls = getProductFiveGalleryUrls(activeModalProduct, activeThemeColor);

          const safeIdx = ((activeModalImageIdx % 5) + 5) % 5;

          activeModalImageIdx = safeIdx;

 

          modalProductImg.src = urls[safeIdx];

          modalProductImg.alt = `${activeModalProduct.name} - ფოტო ${safeIdx + 1}`;

          modalImgCounter.textContent = `${safeIdx + 1} / 5`;

 

          modalThumbnailsStrip.innerHTML = urls

            .map((u, idx) => {

              const isSelected = idx === safeIdx;

              return `

                <button

                  type="button"

                  data-modal-thumb-idx="${idx}"

                  class="min-h-[52px] aspect-[4/3] rounded-xl bg-stone-100 p-1 border-2 ${

                    isSelected ? 'theme-border bg-white shadow-sm scale-[1.02]' : 'border-zinc-200 opacity-75 hover:opacity-100'

                  } flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden fast-transition"

                  aria-label="ფოტო ${idx + 1}"

                >

                  <img src="${u}" alt="" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" class="w-full h-full object-contain rounded-lg pointer-events-none" />

                </button>

              `;

            })

            .join('');

        }

 

        modalPrevImgBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          e.stopPropagation();

          activeModalImageIdx = (activeModalImageIdx - 1 + 5) % 5;

          renderModalGalleryState();

        });

 

        modalNextImgBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          e.stopPropagation();

          activeModalImageIdx = (activeModalImageIdx + 1) % 5;

          renderModalGalleryState();

        });

 

        modalThumbnailsStrip.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          const btn = e.target.closest('[data-modal-thumb-idx]');

          if (btn) {

            activeModalImageIdx = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-modal-thumb-idx')) || 0;

            renderModalGalleryState();

          }

        });

 

        // Mobile Touch Swipe Left/Right on Modal Main Gallery Image

        let touchStartX = 0;

        let touchStartY = 0;

        let isStageSwiping = false;

        modalGalleryStage.addEventListener(

          'touchstart',

          (e) => {

            if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]) {

              touchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;

              touchStartY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;

              isStageSwiping = false;

            }

          },

          { passive: true }

        );

 

        modalGalleryStage.addEventListener(

          'touchend',

          (e) => {

            if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]) {

              const diffX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX - touchStartX;

              const diffY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY - touchStartY;

              if (Math.abs(diffX) > 40 && Math.abs(diffX) > Math.abs(diffY)) {

                isStageSwiping = true;

                if (diffX < 0) {

                  activeModalImageIdx = (activeModalImageIdx + 1) % 5;

                } else {

                  activeModalImageIdx = (activeModalImageIdx - 1 + 5) % 5;

                }

                renderModalGalleryState();

              }

            }

          },

          { passive: true }

        );

 

        // Tap or click on photo / stage opens full enlarged lightbox

        modalGalleryStage.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          if (isStageSwiping) {

            isStageSwiping = false;

            return;

          }

          if (e.target.closest('#modal-prev-img-btn') || e.target.closest('#modal-next-img-btn')) {

            return;

          }

          if (activeModalProduct) {

            openLightbox(activeModalImageIdx);

          }

        });

 

        // =========================================================================

        // LIGHTBOX FULLSCREEN IMAGE GALLERY LOGIC & NAVIGATION (5-PHOTO EXPANSION)

        // =========================================================================

        function renderLightboxState() {

          if (!activeModalProduct) return;

          if (lightboxPrevBtn) lightboxPrevBtn.classList.remove('hidden');

          if (lightboxNextBtn) lightboxNextBtn.classList.remove('hidden');

          if (lightboxThumbnailsStrip) lightboxThumbnailsStrip.classList.remove('hidden');

          const urls = getProductFiveGalleryUrls(activeModalProduct, activeThemeColor);

          const safeIdx = ((lightboxActiveIdx % 5) + 5) % 5;

          lightboxActiveIdx = safeIdx;

 

          const locProd = getLocalizedProduct(activeModalProduct, currentLang);

          if (lightboxProductTitle) lightboxProductTitle.textContent = locProd.name;

          if (lightboxCounterBadge) lightboxCounterBadge.textContent = `${safeIdx + 1} / 5`;

 

          // Main enlarged image

          if (lightboxImg) {

            lightboxImg.src = urls[safeIdx];

            lightboxImg.alt = `${locProd.name} - ${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Photo' : 'ფოტო'} ${safeIdx + 1}`;

          }

 

          // Keep underlying modal gallery in sync

          activeModalImageIdx = safeIdx;

          renderModalGalleryState();

 

          // Render 5 interactive Lightbox Thumbnails

          if (lightboxThumbnailsStrip) {

            lightboxThumbnailsStrip.innerHTML = urls

              .map((u, idx) => {

                const isSelected = idx === safeIdx;

                return `

                  <button

                    type="button"

                    data-lightbox-thumb-idx="${idx}"

                    class="min-h-[46px] sm:min-h-[54px] aspect-[4/3] rounded-xl bg-zinc-950 p-1 border-2 ${

                      isSelected

                        ? 'border-amber-400 ring-2 ring-amber-400/60 scale-105 shadow-lg'

                        : 'border-zinc-700 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 hover:border-zinc-500'

                    } flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden fast-transition cursor-pointer"

                    aria-label="ფოტო ${idx + 1}"

                    title="ფოტო ${idx + 1}"

                  >

                    <img src="${u}" alt="" referrerPolicy="no-referrer" class="w-full h-full object-contain rounded-lg pointer-events-none" />

                  </button>

                `;

              })

              .join('');

          }

        }

 

        function openLightbox(initialIdx = 0) {

          if (!activeModalProduct) return;

          lightboxActiveIdx = ((initialIdx % 5) + 5) % 5;

          renderLightboxState();

          if (lightboxModalBackdrop) {

            lightboxModalBackdrop.classList.remove('hidden');

          }

          document.body.classList.add('overflow-hidden');

        }

 

        function closeLightbox() {

          if (lightboxModalBackdrop) {

            lightboxModalBackdrop.classList.add('hidden');

          }

          // If product detail modal is still open, keep body overflow-hidden

          if (modalBackdrop && !modalBackdrop.classList.contains('hidden')) {

            document.body.classList.add('overflow-hidden');

          } else {

            document.body.classList.remove('overflow-hidden');

          }

        }

 

        function lightboxNext() {

          lightboxActiveIdx = (lightboxActiveIdx + 1) % 5;

          renderLightboxState();

        }

 

        function lightboxPrev() {

          lightboxActiveIdx = (lightboxActiveIdx - 1 + 5) % 5;

          renderLightboxState();

        }

 

        if (lightboxCloseBtn) {

          lightboxCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);

        }

 

        if (lightboxPrevBtn) {

          lightboxPrevBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            e.stopPropagation();

            lightboxPrev();

          });

        }

 

        if (lightboxNextBtn) {

          lightboxNextBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            e.stopPropagation();

            lightboxNext();

          });

        }

 

        if (lightboxThumbnailsStrip) {

          lightboxThumbnailsStrip.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            const btn = e.target.closest('[data-lightbox-thumb-idx]');

            if (btn) {

              e.stopPropagation();

              const idx = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-lightbox-thumb-idx')) || 0;

              lightboxActiveIdx = idx;

              renderLightboxState();

            }

          });

        }

 

        // Close on backdrop / stage background click (outside image and buttons)

        if (lightboxModalBackdrop) {

          lightboxModalBackdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            if (e.target === lightboxModalBackdrop || e.target === lightboxStage) {

              closeLightbox();

            }

          });

        }

 

        // Mobile touch swipe gestures on Lightbox stage

        if (lightboxStage) {

          let lbTouchStartX = 0;

          let lbTouchStartY = 0;

          lightboxStage.addEventListener(

            'touchstart',

            (e) => {

              if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]) {

                lbTouchStartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX;

                lbTouchStartY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY;

              }

            },

            { passive: true }

          );

 

          lightboxStage.addEventListener(

            'touchend',

            (e) => {

              if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]) {

                const diffX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX - lbTouchStartX;

                const diffY = e.changedTouches[0].screenY - lbTouchStartY;

                if (Math.abs(diffX) > 40 && Math.abs(diffX) > Math.abs(diffY)) {

                  if (diffX < 0) {

                    lightboxNext();

                  } else {

                    lightboxPrev();

                  }

                }

              }

            },

            { passive: true }

          );

        }

 

        // Open Product Detail Modal

        function openProductModal(productId) {

          const rawProduct = productsList.find((p) => p.id === productId);

          if (!rawProduct) return;

          savedWindowScrollY = window.scrollY;

          activeModalProduct = rawProduct;

          activeModalImageIdx = 0;

 

          const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

          const product = getLocalizedProduct(rawProduct, currentLang);

          const savings = Math.max(0, Number(rawProduct.oldPrice) - Number(rawProduct.newPrice));

          const cleanDigits = String(storeSettings.phoneDigits || '995551588579').replace(/\D/g, '') || '995551588579';

          const displayPhone = formatPhoneDisplay(cleanDigits);

 

          const warrantyLabel = currentLang === 'en'

            ? `${product.categoryLabel} · Code: ${rawProduct.sku} · Official 24-Month Warranty`

            : currentLang === 'ru'

            ? `${product.categoryLabel} · Код: ${rawProduct.sku} · Официальная гарантия 24 месяца`

            : `${product.categoryLabel} · კოდი: ${rawProduct.sku} · ოფიციალური გარანტია 24 თვე`;

          modalCategoryMeta.textContent = warrantyLabel;

 

          renderModalGalleryState();

          syncModalWishlistButton();

          syncPriceDropUI(productId);

          modalSkuCaption.textContent = `${product.shortMeta}`;

          modalProductTitle.textContent = product.name;

          modalNewPrice.textContent = formatGel(rawProduct.newPrice);

          modalOldPrice.textContent = formatGel(rawProduct.oldPrice);

          modalSavings.textContent = `-${formatGel(savings)}`;

          modalProductDesc.textContent = product.description;

 

          const specsArr = Array.isArray(product.specs) ? product.specs : [];

          modalSpecsGrid.innerHTML = specsArr

            .filter((s) => s && (s.label || s.value))

            .map(

              (spec) => `

              <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-stone-50 border border-zinc-200/80">

                <div class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">${spec.label || ''}</div>

                <div class="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 font-mono-num mt-0.5">${spec.value || ''}</div>

              </div>

            `

            )

            .join('');

 

          const waOrderText = currentLang === 'en'

            ? `Hello, I would like to order this product: ${product.name} (${rawProduct.newPrice} ₾)`

            : currentLang === 'ru'

            ? `Здравствуйте, хочу заказать этот товар: ${product.name} (${rawProduct.newPrice} ₾)`

            : (storeSettings.waDefaultText || 'გამარჯობა, მინდა შევუკვეთო ეს პროდუქტი');

          const encodedWaBase = encodeURIComponent(waOrderText);

          modalWhatsappBtn.href = `https://wa.me/${cleanDigits}?text=${encodedWaBase}`;

          modalViberBtn.href = `viber://chat?number=%2B${cleanDigits}`;

          modalTelegramBtn.href = `https://t.me/+${cleanDigits}`;

          const fbPageHref = String(

            storeSettings.fbUrl || 'https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100063598716104&sk=photos_albums'

          ).trim() || 'https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100063598716104&sk=photos_albums';

          const modalTopFbLink = document.getElementById('modal-top-fb-page-link');

          const modalBottomFbBtn = document.getElementById('modal-bottom-fb-btn');

          if (modalTopFbLink) modalTopFbLink.href = fbPageHref;

          if (modalBottomFbBtn) modalBottomFbBtn.href = fbPageHref;

 

          if (

            !storeSettings.tiktokHandle ||

            storeSettings.tiktokHandle === '@voltandvox' ||

            storeSettings.tiktokHandle === '@voltandvox.ge' ||

            storeSettings.tiktokHandle === 'https://www.tiktok.com/@voltandvox'

          ) {

            storeSettings.tiktokHandle = 'https://www.tiktok.com/@iyidebaiyide?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc';

          }

          const rawTtModal = String(

            storeSettings.tiktokHandle || 'https://www.tiktok.com/@iyidebaiyide?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc'

          ).trim();

          const ttModalHref = rawTtModal.startsWith('http')

            ? rawTtModal

            : `https://www.tiktok.com/${rawTtModal.startsWith('@') ? rawTtModal : '@' + rawTtModal}`;

          const modalTopTtLink = document.getElementById('modal-top-tiktok-link');

          const modalBottomTtBtn = document.getElementById('modal-bottom-tiktok-btn');

          if (modalTopTtLink) modalTopTtLink.href = ttModalHref;

          if (modalBottomTtBtn) modalBottomTtBtn.href = ttModalHref;

 

          const rawYtModal = String(storeSettings.youtubeUrl || 'https://www.youtube.com/@voltandvox').trim();

          const ytModalHref = rawYtModal.startsWith('http')

            ? rawYtModal

            : `https://www.youtube.com/${rawYtModal.startsWith('@') ? rawYtModal : '@' + rawYtModal}`;

          const modalTopYtLink = document.getElementById('modal-top-youtube-link');

          const modalBottomYtBtn = document.getElementById('modal-bottom-youtube-btn');

          if (modalTopYtLink) modalTopYtLink.href = ytModalHref;

          if (modalBottomYtBtn) modalBottomYtBtn.href = ytModalHref;

 

          const contactName = String(storeSettings.contactName || 'გოჩა').trim() || 'გოჩა';

          document.getElementById('modal-top-phone-link').href = `tel:+${cleanDigits}`;

          document.getElementById('modal-top-phone-link').textContent = `${contactName} · ${displayPhone}`;

          document.getElementById('modal-bottom-phone-link').href = `tel:+${cleanDigits}`;

          document.getElementById('modal-bottom-phone-label').textContent = `${contactName} · ${strings.modalCallNowBadge}`;

          const modalPricePhoneBanner = document.getElementById('modal-price-phone-banner');

          const modalPricePhoneDigits = document.getElementById('modal-price-phone-digits');

          const modalPriceContactName = document.getElementById('modal-price-contact-name');

          if (modalPricePhoneBanner) modalPricePhoneBanner.href = `tel:+${cleanDigits}`;

          if (modalPriceContactName) modalPriceContactName.textContent = contactName;

          if (modalPricePhoneDigits) modalPricePhoneDigits.textContent = displayPhone;

 

          const installmentText = encodeURIComponent(

            currentLang === 'en'

              ? `Hello, I want to order this product with installment: ${product.name} (${rawProduct.newPrice} ₾)`

              : currentLang === 'ru'

              ? `Здравствуйте, хочу заказать этот товар в рассрочку: ${product.name} (${rawProduct.newPrice} ₾)`

              : `გამარჯობა, მინდა შევუკვეთო ეს პროდუქტი განვადებით: ${product.name} (${rawProduct.newPrice} ₾)`

          );

          const cardPaymentText = encodeURIComponent(

            currentLang === 'en'

              ? `Hello, I want to order this product paying by card: ${product.name} (${rawProduct.newPrice} ₾)`

          );

 

          modalInstallmentBtn.href = `https://wa.me/${cleanDigits}?text=${installmentText}`;

              : ttModalHref;

 

          if (

        // High-Resolution Image Compressor: produces crisp, retina-ready JPEG with max 1600px dimension and ~150-250KB weight

        function compressImageFileToDataUrl(file) {

          return new Promise((resolve) => {

            const reader = new FileReader();

            reader.onload = function (ev) {

              const rawDataUrl = ev.target.result;

              const img = new Image();

              img.onload = function () {

                const maxDim = 1600;

                let w = img.width;

                let h = img.height;

                if (w > maxDim || h > maxDim) {

                  if (w > h) {

                    h = Math.round((h * maxDim) / w);

                    w = maxDim;

                  } else {

                    w = Math.round((w * maxDim) / h);

                    h = maxDim;

                  }

                }

                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');

                canvas.width = w;

                canvas.height = h;

                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

                ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;

                ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';

                ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);

                resolve(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.88));

              };

              img.onerror = function () {

                resolve(rawDataUrl || '');

              };

              img.src = rawDataUrl;

            };

            reader.onerror = function () {

              resolve('');

            };

            reader.readAsDataURL(file);

          });

        }

 

        // Uploads image to server static storage (/api/upload -> /uploads/filename.jpg)

        // Uploads image to server static storage (/api/upload -> /uploads/filename.jpg)

        // and immediately records productId + slotIndex on the server!

        async function uploadDataUrlToServer(dataUrl, prefix, productId = '', slotIndex = -1) {

          if (!dataUrl || typeof dataUrl !== 'string' || !dataUrl.startsWith('data:image/')) {

            return dataUrl;

          }

          try {

            const res = await fetch('/api/upload', {

              method: 'POST',

              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

              body: JSON.stringify({

                image: dataUrl,

                filename: prefix || 'prod_img',

                productId: productId || '',

                slotIndex: typeof slotIndex === 'number' ? slotIndex : -1

              })

            });

            if (res.ok) {

              const data = await res.json();

              if (data && data.ok && data.url) {

                if (productId && slotIndex >= 0) {

                  recordProductSlotInLocalBackup(productId, slotIndex, data.url);

                }

                return data.url;

              }

            }

          } catch (err) {

            console.warn('Direct upload to /api/upload failed, keeping dataUrl:', err);

          }

          if (productId && slotIndex >= 0) {

            recordProductSlotInLocalBackup(productId, slotIndex, dataUrl);

          }

          return dataUrl;

        }

 

        // Auto-save 5 images to the currently edited product in real time

        function syncFormImagesToActiveProduct(extraOpts = {}) {

          const existingId = fId.value.trim();

          if (!existingId) return;

          const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === existingId);

          if (!prod) return;

          prod.images = formFiveImages.slice(0, 5);

          prod.images.forEach((img, idx) => {

            recordProductSlotInLocalBackup(existingId, idx, img || '');

          });

          updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

          saveStateEverywhere(extraOpts);

        }

 

        // Render the 5 Image Upload Slots inside the Control Panel Form

        function renderFiveImageSlotsUI() {

          const tempProd = {

            sku: fSku.value || 'PRO',

            shortMeta: fShortMeta.value || '',

            category: fCategory.value || 'karaoke',

            newPrice: Number(fNewPrice.value) || 1000,

          const cardsHtml = [];

            const previewSrc = getProductSlotImageSrc(tempProd, i, activeThemeColor);

 

            cardsHtml.push(`

                  <span class="text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md ${

                  }">
