                  </span>

                </div>

 

                <!-- Preview Box -->

                <div class="relative aspect-[4/3] w-full rounded-xl bg-stone-100 border border-zinc-200/80 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden p-1.5">

                  <img

                    src="${previewSrc}"

                    alt="სურათი ${i + 1}"

                    referrerPolicy="no-referrer"

                    class="w-full h-full object-contain rounded-lg"

                  />

                </div>

 

                <!-- Upload File Button for Slot i (Also supports selecting up to 5 files at once!) -->

                <div class="space-y-1.5">

                  <label class="w-full min-h-[38px] px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300/80 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.98] fast-transition">

                    <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-700 shrink-0" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">

                      <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-8l-4-4m0 0L8 8m4-4v12" />

                    </svg>

                    <span>ფოტო #${i + 1} (ან 5-ვე)</span>

                    <input type="file" accept="image/*" multiple data-slot-file="${i}" class="hidden" />

                  </label>

 

                  <!-- Direct URL Input for Slot i -->

                  <input

                    type="text"

                    data-slot-url="${i}"

                    value="${hasCustom && !formFiveImages[i].startsWith('data:') ? formFiveImages[i].replace(/"/g, '&quot;') : ''}"

                    placeholder="ან ჩასვით URL #${i + 1}"

                    class="w-full min-h-[34px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 bg-stone-50 focus:bg-white text-[11px] focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-900"

                  />

 

                  <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 pt-0.5">

                    ${

                      i > 0 && hasCustom

                        ? `<button type="button" data-slot-make-main="${i}" class="text-[11px] font-semibold theme-text hover:underline">მთავარად დაყენება</button>`

                        : `<span></span>`

                    }

                    ${

                      hasCustom

                        ? `<button type="button" data-slot-clear="${i}" class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-600 hover:underline">წაშლა</button>`

                        : ''

                    }

                  </div>

                </div>

              </div>

            `);

          }

 

          cpFiveImagesGrid.innerHTML = cardsHtml.join('');

        }

 

        // Helper: Process 1 to 5 selected files at once, upload them to server disk, and place clean URLs into the 5 slots

        async function processAndInsertMultipleFiles(targetArray, fileList, startSlot = 0, productId = 'stagemax-1200w') {

          const files = Array.from(fileList || []).slice(0, 5);

          if (files.length === 0) return 0;

 

          showCpToast('სურათები მუშავდება და იტვირთება სერვერზე...');

          let added = 0;

          for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {

            const dataUrl = await compressImageFileToDataUrl(files[i]);

            if (dataUrl) {

              const slotToFill = (startSlot + added) % 5;

              const serverUrl = await uploadDataUrlToServer(

                dataUrl,

                `${productId}_slot_${slotToFill}`,

                productId,

                slotToFill

              );

              targetArray[slotToFill] = serverUrl;

              if (productId) {

                recordProductSlotInLocalBackup(productId, slotToFill, serverUrl);

              }

              added++;

            }

          }

          return added;

        }

 

        // Event Listeners for 5 Image Upload Slots (Supports both single photo AND 5 photos selected at once!)

        cpFiveImagesGrid.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {

          const fileInput = e.target.closest('[data-slot-file]');

          if (!fileInput) return;

          const slotIdx = Number(fileInput.getAttribute('data-slot-file')) || 0;

          const files = fileInput.files;

          if (!files || files.length === 0) return;

 

          // If user selected all 5 photos at once on any slot button, fill from slot 0..4; otherwise fill starting at slotIdx

          const startAt = files.length >= 5 ? 0 : slotIdx;

          const prodTag = fId.value.trim() || 'prod';

          const count = await processAndInsertMultipleFiles(formFiveImages, files, startAt, prodTag);

          fileInput.value = '';

          if (count > 0) {

            renderFiveImageSlotsUI();

            syncFormImagesToActiveProduct();

            showCpToast(

              count > 1

                ? `${count} ფოტო წარმატებით აიტვირთა სერვერზე და შეინახა!`

                : `სურათი #${slotIdx + 1} აიტვირთა სერვერზე და გამოჩნდება ტელეფონზეც!`

            );

          }

        });

 

        cpFiveImagesGrid.addEventListener('input', (e) => {

          const urlInput = e.target.closest('[data-slot-url]');

          if (!urlInput) return;

          const slotIdx = Number(urlInput.getAttribute('data-slot-url'));

          formFiveImages[slotIdx] = urlInput.value.trim();

          syncFormImagesToActiveProduct();

        });

 

        cpFiveImagesGrid.addEventListener('change', (e) => {

          const urlInput = e.target.closest('[data-slot-url]');

          if (!urlInput) return;

          renderFiveImageSlotsUI();

          showCpToast('სურათის ბმული განახლდა!');

        });

 

        cpFiveImagesGrid.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          const clearBtn = e.target.closest('[data-slot-clear]');

          if (clearBtn) {

            const slotIdx = Number(clearBtn.getAttribute('data-slot-clear'));

            formFiveImages[slotIdx] = '';

            const existingId = fId.value.trim();

            if (existingId) {

              recordProductSlotInLocalBackup(existingId, slotIdx, '');

            }

            renderFiveImageSlotsUI();

            syncFormImagesToActiveProduct({ forceClearProductId: existingId, forceClearSlot: slotIdx });

            showCpToast(`სურათი #${slotIdx + 1} წაიშალა.`);

            return;

          }

 

          const makeMainBtn = e.target.closest('[data-slot-make-main]');

          if (makeMainBtn) {

            const slotIdx = Number(makeMainBtn.getAttribute('data-slot-make-main'));

            const temp = formFiveImages[0];

            formFiveImages[0] = formFiveImages[slotIdx];

            formFiveImages[slotIdx] = temp;

            renderFiveImageSlotsUI();

            syncFormImagesToActiveProduct();

            showCpToast('მთავარი სურათი (#1) განახლდა!');

          }

        });

 

        // Multi-File Upload Handler (Select up to 5 images at once in one dialog!)

        cpMultiImgInput.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {

          const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []).slice(0, 5);

          if (files.length === 0) return;

 

          // If user selects multiple files (e.g. 5 files), place them cleanly into slots #1..#5

          // If only 1 file is selected and there is an empty slot, use the first empty slot

          let startSlot = 0;

          if (files.length === 1) {

            const emptyIdx = formFiveImages.findIndex((x) => !x || x.length === 0);

            if (emptyIdx !== -1) startSlot = emptyIdx;

          }

 

          const prodTag = fId.value.trim() || 'prod';

          const count = await processAndInsertMultipleFiles(formFiveImages, files, startSlot, prodTag);

          cpMultiImgInput.value = '';

          if (count > 0) {

            renderFiveImageSlotsUI();

            syncFormImagesToActiveProduct();

            showCpToast(`${count} ფოტო წარმატებით აიტვირთა სერვერზე და გამოჩნდება ტელეფონზეც!`);

          }

        });

 

        cpClearAllImgsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          formFiveImages = ['', '', '', '', ''];

          const existingId = fId.value.trim();

          if (existingId) {

            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) recordProductSlotInLocalBackup(existingId, i, '');

          }

          renderFiveImageSlotsUI();

          syncFormImagesToActiveProduct({ forceClearProductId: existingId, forceClearSlot: -1 });

          showCpToast('ყველა ატვირთული ფოტო გასუფთავდა.');

        });

 

        function buildSpecInputs(specsArray) {

          const rows = [];

          for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {

            const item = (specsArray && specsArray[i]) || { label: DEFAULT_SPEC_LABELS[i], value: '' };

            rows.push(`

              <div class="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 bg-stone-50 p-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/80">

                <input

                  type="text"

                  data-spec-label="${i}"

                  value="${(item.label || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}"

                  placeholder="მახასიათებელი ${i + 1}"

                  class="col-span-2 min-h-[38px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white text-xs"

                />

                <input

                  type="text"

                  data-spec-value="${i}"

                  value="${(item.value || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}"

                  placeholder="მნიშვნელობა (მაგ: 1200W)"

                  class="col-span-3 min-h-[38px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white text-xs font-mono-num"

                />

              </div>

            `);

          }

          cpSpecsContainer.innerHTML = rows.join('');

        }

 

        let toastTimer = null;

        function showCpToast(message) {

          cpToastText.textContent = message;

          cpToastBanner.classList.remove('hidden');

          if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);

          toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {

            cpToastBanner.classList.add('hidden');

          }, 3500);

        }

 

        document.getElementById('cp-toast-close').addEventListener('click', () => {

          cpToastBanner.classList.add('hidden');

        });

 

        function switchCpTab(tabName) {

          [cpTabBtnList, cpTabBtnForm, cpTabBtnSettings].forEach((btn) => {

            const isMatch = btn.getAttribute('data-cp-tab') === tabName;

            if (isMatch) {

              btn.classList.add('theme-bg', 'shadow-sm');

              btn.classList.remove('bg-white', 'text-zinc-700', 'border', 'border-zinc-200/80');

            } else {

              btn.classList.remove('theme-bg', 'shadow-sm');

              btn.classList.add('bg-white', 'text-zinc-700', 'border', 'border-zinc-200/80');

            }

          });

 

          cpListSection.classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'list');

          cpProductForm.classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'form');

          cpSettingsForm.classList.toggle('hidden', tabName !== 'settings');

 

          if (tabName === 'list') {

            renderCpProductsList();

          } else if (tabName === 'form') {

            renderFiveImageSlotsUI();

          } else if (tabName === 'settings') {

            populateSettingsForm();

          }

        }

 

        cpTabBtnList.addEventListener('click', () => switchCpTab('list'));

        cpTabBtnForm.addEventListener('click', () => switchCpTab('form'));

        cpTabBtnSettings.addEventListener('click', () => switchCpTab('settings'));

 

        const fCategoryLabel = document.getElementById('cp-prod-category-label');

        const fYtDuration = document.getElementById('cp-prod-yt-duration');

 

        function resetProductForm() {

          fId.value = '';

          fName.value = '';

          fCategory.value = 'karaoke';

          if (fCategoryLabel) fCategoryLabel.value = '';

          fOldPrice.value = '';

          fNewPrice.value = '';

          fBadge.value = 'აქცია';

          fSku.value = 'PRO-1000';

          fShortMeta.value = '';

          fDesc.value = '';

          fYoutube.value = 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M7lc1UVf-VE';

          if (fYtDuration) fYtDuration.value = '08:45';

          fYtCaption.value = '';

          fTiktok.value = 'https://www.tiktok.com/embed/v2/7234567890123456789';

          fTtCaption.value = '';

          if (fInstagram) fInstagram.value = 'https://www.instagram.com/p/C-DefaultReel/embed';

          if (fIgCaption) fIgCaption.value = '';

          formFiveImages = ['', '', '', '', ''];

 

          document.getElementById('cp-form-heading').textContent = 'ახალი პროდუქტის დამატება ხელით (5 სურათით)';

          document.getElementById('cp-submit-btn-label').textContent = 'პროდუქტის დამატება და საიტზე დაბრუნება';

          buildSpecInputs(null);

          renderFiveImageSlotsUI();

        }

 

        function loadProductIntoForm(productId) {

          const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === productId);

          if (!prod) return;

 

          ensureFiveImagesArray(prod);

          formFiveImages = prod.images.slice(0, 5);

 

          fId.value = prod.id;

          fName.value = prod.name || '';

          fCategory.value = prod.category || 'karaoke';

          if (fCategoryLabel) fCategoryLabel.value = prod.categoryLabel || '';

          fOldPrice.value = prod.oldPrice || '';

          fNewPrice.value = prod.newPrice || '';

          fBadge.value = prod.badgeText || '';

          fSku.value = prod.sku || '';

          fShortMeta.value = prod.shortMeta || '';

          fDesc.value = prod.description || '';

          fYoutube.value = prod.youtubeId ? `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${extractYoutubeId(prod.youtubeId)}` : '';

          if (fYtDuration) fYtDuration.value = prod.youtubeDuration || '08:45';

          fYtCaption.value = prod.youtubeCaption || '';

          fTiktok.value = prod.tiktokUrl || '';

          fTtCaption.value = prod.tiktokCaption || '';

          if (fInstagram) fInstagram.value = prod.instagramUrl || '';

          if (fIgCaption) fIgCaption.value = prod.instagramCaption || '';

 

          document.getElementById('cp-form-heading').textContent = `პროდუქტის და 5 ფოტოს რედაქტირება: ${prod.name}`;

          document.getElementById('cp-submit-btn-label').textContent = 'შენახვა და საიტზე დაბრუნება';

          buildSpecInputs(prod.specs || []);

          switchCpTab('form');

        }

 

        // Live auto-save when changing price inside the Edit Form

        function handleLiveFormPriceChange() {

          const existingId = fId.value.trim();

          if (!existingId) return;

          const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === existingId);

          if (!prod) return;

          const newOld = Number(fOldPrice.value);

          const newSale = Number(fNewPrice.value);

          if (newOld > 0) prod.oldPrice = newOld;

          if (newSale > 0) prod.newPrice = newSale;

          updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

          saveStateEverywhere();

        }

 

        fOldPrice.addEventListener('input', handleLiveFormPriceChange);

        fNewPrice.addEventListener('input', handleLiveFormPriceChange);

 

        document.getElementById('cp-clear-form-btn').addEventListener('click', resetProductForm);

 

        // Save Product Function

        function saveProductFromForm(shouldClosePanel) {

          const nameVal = fName.value.trim();

          if (!nameVal) {

            showCpToast('გთხოვთ შეიყვანოთ პროდუქტის დასახელება');

            fName.focus();

            return;

          }

 

          const specsCollected = [];

          for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {

            const lblEl = cpSpecsContainer.querySelector(`[data-spec-label="${i}"]`);

            const valEl = cpSpecsContainer.querySelector(`[data-spec-value="${i}"]`);

            const label = lblEl ? lblEl.value.trim() : '';

            const value = valEl ? valEl.value.trim() : '';

            if (label || value) {

              specsCollected.push({ label: label || `პარამეტრი ${i + 1}`, value: value || '—' });

            }

          }

 

          const catValue = fCategory.value;

          const customCatLabel = fCategoryLabel ? fCategoryLabel.value.trim() : '';

          const existingId = fId.value.trim();

          const targetId = existingId || 'prod-' + Date.now();

 

          const newProductObj = {

            id: targetId,

            sku: fSku.value.trim() || 'VV-PRO',

            category: catValue,

            categoryLabel: customCatLabel || CATEGORY_LABELS[catValue] || 'პროდუქტი',

            badgeText: fBadge.value.trim() || 'აქცია',

            name: nameVal,

            shortMeta: fShortMeta.value.trim() || 'ოფიციალური გარანტია 24 თვე',

            oldPrice: Number(fOldPrice.value) || 0,

            newPrice: Number(fNewPrice.value) || 0,

            images: formFiveImages.slice(0, 5),

            description: fDesc.value.trim() || nameVal,

            specs: specsCollected,

            youtubeId: extractYoutubeId(fYoutube.value),

            youtubeDuration: (fYtDuration && fYtDuration.value.trim()) || '08:45',

            youtubeCaption: fYtCaption.value.trim() || nameVal,

            tiktokUrl: normalizeTiktokEmbedUrl(fTiktok.value),

            tiktokCaption: fTtCaption.value.trim() || nameVal,

            instagramUrl: fInstagram ? normalizeInstagramEmbedUrl(fInstagram.value) : '',

            instagramCaption: fIgCaption ? fIgCaption.value.trim() || nameVal : nameVal

          };

 

          if (existingId) {

            const idx = productsList.findIndex((p) => p.id === existingId);

            if (idx !== -1) {

              productsList[idx] = newProductObj;

            } else {

              productsList.unshift(newProductObj);

            }

            preserveScroll(() => renderProducts());

            showCpToast('პროდუქტის 5 ფოტო და მონაცემები წარმატებით შეინახა!');

          } else {

            productsList.unshift(newProductObj);

            preserveScroll(() => renderProducts());

            showCpToast('ახალი პროდუქტი წარმატებით დაემატა საიტზე!');

            resetProductForm();

          }

 

          saveStateEverywhere();

 

          if (shouldClosePanel) {

            closeControlPanel();

          }

        }

 

        document.getElementById('cp-save-stay-btn').addEventListener('click', () => saveProductFromForm(false));

        document.getElementById('cp-save-close-btn').addEventListener('click', () => saveProductFromForm(true));

 

        cpProductForm.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

          if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.tagName !== 'TEXTAREA') {

            e.preventDefault();

            saveProductFromForm(false);

          }

        });

 

        // Render Products Management List inside Tab 1 (with 5-Thumbnails preview & Direct Inline Manual Editing of ALL fields)

        function renderCpProductsList() {

          const container = document.getElementById('cp-products-table-list');

          if (productsList.length === 0) {

            container.innerHTML = `<div class="p-8 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">პროდუქტების სია ცარიელია. დაამატეთ ახალი პროდუქტი.</div>`;

            return;

          }

 

          container.innerHTML = productsList

            .map((prod, idx) => {

              const urls = getProductFiveGalleryUrls(prod, activeThemeColor);

              const customCount = countCustomUploadedImages(prod);

 

              const miniThumbs = urls

                .map(

                  (u, i) => `

                  <img

                    src="${u}"

                    alt=""

                    referrerPolicy="no-referrer"

                    class="w-9 h-7 rounded-md bg-white border ${

                      prod.images && prod.images[i] ? 'theme-border' : 'border-zinc-200 opacity-70'

                    } object-contain p-0.5 shrink-0"

                  />

                `

                )

                .join('');

 

              return `

                <div class="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-stone-50 border border-zinc-200 flex flex-col gap-3">

                  <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3">

                    <!-- Left: Inline Editable Name, Short Meta, Badge, SKU & 5 Thumbnails -->

                    <div class="space-y-2 min-w-0 flex-1">

                      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-zinc-500">

                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-200/80 text-zinc-800 font-bold">#${idx + 1}</span>

                        <span>${escapeHtmlSafe(prod.categoryLabel || '')}</span>

                        <span>·</span>

                        <span class="theme-text font-semibold">${customCount}/5 ატვირთული ფოტო</span>

                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1 ml-auto sm:ml-2">

                          <button

                            type="button"

                            data-cp-move-up="${prod.id}"

                            ${idx === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}

                            class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-stone-100 disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer text-[11px] font-bold"

                            title="ზემოთ აწევა"

                          >↑ ზემოთ</button>

                          <button

                            type="button"

                            data-cp-move-down="${prod.id}"

                            ${idx === productsList.length - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}

                            class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-stone-100 disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer text-[11px] font-bold"

                            title="ქვემოთ ჩამოწევა"

                          >↓ ქვემოთ</button>

                        </div>

                      </div>

 

                      <!-- Inline Editable Name & Short Description -->

                      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-12 gap-2">

                        <div class="sm:col-span-5">

                          <label class="block text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 mb-0.5">დასახელება (ხელით შეცვლა):</label>

                          <input

                            type="text"

                            data-inline-name="${prod.id}"

                            value="${escapeHtmlSafe(prod.name || '')}"

                            class="w-full min-h-[34px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white text-xs font-bold text-zinc-950 focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-900"

                          />

                        </div>

                        <div class="sm:col-span-4">

                          <label class="block text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 mb-0.5">მოკლე აღწერა / სიმძლავრე:</label>

                          <input

                            type="text"

                            data-inline-meta="${prod.id}"

                            value="${escapeHtmlSafe(prod.shortMeta || '')}"

                            class="w-full min-h-[34px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white text-xs text-zinc-800 focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-900"

                          />

                        </div>

                        <div class="sm:col-span-3 flex items-end gap-1.5">

                          <div class="flex-1">

                            <label class="block text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 mb-0.5">ბეიჯი:</label>

                            <input

                              type="text"

                              data-inline-badge="${prod.id}"

                              value="${escapeHtmlSafe(prod.badgeText || '')}"

                              class="w-full min-h-[34px] px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-900"

                            />

                          </div>

                          <div class="w-20">

                            <label class="block text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 mb-0.5">კოდი:</label>

                            <input

                              type="text"

                              data-inline-sku="${prod.id}"

                              value="${escapeHtmlSafe(prod.sku || '')}"

                              class="w-full min-h-[34px] px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 bg-white text-xs font-mono-num text-zinc-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-900"

                            />

                          </div>

                        </div>

                      </div>

 

                      <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-0.5">${miniThumbs}</div>

                    </div>

 

                    <!-- Right: Direct Inline Price Inputs & 5-Photo Edit Button -->

                    <div class="flex flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap items-center gap-2 shrink-0">

                      <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200">

                        <label class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">ძველი ₾:</label>

                        <input

                          type="number"

                          min="1"

                          step="1"

                          data-inline-old-price="${prod.id}"

                          value="${prod.oldPrice}"

                          class="w-20 min-h-[32px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 text-xs font-mono-num text-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-900"

                        />

                      </div>

 

                      <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border theme-border">

                        <label class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-800 whitespace-nowrap">აქციის ₾:</label>

                        <input

                          type="number"

                          min="1"

                          step="1"

                          data-inline-new-price="${prod.id}"

                          value="${prod.newPrice}"

                          class="w-20 min-h-[32px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 text-xs font-mono-num font-bold theme-text focus:outline-none focus:border-zinc-900"

                        />

                      </div>

 

                      <label

                        class="theme-bg min-h-[38px] px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 fast-transition"

                        title="ერთი გახსნით მონიშნეთ 5 ფოტო და ატვირთეთ ერთდროულად"

                      >

                        <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2">

                          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M4 16v1a3 3 0 003 3h10a3 3 0 003-3v-1m-4-8l-4-4m0 0L8 8m4-4v12" />

                        </svg>

                        <span>5 ფოტო</span>

                        <input type="file" accept="image/*" multiple data-cp-list-upload="${prod.id}" class="hidden" />

                      </label>

 

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        data-cp-edit="${prod.id}"

                        class="min-h-[38px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white hover:bg-stone-100 text-zinc-800 border border-zinc-300 text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"

                      >

                        სრული ჩასწორება

                      </button>

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        data-cp-delete="${prod.id}"

                        class="min-h-[38px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"

                      >

                        წაშლა

                      </button>

                    </div>

                  </div>

                </div>

              `;

            })

            .join('');

        }

 

        // Direct 1-Click 5-Photo Upload from Control Panel Tab 1 List

        document.getElementById('cp-products-table-list').addEventListener('change', async (e) => {

          const uploadInput = e.target.closest('[data-cp-list-upload]');

          if (!uploadInput) return;

          const prodId = uploadInput.getAttribute('data-cp-list-upload');

          const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === prodId);

          if (!prod) return;

 

          ensureFiveImagesArray(prod);

          const count = await processAndInsertMultipleFiles(prod.images, uploadInput.files, 0, prod.id);

          uploadInput.value = '';

          if (count > 0) {

            updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

            await saveStateEverywhere();

            renderCpProductsList();

            showCpToast(`${count} ფოტო წარმატებით აიტვირთა სერვერზე და გამოჩნდება ტელეფონზეც!`);

          }

        });

 

        // Handle Inline Manual Edits (Name, Meta, Badge, SKU, Old Price, New Price) inside Tab 1 List

        document.getElementById('cp-products-table-list').addEventListener('input', (e) => {

          const nameInput = e.target.closest('[data-inline-name]');

          if (nameInput) {

            const prodId = nameInput.getAttribute('data-inline-name');

            const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === prodId);

            if (prod) {

              prod.name = nameInput.value;

              updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

              saveStateEverywhere();

            }

            return;

          }

 

          const metaInput = e.target.closest('[data-inline-meta]');

          if (metaInput) {

            const prodId = metaInput.getAttribute('data-inline-meta');

            const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === prodId);

            if (prod) {

              prod.shortMeta = metaInput.value;

              updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

              saveStateEverywhere();

            }

            return;

          }

 

          const badgeInput = e.target.closest('[data-inline-badge]');

          if (badgeInput) {

            const prodId = badgeInput.getAttribute('data-inline-badge');

            const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === prodId);

            if (prod) {

              prod.badgeText = badgeInput.value;

              updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

              saveStateEverywhere();

            }

            return;

          }

 

          const skuInput = e.target.closest('[data-inline-sku]');

          if (skuInput) {

            const prodId = skuInput.getAttribute('data-inline-sku');

            const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === prodId);

            if (prod) {

              prod.sku = skuInput.value;

              updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

              saveStateEverywhere();

            }

            return;

          }

 

          const oldInput = e.target.closest('[data-inline-old-price]');

          if (oldInput) {

            const prodId = oldInput.getAttribute('data-inline-old-price');

            const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === prodId);

            if (prod) {

              prod.oldPrice = Number(oldInput.value) || 0;

              updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

              saveStateEverywhere();

              showCpToast(`განახლდა ძველი ფასი: ${prod.oldPrice} ₾`);

            }

            return;

          }

 

          const newInput = e.target.closest('[data-inline-new-price]');

          if (newInput) {

            const prodId = newInput.getAttribute('data-inline-new-price');

            const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === prodId);

            if (prod) {

              prod.newPrice = Number(newInput.value) || 0;

              updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

              saveStateEverywhere();

              showCpToast(`განახლდა აქციის ფასი: ${prod.newPrice} ₾`);

            }

          }

        });

 

        document.getElementById('cp-products-table-list').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

          if (e.key === 'Enter') {

            e.preventDefault();

            showCpToast('ცვლილება შენახულია!');

          }

        });

 

        document.getElementById('cp-products-table-list').addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          const moveUpBtn = e.target.closest('[data-cp-move-up]');

          if (moveUpBtn) {

            const id = moveUpBtn.getAttribute('data-cp-move-up');

            const idx = productsList.findIndex((p) => p.id === id);

            if (idx > 0) {

              const temp = productsList[idx - 1];

              productsList[idx - 1] = productsList[idx];

              productsList[idx] = temp;

              saveStateEverywhere();

              preserveScroll(() => renderProducts());

              renderCpProductsList();

              showCpToast('პროდუქტი აიწია სიაში ზემოთ!');

            }

            return;

          }

 

          const moveDownBtn = e.target.closest('[data-cp-move-down]');

          if (moveDownBtn) {

            const id = moveDownBtn.getAttribute('data-cp-move-down');

            const idx = productsList.findIndex((p) => p.id === id);

            if (idx !== -1 && idx < productsList.length - 1) {

              const temp = productsList[idx + 1];

              productsList[idx + 1] = productsList[idx];

              productsList[idx] = temp;

              saveStateEverywhere();

              preserveScroll(() => renderProducts());

              renderCpProductsList();

              showCpToast('პროდუქტი ჩამოიწია სიაში ქვემოთ!');

            }

            return;

          }

 

          const editBtn = e.target.closest('[data-cp-edit]');

          if (editBtn) {

            loadProductIntoForm(editBtn.getAttribute('data-cp-edit'));

            return;

          }

          const delBtn = e.target.closest('[data-cp-delete]');

          if (delBtn) {

            const idToDel = delBtn.getAttribute('data-cp-delete');

            productsList = productsList.filter((p) => p.id !== idToDel);

            saveStateEverywhere();

            preserveScroll(() => renderProducts());

            renderCpProductsList();

            showCpToast('პროდუქტი წაიშალა სიიდან.');

          }

        });

 

        document.getElementById('cp-add-new-from-list-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {

          resetProductForm();

          switchCpTab('form');

        });

 

        document.getElementById('cp-reset-defaults-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {

          productsList = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_PRODUCTS));

          storeSettings = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS);

          saveStateEverywhere();

          applyStoreSettingsToDOM();

          preserveScroll(() => renderProducts());

          renderCpProductsList();

          showCpToast('საწყისი მონაცემები სრულად აღდგა!');

        });

 

        const forceSyncBtn = document.getElementById('cp-force-sync-btn');

        if (forceSyncBtn) {

          forceSyncBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {

            forceSyncBtn.disabled = true;

            forceSyncBtn.classList.add('opacity-75');

            showCpToast('მიმდინარეობს სინქრონიზაცია სერვერთან...');

            await saveStateEverywhere();

            if (typeof syncInitialStateFromServer === 'function') {

              await syncInitialStateFromServer();

            }

            forceSyncBtn.disabled = false;

            forceSyncBtn.classList.remove('opacity-75');

            showCpToast('ყველა ფოტო და პროდუქტი სინქრონიზებულია! გამოჩნდება მეორე კომპიუტერზე და ტელეფონზეც.');

          });

        }

 

        // Store Settings Tab 3 (Full Manual Control of Everything)

          setVal('cp-set-serv2-title', storeSettings.serv2Title || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv2Title);

          setVal('cp-set-serv3-tag', storeSettings.serv3Tag || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv3Tag);

        }

 

        function saveStoreSettings() {

          const getVal = (id, fallback) => {

            const el = document.getElementById(id);

            return el && el.value.trim() ? el.value.trim() : fallback;

          };

 

          storeSettings.brandName = getVal('cp-set-brand', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.brandName);

          storeSettings.contactName = getVal('cp-set-contact-name', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.contactName);

          storeSettings.phoneDigits =

            getVal('cp-set-phone', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.phoneDigits).replace(/\D/g, '') || '995551588579';

          storeSettings.fbUrl = getVal('cp-set-fb-url', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.fbUrl);

          storeSettings.waDefaultText = getVal('cp-set-wa-text', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.waDefaultText);

          storeSettings.igHandle = getVal('cp-set-ig-handle', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.igHandle);

 

          storeSettings.navCatalog = getVal('cp-set-nav-catalog', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.navCatalog);

          storeSettings.navSolar = getVal('cp-set-nav-solar', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.navSolar);

          storeSettings.navService = getVal('cp-set-nav-service', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.navService);

 

          storeSettings.catAll = getVal('cp-set-cat-all', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.catAll);

          storeSettings.catKaraoke = getVal('cp-set-cat-karaoke', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.catKaraoke);

          storeSettings.catSolar = getVal('cp-set-cat-solar', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.catSolar);

          storeSettings.catBundle = getVal('cp-set-cat-bundle', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.catBundle);

 

          storeSettings.catalogTitle = getVal('cp-set-catalog-title', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.catalogTitle);

          storeSettings.searchPlaceholder = getVal('cp-set-search-placeholder', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.searchPlaceholder);

 

          storeSettings.chatTitle = getVal('cp-set-chat-title', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.chatTitle);

          storeSettings.chatSubtitle = getVal('cp-set-chat-subtitle', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.chatSubtitle);

          storeSettings.chatEmptyCustomer = getVal('cp-set-chat-empty', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.chatEmptyCustomer);

 

          storeSettings.serv1Tag = getVal('cp-set-serv1-tag', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv1Tag);

          storeSettings.serv1Title = getVal('cp-set-serv1-title', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv1Title);

          storeSettings.serv1Desc = getVal('cp-set-serv1-desc', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv1Desc);

 

          storeSettings.serv2Tag = getVal('cp-set-serv2-tag', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv2Tag);

          storeSettings.serv2Title = getVal('cp-set-serv2-title', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv2Title);

          storeSettings.serv2Desc = getVal('cp-set-serv2-desc', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv2Desc);

 

          storeSettings.serv3Tag = getVal('cp-set-serv3-tag', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv3Tag);

          storeSettings.serv3Title = getVal('cp-set-serv3-title', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv3Title);

          storeSettings.serv3Desc = getVal('cp-set-serv3-desc', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serv3Desc);

 

          storeSettings.footerTagline = getVal('cp-set-footer-tagline', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.footerTagline);

          storeSettings.heroDiscount = getVal('cp-set-hero-discount', DEFAULT_SETTINGS.heroDiscount);

          const cpThemeColorEl = document.getElementById('cp-set-theme-color');

          if (cpThemeColorEl && cpThemeColorEl.value) {

            applyThemeColor(cpThemeColorEl.value, null, false);

          saveStateEverywhere();

          if (typeof renderAllChatWidgets === 'function') {

            renderAllChatWidgets();

          showCpToast('ყველა პარამეტრი, ტექსტი და ამინდის რეჟიმი წარმატებით შეინახა!');

        }

 

        const cpSetThemeColorInp = document.getElementById('cp-set-theme-color');

        if (cpSetThemeColorInp) {

        document.getElementById('cp-save-settings-btn').addEventListener('click', saveStoreSettings);

          }

        });

 

        // Open / Close Control Panel Modal

        function openControlPanel(initialTab = 'list') {

          savedWindowScrollY = window.scrollY;

          cpBackdrop.classList.remove('hidden');

          switchCpTab(initialTab);

        }

 

        function closeControlPanel() {

          cpBackdrop.classList.add('hidden');

          window.scrollTo({ top: savedWindowScrollY, behavior: 'instant' });

        }

 

        openCpBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openControlPanel('list'));

        quickAddBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          resetProductForm();

          openControlPanel('form');

        });

        footerAdminBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openControlPanel('list'));

        closeCpBtn.addEventListener('click', closeControlPanel);

        cpBackdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          if (e.target === cpBackdrop) closeControlPanel();

        });

 

        modalEditProductBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          if (!activeModalProduct) return;

          const idToEdit = activeModalProduct.id;

          modalBackdrop.classList.add('hidden');

          modalYoutubeIframe.src = '';

          modalTiktokIframe.src = '';

          activeModalProduct = null;

          cpBackdrop.classList.remove('hidden');

          loadProductIntoForm(idToEdit);

        });

 

        // Download Standalone Single-File HTML with Owner's 5 Photos & Custom Data Baked In

        document.getElementById('download-single-html-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {

          syncBakedStateTag();

          const cloneDoc = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);

          const rootDiv = cloneDoc.querySelector('#root');

          const viteScript = cloneDoc.querySelector('script[src="/src/main.tsx"]');

          const cpModal = cloneDoc.querySelector('#control-panel-backdrop');

          if (rootDiv) rootDiv.remove();

          if (viteScript) viteScript.remove();

          if (cpModal) cpModal.classList.add('hidden');

 

          const htmlString = '<!doctype html>\n' + cloneDoc.outerHTML;

          const blob = new Blob([htmlString], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });

          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

          const a = document.createElement('a');

          a.href = url;

          a.download = 'volt-and-vox-store.html';

          document.body.appendChild(a);

          a.click();

          document.body.removeChild(a);

          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

          showCpToast('მზა HTML ფაილი თქვენი ფოტოებით და ფასებით ჩამოიტვირთა!');

        });

 

        function setCategoryFilter(category) {

          preserveScroll(() => {

            activeCategory = category;

            document.querySelectorAll('.category-tab-btn').forEach((btn) => {

              const btnCat = btn.getAttribute('data-category');

              if (btnCat === category) {

                btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

                btn.classList.add('theme-bg', 'shadow-sm');

                btn.classList.remove('text-zinc-600');

              } else {

                btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');

                btn.classList.remove('theme-bg', 'shadow-sm');

                btn.classList.add('text-zinc-600');

              }

            });

            renderProducts();

          });

        }

 

        // Direct 1-Click 5-Photo Upload inside the Product Detail Modal

        const modalDirect5PhotoInput = document.getElementById('modal-direct-5photo-input');

        if (modalDirect5PhotoInput) {

          modalDirect5PhotoInput.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {

            if (!activeModalProduct) return;

            ensureFiveImagesArray(activeModalProduct);

            const count = await processAndInsertMultipleFiles(

              activeModalProduct.images,

              e.target.files,

              0,

              activeModalProduct.id

            );

            modalDirect5PhotoInput.value = '';

            if (count > 0) {

              activeModalImageIdx = 0;

              renderModalGalleryState();

              updateSingleProductCardInPlace(activeModalProduct);

              await saveStateEverywhere();

              showCpToast(`${count} ფოტო წარმატებით აიტვირთა და სამუდამოდ შეინახა სერვერზე!`);

            }

          });

        }

 

        // Event Listeners: Product Grid Click & Direct 1-Click 5-Photo Card Upload

        productGridEl.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {

          const directCardUpload = e.target.closest('[data-direct-card-upload]');

          if (!directCardUpload) return;

          const prodId = directCardUpload.getAttribute('data-direct-card-upload');

          const prod = productsList.find((p) => p.id === prodId);

          if (!prod) return;

 

          ensureFiveImagesArray(prod);

          const count = await processAndInsertMultipleFiles(prod.images, directCardUpload.files, 0, prod.id);

          directCardUpload.value = '';

          if (count > 0) {

            updateSingleProductCardInPlace(prod);

            await saveStateEverywhere();

            showCpToast(`${count} ფოტო წარმატებით აიტვირთა და სამუდამოდ შეინახა სერვერზე!`);

          }

        });

 

        productGridEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          const wishlistToggleBtn = e.target.closest('[data-wishlist-toggle]');

          if (wishlistToggleBtn) {

            e.stopPropagation();

            const prodId = wishlistToggleBtn.getAttribute('data-wishlist-toggle');

            toggleWishlistProduct(prodId, e);

            return;

          }

          const phoneCallLink = e.target.closest('[data-card-phone-call]');

          if (phoneCallLink) {

            e.stopPropagation();

            return;

          }

          const directUploadLabel = e.target.closest('[data-direct-card-upload-label]');

          if (directUploadLabel) {

            e.stopPropagation();

            return;

          }

          const cardChatBtn = e.target.closest('[data-card-chat]');

          if (cardChatBtn) {

            e.stopPropagation();

            const prodId = cardChatBtn.getAttribute('data-card-chat');

            openProductModal(prodId);

            setTimeout(() => {

              const modalChatEl = document.getElementById('modal-seller-chat-box');

              const modalChatInp = document.getElementById('modal-chat-text-input');

              if (modalChatEl) {

                modalChatEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });

              }

              if (modalChatInp) {

                modalChatInp.focus();

              }

            }, 120);

            return;

          }

          const cardScreenshotBtn = e.target.closest('[data-card-screenshot]');

          if (cardScreenshotBtn) {

            e.stopPropagation();

            const prodId = cardScreenshotBtn.getAttribute('data-card-screenshot');

            captureProductScreenshot(prodId);

            return;

          }

          const cardShareBtn = e.target.closest('[data-card-share]');

          if (cardShareBtn) {

            e.stopPropagation();

            const prodId = cardShareBtn.getAttribute('data-card-share');

            openShareModal(prodId);

            return;

          }

          const quickEditBtn = e.target.closest('[data-quick-edit-id]');

          if (quickEditBtn) {

            e.stopPropagation();

            const prodId = quickEditBtn.getAttribute('data-quick-edit-id');

            openControlPanel('form');

            loadProductIntoForm(prodId);

            return;

          }

          const card = e.target.closest('[data-product-id]');

          if (card) {

            openProductModal(card.getAttribute('data-product-id'));

          }

        });

 

        productGridEl.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {

            const card = e.target.closest('[data-product-id]');

            if (card) {

              e.preventDefault();

              openProductModal(card.getAttribute('data-product-id'));

            }

          }

        });

 

        // Wishlist button on Product Detail Modal

        const modalWishlistBtn = document.getElementById('modal-wishlist-btn');

        if (modalWishlistBtn) {

          modalWishlistBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            e.stopPropagation();

            if (activeModalProduct) {

              toggleWishlistProduct(activeModalProduct.id, e);

            }

          });

        }

 

        // =========================================================================

        // PRICE DROP ALERT BUTTONS & NOTIFICATION SIGNUP CONTROLLER

        // =========================================================================

        const priceDropToggleBtn = document.getElementById('price-drop-toggle-btn');

        const priceDropCloseFormBtn = document.getElementById('price-drop-close-form-btn');

        const priceDropFormBox = document.getElementById('price-drop-form-box');

        const priceDropPhoneInput = document.getElementById('price-drop-phone-input');

        const priceDropErrorMsg = document.getElementById('price-drop-error-msg');

        const priceDropEditBtn = document.getElementById('price-drop-edit-btn');

        const priceDropCancelBtn = document.getElementById('price-drop-cancel-btn');

 

        if (priceDropToggleBtn) {

          priceDropToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            e.stopPropagation();

            if (!priceDropFormBox) return;

            priceDropFormBox.classList.remove('hidden');

            priceDropToggleBtn.classList.add('hidden');

            if (priceDropPhoneInput) {

              if (!priceDropPhoneInput.value) {

                const remembered = localStorage.getItem('vv_price_drop_phone') || '';

                if (remembered) priceDropPhoneInput.value = remembered;

              }

              priceDropPhoneInput.focus();

            }

          });

        }

 

        if (priceDropCloseFormBtn) {

          priceDropCloseFormBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            e.stopPropagation();

            if (!priceDropFormBox || !priceDropToggleBtn) return;

            priceDropFormBox.classList.add('hidden');

            priceDropToggleBtn.classList.remove('hidden');

            if (priceDropErrorMsg) {

              priceDropErrorMsg.textContent = '';

              priceDropErrorMsg.classList.add('hidden');

            }

          });

        }

 

        if (priceDropEditBtn) {

          priceDropEditBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            e.stopPropagation();

            const subscribedBanner = document.getElementById('price-drop-subscribed-banner');

            if (subscribedBanner) subscribedBanner.classList.add('hidden');

            if (priceDropFormBox) {

              priceDropFormBox.classList.remove('hidden');

              if (priceDropPhoneInput && activeModalProduct && priceDropAlerts[activeModalProduct.id]) {

                priceDropPhoneInput.value = priceDropAlerts[activeModalProduct.id].phone || '';

                priceDropPhoneInput.focus();

              }

            }

          });

        }

 

        if (priceDropCancelBtn) {

          priceDropCancelBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            e.stopPropagation();

            if (!activeModalProduct) return;

            const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

            if (priceDropAlerts[activeModalProduct.id]) {

              delete priceDropAlerts[activeModalProduct.id];

              savePriceDropAlertsToStorage();

              syncPriceDropUI(activeModalProduct.id);

              showPriceDropToast(strings.priceDropCancelToast || 'შეტყობინება გაუქმებულია');

            }

          });

        }

 

        if (priceDropFormBox) {

          priceDropFormBox.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {

            e.preventDefault();

            e.stopPropagation();

            if (!activeModalProduct) return;

 

            const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

            const phoneVal = (priceDropPhoneInput ? priceDropPhoneInput.value : '').trim();

            const digitsOnly = phoneVal.replace(/\D/g, '');

 

            if (!phoneVal || digitsOnly.length < 6) {

              if (priceDropErrorMsg) {

                priceDropErrorMsg.textContent = strings.priceDropErrorEmpty || 'გთხოვთ შეიყვანოთ სწორი WhatsApp ნომერი';

                priceDropErrorMsg.classList.remove('hidden');

              }

              if (priceDropPhoneInput) priceDropPhoneInput.focus();

              return;

            }

 

            // Save signup in local storage mapping product ID to alert info

            priceDropAlerts[activeModalProduct.id] = {

              phone: phoneVal,

              targetPrice: Number(activeModalProduct.newPrice) || 0,

              productName: activeModalProduct.name,

              timestamp: Date.now()

            };

            savePriceDropAlertsToStorage();

            try {

              localStorage.setItem('vv_price_drop_phone', phoneVal);

            } catch (err) {}

 

            syncPriceDropUI(activeModalProduct.id);

            showPriceDropToast(strings.priceDropSuccessToast || 'ფასის კლების შეტყობინება წარმატებით გააქტიურდა WhatsApp-ზე! 🔔');

          });

        }

 

        // =========================================================================

        // WISHLIST MODAL DIALOG CONTROLLER & ACTIONS

        // =========================================================================

        const wishlistModalBackdrop = document.getElementById('wishlist-modal-backdrop');

        const closeWishlistModalBtn = document.getElementById('close-wishlist-modal-btn');

        const headerWishlistBtn = document.getElementById('header-wishlist-btn');

        const toolbarWishlistBtn = document.getElementById('toolbar-wishlist-btn');

        const wishlistClearAllBtn = document.getElementById('wishlist-clear-all-btn');

        const wishlistOrderAllWaBtn = document.getElementById('wishlist-order-all-wa-btn');

        const wishlistModalBody = document.getElementById('wishlist-modal-body');

        const wishlistTotalSum = document.getElementById('wishlist-total-sum');

 

        function openWishlistModal() {

          savedWindowScrollY = window.scrollY;

          renderWishlistModalContent();

          if (wishlistModalBackdrop) {

            wishlistModalBackdrop.classList.remove('hidden');

          }

          document.body.classList.add('overflow-hidden');

        }

 

        function closeWishlistModal() {

          if (wishlistModalBackdrop) {

            wishlistModalBackdrop.classList.add('hidden');

          }

          if (modalBackdrop && !modalBackdrop.classList.contains('hidden')) {

            document.body.classList.add('overflow-hidden');

          } else {

            document.body.classList.remove('overflow-hidden');

          }

        }

 

        function renderWishlistModalContent() {

          if (!wishlistModalBody) return;

          const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

          const wishlistedProducts = productsList.filter((p) => wishlistIds.has(p.id));

          const totalCount = wishlistedProducts.length;

 

          // Update badges

          document.querySelectorAll('.wishlist-count-badge').forEach((b) => {

            b.textContent = String(totalCount);

          });

 

          // Calculate total price sum

          const totalSum = wishlistedProducts.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (Number(p.newPrice) || 0), 0);

          if (wishlistTotalSum) {

            wishlistTotalSum.textContent = formatGel(totalSum);

          }

 

          // Build bulk WhatsApp link

          const cleanDigits = String(storeSettings.phoneDigits || '995551588579').replace(/\D/g, '') || '995551588579';

          if (wishlistOrderAllWaBtn) {

            if (totalCount === 0) {

              wishlistOrderAllWaBtn.classList.add('opacity-50', 'pointer-events-none');

              wishlistOrderAllWaBtn.href = '#';

            } else {

              wishlistOrderAllWaBtn.classList.remove('opacity-50', 'pointer-events-none');

              const lines = wishlistedProducts.map((p, i) => {

                const loc = getLocalizedProduct(p, currentLang);

                return `${i + 1}. ${loc.name} — ${formatGel(p.newPrice)}`;

              });

              let waMsg = '';

              if (currentLang === 'en') {

                waMsg = `Hello! I would like to order my saved Wishlist (${totalCount} items):\n\n${lines.join('\n')}\n\nTotal: ${formatGel(totalSum)}`;

              } else if (currentLang === 'ru') {

                waMsg = `Здравствуйте! Хочу заказать товары из Избранного (${totalCount} шт.):\n\n${lines.join('\n')}\n\nИтого: ${formatGel(totalSum)}`;

              } else {

                waMsg = `გამარჯობა! მსურს შევუკვეთო ჩემი რჩეული პროდუქტები (${totalCount} ერთეული):\n\n${lines.join('\n')}\n\nსულ ჯამი: ${formatGel(totalSum)}`;

              }

              wishlistOrderAllWaBtn.href = `https://wa.me/${cleanDigits}?text=${encodeURIComponent(waMsg)}`;

            }

          }

 

          if (wishlistClearAllBtn) {

            if (totalCount === 0) {

              wishlistClearAllBtn.classList.add('opacity-50', 'pointer-events-none');

            } else {

              wishlistClearAllBtn.classList.remove('opacity-50', 'pointer-events-none');

            }

          }

 

          if (totalCount === 0) {

            wishlistModalBody.innerHTML = `

              <div class="py-12 px-4 text-center space-y-3">

                <div class="w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-500 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl shadow-sm">

                  ❤️

                </div>

                <h4 class="font-bold text-zinc-950 text-base sm:text-lg">${strings.wishlistEmptyTitle}</h4>

                <p class="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-500 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">

                  ${strings.wishlistEmptyDesc}

                </p>

                <button

                  type="button"

                  id="wishlist-modal-explore-btn"

                  class="mt-2 theme-bg px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold shadow-sm active:scale-95 fast-transition cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"

                >

                  <span>${strings.wishlistExploreBtn}</span>

                  <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3">

                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M14 5l7 7m0 0l-7 7m7-7H3"/>

                  </svg>

                </button>

              </div>

            `;

            const exploreBtn = document.getElementById('wishlist-modal-explore-btn');

            if (exploreBtn) {

              exploreBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

                closeWishlistModal();

                setCategoryFilter('all');

                const catalogEl = document.getElementById('catalog');

                if (catalogEl) {

                  catalogEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });

                }

              });

            }

            return;

          }

 

          wishlistModalBody.innerHTML = wishlistedProducts

            .map((rawProd) => {

              const loc = getLocalizedProduct(rawProd, currentLang);

              const imgSrc = getProductImageSrc(rawProd, activeThemeColor);

              const savings = Math.max(0, Number(rawProd.oldPrice) - Number(rawProd.newPrice));

              const itemWaText = encodeURIComponent(

                currentLang === 'en'

                  ? `Hello, I want to order from my wishlist: ${loc.name} (${formatGel(rawProd.newPrice)})`

                  : currentLang === 'ru'

                  ? `Здравствуйте, хочу заказать из избранного: ${loc.name} (${formatGel(rawProd.newPrice)})`

                  : `გამარჯობა, მსურს რჩეულებიდან შევუკვეთო: ${loc.name} (${formatGel(rawProd.newPrice)})`

              );

              const itemWaHref = `https://wa.me/${cleanDigits}?text=${itemWaText}`;

 

              return `

                <div class="p-3 sm:p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 hover:border-zinc-300 fast-transition">

                  <div class="flex items-center gap-3.5 min-w-0">

                    <div

                      data-wishlist-open-prod="${rawProd.id}"

                      class="w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 rounded-xl bg-stone-100 border border-zinc-200/80 p-1 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden cursor-pointer"

                      title="${loc.name}"

                    >

                      <img src="${imgSrc}" alt="${loc.name}" class="w-full h-full object-contain pointer-events-none" />

                    </div>

                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">

                      <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-zinc-500">

                        <span class="font-medium text-zinc-700">${loc.categoryLabel}</span>

                        <span>·</span>

                        <span class="theme-text font-semibold">${loc.badgeText}</span>

                      </div>

                      <h4

                        data-wishlist-open-prod="${rawProd.id}"

                        class="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-zinc-950 truncate hover:underline cursor-pointer"

                        title="${loc.name}"

                      >

                        ${loc.name}

                      </h4>

                      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">

                        <span class="font-mono-num text-sm sm:text-base font-extrabold theme-text">

                          ${formatGel(rawProd.newPrice)}

                        </span>

                        <span class="font-mono-num text-xs text-zinc-600 line-through">

                          ${formatGel(rawProd.oldPrice)}

                        </span>

                        ${savings > 0 ? `<span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-600">-${formatGel(savings)}</span>` : ''}

                      </div>

                    </div>

                  </div>

 

                  <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 shrink-0 pt-2 sm:pt-0 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-zinc-100">

                    <a

                      href="${itemWaHref}"

                      target="_blank"

                      rel="noopener noreferrer"

                      class="min-h-[38px] px-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm active:scale-95 fast-transition"

                      title="WhatsApp შეკვეთა"

                    >

                      <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" viewBox="0 0 24 24">

                        <path d="M12.031 6.172c-3.181 0-5.767 2.586-5.768 5.766-.001 1.298.38 2.27 1.019 3.287l-.582 2.128 2.182-.573c.978.58 1.911.928 3.145.929 3.178 0 5.767-2.587 5.768-5.766.001-3.187-2.575-5.77-5.764-5.771zm3.392 8.244c-.144.405-.837.774-1.17.824-.299.045-.677.063-1.092-.069-.252-.08-.575-.187-.988-.365-1.739-.751-2.874-2.502-2.961-2.617-.087-.116-.708-.94-.708-1.793s.448-1.273.607-1.446c.159-.173.346-.217.462-.217l.332.006c.106.005.249-.04.39.298.144.347.491 1.2.534 1.287.043.087.072.188.014.304-.058.116-.087.188-.173.289l-.26.304c-.087.086-.177.18-.076.354.101.174.449.741.964 1.201.662.591 1.221.774 1.394.86s.274.072.376-.043c.101-.116.433-.506.549-.68.116-.173.231-.145.39-.087s1.011.477 1.184.564.289.13.332.202c.045.072.045.419-.1.824zm-3.423-14.416c-6.627 0-12 5.373-12 12 0 2.124.556 4.119 1.528 5.847l-1.528 5.581 5.714-1.499c1.693.903 3.621 1.419 5.672 1.419 6.627 0 12-5.373 12-12s-5.373-11.348-11.386-11.348z" />

                      </svg>

                      <span>${strings.cardOrderBtn}</span>

                    </a>

 

                    <button

                      type="button"

                      data-wishlist-remove-id="${rawProd.id}"

                      class="min-h-[38px] min-w-[38px] rounded-xl bg-stone-100 hover:bg-rose-50 text-zinc-600 hover:text-rose-600 border border-zinc-200/90 flex items-center justify-center active:scale-95 fast-transition cursor-pointer"

                      title="${strings.wishlistRemoveTip}"

                      aria-label="${strings.wishlistRemoveTip}"

                    >

                      <svg class="w-4 h-4 fill-current pointer-events-none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">

                        <path d="M19 6.41L17.59 5 12 10.59 6.41 5 5 6.41 10.59 12 5 17.59 6.41 19 12 13.41 17.59 19 19 17.59 13.41 12 19 6.41z"/>

                      </svg>

                    </button>

                  </div>

                </div>

              `;

            })

            .join('');

        }

 

        if (wishlistModalBody) {

          wishlistModalBody.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            const removeBtn = e.target.closest('[data-wishlist-remove-id]');

            if (removeBtn) {

              e.stopPropagation();

              const prodId = removeBtn.getAttribute('data-wishlist-remove-id');

              toggleWishlistProduct(prodId);

              return;

            }

            const openProd = e.target.closest('[data-wishlist-open-prod]');

            if (openProd) {

              e.stopPropagation();

              const prodId = openProd.getAttribute('data-wishlist-open-prod');

              closeWishlistModal();

              openProductModal(prodId);

            }

          });

        }

 

        if (closeWishlistModalBtn) {

          closeWishlistModalBtn.addEventListener('click', closeWishlistModal);

        }

        if (wishlistModalBackdrop) {

          wishlistModalBackdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            if (e.target === wishlistModalBackdrop) closeWishlistModal();

          });

        }

        const shareModalBackdrop = document.getElementById('share-modal-backdrop');

        const closeShareModalBtn = document.getElementById('close-share-modal-btn');

        const shareModalSubtitle = document.getElementById('share-modal-subtitle');

        const shareCopyLinkBtn = document.getElementById('share-copy-link-btn');

        const shareCopyLinkLabel = document.getElementById('share-copy-link-label');

        const shareUrlReadonly = document.getElementById('share-url-readonly');

        const shareFbLink = document.getElementById('share-fb-link');

        const shareMessengerBtn = document.getElementById('share-messenger-btn');

        const shareViberLink = document.getElementById('share-viber-link');

        const shareWaLink = document.getElementById('share-wa-link');

        const shareTgLink = document.getElementById('share-tg-link');

        let currentShareUrl = window.location.href;

        let currentShareTitle = '';

 

        function buildShareUrlForProduct(product) {

          const base = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;

          if (!product) return base;

          return `${base}?product=${encodeURIComponent(product.id)}`;

        }

 

        function copyTextToClipboard(text) {

          if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {

            return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(() => {

              shareUrlReadonly.select();

              document.execCommand('copy');

            });

          }

          shareUrlReadonly.select();

          document.execCommand('copy');

          return Promise.resolve();

        }

 

        function openShareModal(productId) {

          const rawProd = productId

            ? productsList.find((p) => p.id === productId)

            : activeModalProduct;

          const prod = rawProd ? getLocalizedProduct(rawProd, currentLang) : null;

          const cleanDigits = String(storeSettings.phoneDigits || '995551588579').replace(/\D/g, '') || '995551588579';

          const contactName = String(storeSettings.contactName || 'გოჩა').trim() || 'გოჩა';

          const displayPhone = formatPhoneDisplay(cleanDigits);

 

          currentShareUrl = buildShareUrlForProduct(rawProd);

          if (currentLang === 'en') {

            currentShareTitle = prod

              ? `${prod.name} — Sale Price: ${formatGel(rawProd.newPrice)} (Contact: ${contactName} ${displayPhone})`

              : `${storeSettings.brandName} — Karaoke Speakers & Solar Generators (${contactName}: ${displayPhone})`;

          } else {

            currentShareTitle = prod

              ? `${prod.name} — აქციის ფასი: ${formatGel(rawProd.newPrice)} (საკონტაქტო: ${contactName} ${displayPhone})`

              : `${storeSettings.brandName} — კარაოკე დინამიკები და სოლარ გენერატორები (${contactName}: ${displayPhone})`;

          }

 

          shareModalSubtitle.textContent = currentShareTitle;

          shareUrlReadonly.value = currentShareUrl;

          const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

          shareCopyLinkLabel.textContent = strings.shareCopyLink;

 

          const encUrl = encodeURIComponent(currentShareUrl);

          const encText = encodeURIComponent(`${currentShareTitle}\n${currentShareUrl}`);

          const encTitleOnly = encodeURIComponent(currentShareTitle);

 

          shareFbLink.href = `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${encUrl}`;

          shareViberLink.href = `viber://forward?text=${encText}`;

          shareWaLink.href = `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=${encText}`;

          shareTgLink.href = `https://t.me/share/url?url=${encUrl}&text=${encTitleOnly}`;

 

          shareModalBackdrop.classList.remove('hidden');

        }

 

        function closeShareModal() {

          shareModalBackdrop.classList.add('hidden');

        }

 

        shareCopyLinkBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          copyTextToClipboard(currentShareUrl).then(() => {

            const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

            shareCopyLinkLabel.textContent = `${strings.shareCopiedBtn} ✓`;

            setTimeout(() => {

              shareCopyLinkLabel.textContent = strings.shareCopyLink;

            }, 2500);

          });

        });

 

        shareMessengerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

          copyTextToClipboard(currentShareUrl);

          const isMobile = /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

          if (isMobile) {

            window.location.href = `fb-messenger://share/?link=${encodeURIComponent(currentShareUrl)}`;

          } else {

            window.open(`https://www.messenger.com/`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');

          }

        });

 

        closeShareModalBtn.addEventListener('click', closeShareModal);

        shareModalBackdrop.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          if (e.target === shareModalBackdrop) closeShareModal();

        });

 

        const headerShareBtn = document.getElementById('header-share-btn');

        const modalShareBtn = document.getElementById('modal-share-btn');

        const modalBodyShareBtn = document.getElementById('modal-body-share-btn');

        if (headerShareBtn) headerShareBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openShareModal(null));

        if (modalShareBtn) modalShareBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openShareModal(activeModalProduct ? activeModalProduct.id : null));

        if (modalBodyShareBtn) modalBodyShareBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openShareModal(activeModalProduct ? activeModalProduct.id : null));

        // SITE CODE & EMBED MODAL CONTROLLER (საიტის კოდის დაკოპირება სხვა საიტისთვის)

        // =========================================================================

        const siteCodeModalBackdrop = document.getElementById('site-code-modal-backdrop');

        const openSiteCodeModalBtn = document.getElementById('open-site-code-modal-btn');

        const closeSiteCodeModalBtn = document.getElementById('close-site-code-modal-btn');

        const copyFullHtmlSourceBtn = document.getElementById('copy-full-html-source-btn');

        const modalDownloadFullHtmlBtn = document.getElementById('modal-download-full-html-btn');

 

        function openSiteCodeModal() {

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-copy-code-target]').forEach((btn) => {

          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            const targetId = btn.getAttribute('data-copy-code-target');

              setTimeout(() => {

                btn.textContent = origText;

              }, 2200);

            });

          });

        });

 

        if (copyFullHtmlSourceBtn) {

          copyFullHtmlSourceBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            syncBakedStateTag();

            const cloneDoc = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);

            const rootDiv = cloneDoc.querySelector('#root');

            const viteScript = cloneDoc.querySelector('script[src="/src/main.tsx"]');

            const cpModal = cloneDoc.querySelector('#control-panel-backdrop');

            const codeModal = cloneDoc.querySelector('#site-code-modal-backdrop');

            const htmlString = '<!doctype html>\n' + cloneDoc.outerHTML;

            const origText = copyFullHtmlSourceBtn.innerHTML;

            copyTextToClipboard(htmlString).then(() => {

              copyFullHtmlSourceBtn.innerHTML = '<span>✅ მთლიანი HTML კოდი დაკოპირდა!</span>';

              setTimeout(() => {

                copyFullHtmlSourceBtn.innerHTML = origText;

        if (modalDownloadFullHtmlBtn) {

          modalDownloadFullHtmlBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
