        // =========================================================================

        // 1-CLICK FULL PRODUCT SCREENSHOT GENERATOR (With 5 Photos + Gocha's Phone)

        // =========================================================================

        const screenshotModalBackdrop = document.getElementById('screenshot-modal-backdrop');

        const closeScreenshotModalBtn = document.getElementById('close-screenshot-modal-btn');

        const screenshotCloseBottomBtn = document.getElementById('screenshot-close-bottom-btn');

        const screenshotPreviewImg = document.getElementById('screenshot-preview-img');

        const screenshotDownloadLink = document.getElementById('screenshot-download-link');

 

        function loadImageForCanvas(src) {

          return new Promise((resolve) => {

            const img = new Image();

            img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';

            img.onload = () => resolve(img);

            img.onerror = () => resolve(null);

            img.src = src;

          });

        }

 

        function drawRoundedRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {

          ctx.beginPath();

          ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);

          ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);

          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);

          ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);

          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);

          ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);

          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);

          ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);

          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);

          ctx.closePath();

        }

 

        function drawContainedImage(ctx, img, x, y, w, h) {

          if (!img) return;

          const scale = Math.min(w / img.width, h / img.height);

          const dw = img.width * scale;

          const dh = img.height * scale;

          const dx = x + (w - dw) / 2;

          const dy = y + (h - dh) / 2;

          ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, dw, dh);

        }

 

        async function captureProductScreenshot(productId) {

          const rawProd = productId

            ? productsList.find((p) => p.id === productId)

            : activeModalProduct;

          if (!rawProd) return;

 

          const prod = getLocalizedProduct(rawProd, currentLang);

          const cleanDigits = String(storeSettings.phoneDigits || '995551588579').replace(/\D/g, '') || '995551588579';

          const contactName = String(storeSettings.contactName || 'გოჩა').trim() || 'გოჩა';

          const displayPhone = formatPhoneDisplay(cleanDigits);

          const savings = Math.max(0, Number(rawProd.oldPrice) - Number(rawProd.newPrice));

 

          const galleryUrls = getProductFiveGalleryUrls(rawProd, activeThemeColor);

          const loadedImgs = await Promise.all(galleryUrls.map((u) => loadImageForCanvas(u)));

 

          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');

          const W = 1200;

          const H = 1620;

          canvas.width = W;

          canvas.height = H;

          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

 

          // Background

          ctx.fillStyle = '#fafaf9';

          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

 

          // 1. Top Dark Header Bar with Store Name & Gocha's Phone Number

          ctx.fillStyle = '#09090b';

          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 130);

 

          ctx.fillStyle = activeThemeColor || '#d97706';

          drawRoundedRect(ctx, 45, 28, 74, 74, 18);

          ctx.fill();

          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

          ctx.font = 'bold 34px sans-serif';

          ctx.fillText('V&V', 54, 77);

 

          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

          ctx.font = 'bold 34px sans-serif';

          ctx.fillText(storeSettings.brandName || 'VOLT & VOX', 140, 65);

          ctx.fillStyle = '#a1a1aa';

          ctx.font = '22px sans-serif';

          ctx.fillText(

            currentLang === 'en'

              ? 'Professional Karaoke Acoustics & Portable Solar Generators'

              : currentLang === 'ru'

              ? 'Профессиональная караоке акустика и портативные солнечные станции'

              : 'პროფესიონალური კარაოკე დინამიკები და სოლარ გენერატორები',

            140,

            100

          );

 

          // Top Right Phone Pill

          ctx.fillStyle = '#dc2626';

          drawRoundedRect(ctx, W - 470, 28, 425, 74, 18);

          ctx.fill();

          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

          ctx.font = 'bold 28px monospace';

          ctx.fillText(`${contactName}: ${displayPhone}`, W - 445, 75);

 

          // 2. Main Product Image Stage

          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

          drawRoundedRect(ctx, 45, 155, W - 90, 520, 28);

          ctx.fill();

          ctx.strokeStyle = '#e4e4e7';

          ctx.lineWidth = 2;

          ctx.stroke();

 

          const mainIdx = activeModalProduct && activeModalProduct.id === rawProd.id ? activeModalImageIdx : 0;

          drawContainedImage(ctx, loadedImgs[mainIdx] || loadedImgs[0], 75, 175, W - 150, 480);

 

          // 3. All 5 Product Gallery Thumbnails Strip

          const thumbW = 206;

          const thumbH = 145;

          const thumbGap = 20;

          for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {

            const tx = 45 + i * (thumbW + thumbGap);

            const ty = 695;

            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

            drawRoundedRect(ctx, tx, ty, thumbW, thumbH, 18);

            ctx.fill();

            ctx.strokeStyle = i === mainIdx ? activeThemeColor || '#d97706' : '#d4d4d8';

            ctx.lineWidth = i === mainIdx ? 4 : 2;

            ctx.stroke();

            drawContainedImage(ctx, loadedImgs[i], tx + 10, ty + 10, thumbW - 20, thumbH - 20);

          }

 

          // 4. Product Title & Category

          ctx.fillStyle = activeThemeColor || '#d97706';

          ctx.font = 'bold 24px sans-serif';

          const catLabel = prod.categoryLabel || (currentLang === 'en' ? 'Product' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Товар' : 'პროდუქტი');

          const badgeLabel = prod.badgeText || (currentLang === 'en' ? 'Special Offer' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Акция' : 'აქცია');

          const codePrefix = currentLang === 'en' ? 'Code:' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Код:' : 'კოდი:';

          ctx.fillText(`${catLabel} · ${codePrefix} ${rawProd.sku || ''} · ${badgeLabel}`, 45, 885);

 

          ctx.fillStyle = '#09090b';

          ctx.font = 'bold 36px sans-serif';

          const titleWords = (prod.name || '').split(' ');

          let line1 = '';

          let line2 = '';

          for (const w of titleWords) {

            if ((line1 + ' ' + w).length < 52) {

              line1 = (line1 + ' ' + w).trim();

            } else {

              line2 = (line2 + ' ' + w).trim();

            }

          }

          ctx.fillText(line1, 45, 935);

          if (line2) {

            ctx.fillText(line2, 45, 980);

          }

 

          // 5. Pricing Box (Sale Price, Old Price with red strikethrough, Discount in green)

          const priceBoxY = line2 ? 1005 : 965;

          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

          drawRoundedRect(ctx, 45, priceBoxY, W - 90, 175, 24);

          ctx.fill();

          ctx.strokeStyle = '#e4e4e7';

          ctx.lineWidth = 2;

          ctx.stroke();

 

          // Sale Price

          ctx.fillStyle = '#71717a';

          ctx.font = 'bold 22px sans-serif';

          ctx.fillText(currentLang === 'en' ? 'Sale Price:' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Цена по акции:' : 'აქციის ფასი:', 75, priceBoxY + 50);

          ctx.fillStyle = activeThemeColor || '#d97706';

          ctx.font = 'bold 58px monospace';

          ctx.fillText(formatGel(rawProd.newPrice), 75, priceBoxY + 125);

 

          // Old Price

          const oldX = 500;

          ctx.fillStyle = '#52525b';

          ctx.font = 'bold 22px sans-serif';

          ctx.fillText(currentLang === 'en' ? 'Old Price:' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Старая цена:' : 'ძველი ფასი:', oldX, priceBoxY + 50);

 

          const oldPriceText = formatGel(rawProd.oldPrice);

          ctx.fillStyle = '#52525b';

          ctx.font = 'bold 42px monospace';

          ctx.fillText(oldPriceText, oldX, priceBoxY + 120);

          const oldMetrics = ctx.measureText(oldPriceText);

          ctx.strokeStyle = '#dc2626';

          ctx.lineWidth = 5;

          ctx.beginPath();

          ctx.moveTo(oldX - 4, priceBoxY + 106);

          ctx.lineTo(oldX + oldMetrics.width + 6, priceBoxY + 106);

          ctx.stroke();

 

          // Discount

          const discX = 830;

          ctx.fillStyle = '#059669';

          ctx.font = 'bold 22px sans-serif';

          ctx.fillText(currentLang === 'en' ? 'Discount:' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Скидка:' : 'ფასდაკლება:', discX, priceBoxY + 50);

          ctx.font = 'bold 44px monospace';

          ctx.fillText(`-${formatGel(savings)}`, discX, priceBoxY + 120);

 

          // 6. Technical Specs Grid (Up to 6 specs)

          const specsStartY = priceBoxY + 200;

          const specs = Array.isArray(prod.specs) ? prod.specs.slice(0, 6) : [];

          const specColW = (W - 110) / 2;

          specs.forEach((sp, idx) => {

            const col = idx % 2;

            const row = Math.floor(idx / 2);

            const sx = 45 + col * (specColW + 20);

            const sy = specsStartY + row * 78;

            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

            drawRoundedRect(ctx, sx, sy, specColW, 66, 14);

            ctx.fill();

            ctx.strokeStyle = '#e4e4e7';

            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;

            ctx.stroke();

 

            ctx.fillStyle = '#71717a';

            ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';

            ctx.fillText(`${sp.label || ''}:`, sx + 20, sy + 28);

            ctx.fillStyle = '#18181b';

            ctx.font = 'bold 22px sans-serif';

            ctx.fillText(`${sp.value || ''}`, sx + 20, sy + 54);

          });

 

          // 7. Prominent Bottom Contact Call Strip with Gocha's Name & Phone Number

            80,

            currentLang === 'en'

              ? 'Free Delivery · Official Warranty · Installment Available'

              : currentLang === 'ru'

              ? 'Бесплатная доставка · Официальная гарантия · Рассрочка'

            80,

            H - 62

          );

 

          ctx.fillStyle = '#dc2626';

          drawRoundedRect(ctx, W - 520, H - 130, 445, 75, 18);

          ctx.fill();

          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';

          ctx.font = 'bold 34px monospace';

          ctx.fillText(displayPhone, W - 490, H - 81);

 

          const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');

          screenshotPreviewImg.src = dataUrl;

        // Video Review Tabs inside Modal (YouTube, TikTok & Instagram)

        const videoTabBoth = document.getElementById('video-tab-both');

        const videoTabYoutube = document.getElementById('video-tab-youtube');

        const videoTabTiktok = document.getElementById('video-tab-tiktok');

        const tiktokCard = document.getElementById('tiktok-review-card');

        function setVideoTab(mode) {

          [videoTabBoth, videoTabYoutube, videoTabTiktok, videoTabInstagram].forEach((btn) => {

            if (!btn) return;

            btn.classList.remove('theme-bg');

            btn.classList.add('text-zinc-600');

          });

 

          if (mode === 'both') {

            videoTabBoth.classList.add('theme-bg');

            videoTabBoth.classList.remove('text-zinc-600');

            youtubeCard.classList.remove('hidden');

            tiktokCard.classList.remove('hidden');

            if (instagramCard) {

              instagramCard.classList.remove('hidden');

              instagramCard.classList.remove('sm:col-span-2');

            }

            videoReviewsGrid.className = 'grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3';

          } else if (mode === 'youtube') {

            videoTabYoutube.classList.add('theme-bg');

            videoTabYoutube.classList.remove('text-zinc-600');

            youtubeCard.classList.remove('hidden');

            tiktokCard.classList.add('hidden');

            if (instagramCard) instagramCard.classList.add('hidden');

            videoReviewsGrid.className = 'grid grid-cols-1 max-w-lg mx-auto gap-3';

          } else if (mode === 'tiktok') {

            videoTabTiktok.classList.add('theme-bg');

            videoTabTiktok.classList.remove('text-zinc-600');

            youtubeCard.classList.add('hidden');

            tiktokCard.classList.remove('hidden');

            if (instagramCard) instagramCard.classList.add('hidden');

            videoReviewsGrid.className = 'grid grid-cols-1 max-w-lg mx-auto gap-3';

          } else if (mode === 'instagram') {

            if (videoTabInstagram) {

              videoTabInstagram.classList.add('theme-bg');

              videoTabInstagram.classList.remove('text-zinc-600');

            }

            youtubeCard.classList.add('hidden');

            tiktokCard.classList.add('hidden');

            if (instagramCard) {

              instagramCard.classList.remove('hidden');

              instagramCard.classList.remove('sm:col-span-2');

            }

            videoReviewsGrid.className = 'grid grid-cols-1 max-w-lg mx-auto gap-3';

          }

        }

 

        videoTabBoth.addEventListener('click', () => setVideoTab('both'));

        videoTabYoutube.addEventListener('click', () => setVideoTab('youtube'));

        videoTabTiktok.addEventListener('click', () => setVideoTab('tiktok'));

        if (videoTabInstagram) {

          videoTabInstagram.addEventListener('click', () => setVideoTab('instagram'));

        }

        function setCustomerViewMode(enabled) {

          if (enabled) {

            document.body.classList.add('customer-view-mode');

            chatActiveRole = 'customer';

            if (typeof setMoveBlocksMode === 'function' && isMoveBlocksModeActive) {

              setMoveBlocksMode(false);

            }

            if (typeof renderAllChatWidgets === 'function') {

              renderAllChatWidgets();

            }

          } else {

            document.body.classList.remove('customer-view-mode');

          }

        }

 

        const enterCustomerViewBtn = document.getElementById('enter-customer-view-btn');

        if (enterCustomerViewBtn) {

          enterCustomerViewBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            setCustomerViewMode(true);

            try {

              const url = new URL(window.location.href);

              url.searchParams.set('view', 'customer');

              window.history.replaceState({}, '', url.toString());

            } catch (e) {}

          });

        }

 

        function checkSharedProductUrlParam() {

          try {

            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

            const viewParam = params.get('view') || params.get('mode') || params.get('client');

            if (viewParam === 'customer' || viewParam === 'client' || viewParam === '1') {

              setCustomerViewMode(true);

            }

            const sharedProdId = params.get('product');

            if (sharedProdId && productsList.some((p) => p.id === sharedProdId)) {

              openProductModal(sharedProdId);

            }

          } catch (e) {}

        }

 

        // Language Switcher Button Event Listeners

        const langBtnKa = document.getElementById('lang-btn-ka');

        const langBtnEn = document.getElementById('lang-btn-en');

        const langBtnRu = document.getElementById('lang-btn-ru');

        if (langBtnKa) {

          langBtnKa.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguage('ka'));

        }

        if (langBtnEn) {

          langBtnEn.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguage('en'));

        }

        if (langBtnRu) {

          langBtnRu.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguage('ru'));

        }

 

        // =========================================================================

        // REAL-TIME IN-SITE CHAT ENGINE: "მისწერე გამყიდველს" (Text, Photo & Video)

        // =========================================================================

        let chatCustomerSessionId = '';

        try {

          chatCustomerSessionId = localStorage.getItem('vv_chat_session_id') || '';

          if (!chatCustomerSessionId) {

            chatCustomerSessionId = 'cust_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);

            localStorage.setItem('vv_chat_session_id', chatCustomerSessionId);

          }

        } catch (e) {

          chatCustomerSessionId = 'cust_' + Date.now();

        }

 

        let chatActiveRole = 'customer';

        let chatCustomerName = '';

        let chatCustomerPhone = '';

        try {

          chatCustomerName = localStorage.getItem('vv_chat_cust_name') || '';

          chatCustomerPhone = localStorage.getItem('vv_chat_cust_phone') || '';

        } catch (e) {}

 

        let chatCustomerConversation = null;

        let chatAllConversations = [];

        let chatSellerSelectedSessionId = chatCustomerSessionId;

        const stagedChatMedia = {

          home: null,

          modal: null

        };

 

        function escapeHtmlSafe(str) {

          return String(str || '')

            .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')

            .replace(/</g, '&lt;')

            .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')

            .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

        }

 

        function formatChatTime(isoStr) {

          try {

            const d = new Date(isoStr);

            return d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

          } catch (e) {

            return '';

          }

        }

 

        function getActiveConversationForCurrentRole() {

          if (chatActiveRole === 'seller') {

            if (chatSellerSelectedSessionId) {

              const found = chatAllConversations.find((c) => c.sessionId === chatSellerSelectedSessionId);

              if (found) return found;

            }

            if (chatAllConversations.length > 0) {

              chatSellerSelectedSessionId = chatAllConversations[0].sessionId;

              return chatAllConversations[0];

            }

            chatSellerSelectedSessionId = chatCustomerSessionId;

            return chatCustomerConversation;

          }

          return chatCustomerConversation;

        }

 

        function renderChatMediaPreview(prefix) {

          const previewBar = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-media-preview`);

          const previewContent = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-media-preview-content`);

          if (!previewBar || !previewContent) return;

 

          const item = stagedChatMedia[prefix];

          if (!item) {

            previewBar.classList.add('hidden');

            previewContent.innerHTML = '';

            return;

          }

 

          previewBar.classList.remove('hidden');

          if (item.mediaType === 'video') {

            previewContent.innerHTML = `

              <video src="${item.dataUrl}" class="w-14 h-10 object-cover rounded-lg bg-black border border-zinc-300 shrink-0" muted playsinline></video>

              <div class="truncate">

                <div class="text-xs font-extrabold text-zinc-900">🎬 ${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Video ready to send' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Видео готово к отправке' : 'ვიდეო მზადაა გასაგზავნად'}</div>

                <div class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 truncate">${escapeHtmlSafe(item.fileName || 'video.mp4')}</div>

              </div>

            `;

          } else {

            previewContent.innerHTML = `

              <img src="${item.dataUrl}" alt="" class="w-12 h-12 object-contain rounded-lg bg-white border border-zinc-300 p-0.5 shrink-0" />

              <div class="truncate">

                <div class="text-xs font-extrabold text-zinc-900">📷 ${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Photo ready to send' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Фото готово к отправке' : 'სურათი მზადაა გასაგზავნად'}</div>

                <div class="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 truncate">${escapeHtmlSafe(item.fileName || 'photo.jpg')}</div>

              </div>

            `;

          }

        }

 

        function renderSingleChatWidget(prefix) {

          const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

          const roleCustBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-role-customer`);

          const roleSellerBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-role-seller`);

          const custBar = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-customer-bar`);

          const sellerBar = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-seller-bar`);

          const threadsList = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-threads-list`);

          const messagesEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-messages`);

          const textInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-text-input`);

          const custUnreadEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-cust-unread`);

          const sellerUnreadEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-seller-unread`);

          const nameInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-name-input`);

          const phoneInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-phone-input`);

 

          if (!messagesEl) return;

 

          if (nameInput && document.activeElement !== nameInput) {

            nameInput.value = chatCustomerName;

          }

          if (phoneInput && document.activeElement !== phoneInput) {

            phoneInput.value = chatCustomerPhone;

          }

 

          // Calculate unread counts

          const totalSellerUnread = chatAllConversations.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (Number(c.unreadForSeller) || 0), 0);

          const totalCustomerUnread = Number(chatCustomerConversation?.unreadForCustomer) || 0;

 

          if (custUnreadEl) {

            if (totalCustomerUnread > 0) {

              custUnreadEl.textContent = String(totalCustomerUnread);

              custUnreadEl.classList.remove('hidden');

            } else {

              custUnreadEl.classList.add('hidden');

            }

          }

          if (sellerUnreadEl) {

            if (totalSellerUnread > 0) {

              sellerUnreadEl.textContent = String(totalSellerUnread);

              sellerUnreadEl.classList.remove('hidden');

            } else {

              sellerUnreadEl.classList.add('hidden');

            }

          }

 

          const toolbarBadge = document.getElementById('toolbar-chat-unread-badge');

          if (toolbarBadge) {

            const combinedUnread = chatActiveRole === 'seller' ? totalSellerUnread : totalCustomerUnread;

            if (combinedUnread > 0) {

              toolbarBadge.textContent = String(combinedUnread);

              toolbarBadge.classList.remove('hidden');

            } else {

              toolbarBadge.classList.add('hidden');

            }

          }

 

          // Role button active state

          if (roleCustBtn && roleSellerBtn) {

            const sizeClasses =

              prefix === 'home'

                ? 'min-h-[24px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px]'

                : 'min-h-[32px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px]';

            if (chatActiveRole === 'customer') {

              roleCustBtn.className = `${sizeClasses} font-bold theme-bg text-white flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer fast-transition`;

              roleSellerBtn.className = `${sizeClasses} font-bold text-zinc-300 hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer fast-transition`;

            } else {

              roleSellerBtn.className = `${sizeClasses} font-bold bg-amber-500 text-zinc-950 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer fast-transition`;

              roleCustBtn.className = `${sizeClasses} font-bold text-zinc-300 hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer fast-transition`;

            }

          }

 

          if (custBar && sellerBar) {

            if (chatActiveRole === 'customer') {

              custBar.classList.remove('hidden');

              sellerBar.classList.add('hidden');

            } else {

              custBar.classList.add('hidden');

              sellerBar.classList.remove('hidden');

            }

          }

 

          if (textInput) {

            textInput.placeholder =

              chatActiveRole === 'seller'

                ? strings.chatInputPlaceholderSeller

                : strings.chatInputPlaceholderCustomer;

          }

 

          // Render Seller Customer Threads Bar

          if (chatActiveRole === 'seller' && threadsList) {

            if (chatAllConversations.length === 0) {

              threadsList.innerHTML = `

                <span class="text-xs text-amber-900/80 py-1">

                  ${currentLang === 'en' ? 'No customer conversations yet — write below to start or reply.' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Пока нет сообщений от клиентов — напишите ниже, чтобы начать общение или ответить.' : 'ჯერ კლიენტის მიმოწერა არ არის — შეგიძლიათ პირდაპირ ქვემოთ დაწეროთ ან გააგზავნოთ ფოტო/ვიდეო.'}

                </span>

              `;

            } else {

              threadsList.innerHTML = chatAllConversations

                .map((conv) => {

                  const isSel = conv.sessionId === chatSellerSelectedSessionId;

                  const unread = Number(conv.unreadForSeller) || 0;

                  const labelName = escapeHtmlSafe(conv.customerName || (currentLang === 'en' ? 'Customer' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Покупатель' : 'მომხმარებელი'));

                  const labelPhone = conv.customerPhone ? ` · ${escapeHtmlSafe(conv.customerPhone)}` : '';

                  const labelProd = conv.lastProductName ? ` (${escapeHtmlSafe(conv.lastProductName.slice(0, 22))})` : '';

                  return `

                    <div class="inline-flex items-center rounded-xl border ${

                      isSel

                        ? 'bg-zinc-950 text-white border-zinc-950 shadow-sm'

                        : 'bg-white text-zinc-800 border-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-100/60'

                    } overflow-hidden shrink-0 fast-transition">

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        data-select-chat-session="${escapeHtmlSafe(conv.sessionId)}"

                        class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"

                      >

                        <span>👤 ${labelName}${labelPhone}${labelProd}</span>

                        ${

                          unread > 0

                            ? `<span class="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-red-600 text-white text-[10px] font-black">${unread}</span>`

                            : ''

                        }

                      </button>

                      <button

                        type="button"

                        data-delete-chat-session="${escapeHtmlSafe(conv.sessionId)}"

                        class="px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 hover:text-red-500 cursor-pointer border-l border-zinc-700/20"

                        title="${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Delete conversation' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Удалить диалог' : 'მიმოწერის წაშლა'}"

                      >✕</button>

                    </div>

                  `;

                })

                .join('');

            }

          }

 

          // Render Messages

          const activeConv = getActiveConversationForCurrentRole();

          const msgs = activeConv && Array.isArray(activeConv.messages) ? activeConv.messages : [];

 

          if (msgs.length === 0) {

            const custEmptyText =

              currentLang === 'ka'

                ? storeSettings.chatEmptyCustomer || strings.chatEmptyCustomer

                : strings.chatEmptyCustomer;

            const emptyPadClass = prefix === 'home' ? 'py-1.5 px-2.5 text-[11px]' : 'py-3 px-3 text-xs';

            messagesEl.innerHTML = `

              <div class="${emptyPadClass} text-center text-zinc-500 bg-white/80 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-200">

                ${chatActiveRole === 'seller' ? strings.chatEmptySeller : escapeHtmlSafe(custEmptyText)}

              </div>

            `;

          } else {

            messagesEl.innerHTML = msgs

              .map((m) => {

                const isSeller = m.sender === 'seller';

                const alignRight =

                  (chatActiveRole === 'customer' && !isSeller) ||

                  (chatActiveRole === 'seller' && isSeller);

 

                const bubbleClass = isSeller

                  ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white border border-zinc-800'

                  : 'theme-bg text-white shadow-sm';

 

                const roleBadge = isSeller

                  ? `<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-400 text-zinc-950 text-[10px] font-black">გამყიდველი · ${escapeHtmlSafe(storeSettings.contactName || 'გოჩა')}</span>`

                  : `<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black/20 text-white text-[10px] font-bold">👤 ${escapeHtmlSafe(m.senderName || 'კლიენტი')}</span>`;

 

                const productTagHtml = m.productName

                  ? `<button type="button" data-chat-open-prod="${escapeHtmlSafe(m.productId || '')}" class="mt-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-black/25 hover:bg-black/40 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-200 cursor-pointer max-w-full truncate">

                       <span>📦</span>

                       <span class="truncate underline">${escapeHtmlSafe(m.productName)}</span>

                     </button>`

                  : '';

 

                let mediaHtml = '';

                if (m.mediaUrl) {

                  if (m.mediaType === 'video') {

                    mediaHtml = `

                      <div class="mt-2">

                        <video

                          src="${escapeHtmlSafe(m.mediaUrl)}"

                          controls

                          playsinline

                          preload="metadata"

                          class="rounded-xl max-h-[240px] w-full max-w-[300px] bg-black border border-white/20 shadow"

                        ></video>

                      </div>

                    `;

                  } else {

                    mediaHtml = `

                      <div class="mt-2">

                        <img

                          src="${escapeHtmlSafe(m.mediaUrl)}"

                          alt="Chat photo"

                          data-chat-zoom-img="${escapeHtmlSafe(m.mediaUrl)}"

                          class="rounded-xl max-h-[220px] max-w-[260px] object-contain bg-white p-1 border border-white/20 shadow cursor-zoom-in hover:opacity-95 fast-transition"

                        />

                      </div>

                    `;

                  }

                }

 

                const textHtml = m.text

                  ? `<div class="mt-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">${escapeHtmlSafe(m.text)}</div>`

                  : '';

 

                return `

                  <div class="flex ${alignRight ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}">

                    <div class="max-w-[88%] sm:max-w-[78%] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 ${bubbleClass}">

                      <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] opacity-90">

                        ${roleBadge}

                        <span class="font-mono-num opacity-75">${formatChatTime(m.createdAt)}</span>

                      </div>

                      ${productTagHtml}

                      ${mediaHtml}

                      ${textHtml}

                    </div>

                  </div>

                `;

              })

              .join('');

 

            messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight;

          }

 

          renderChatMediaPreview(prefix);

        }

 

        function renderAllChatWidgets() {

          renderSingleChatWidget('home');

          renderSingleChatWidget('modal');

        }

 

        async function fetchChatStateFromServer() {

          try {

            const [custResp, sellerResp] = await Promise.all([

              fetch(`/api/chat?sessionId=${encodeURIComponent(chatCustomerSessionId)}`),

              fetch('/api/chat?role=seller')

            ]);

            if (custResp.ok) {

              const custData = await custResp.json();

              if (custData && custData.ok) {

                chatCustomerConversation = custData.conversation || null;

              }

            }

            if (sellerResp.ok) {

              const sellerData = await sellerResp.json();

              if (sellerData && sellerData.ok && Array.isArray(sellerData.conversations)) {

                chatAllConversations = sellerData.conversations;

                if (

                  chatAllConversations.length > 0 &&

                  !chatAllConversations.some((c) => c.sessionId === chatSellerSelectedSessionId)

                ) {

                  chatSellerSelectedSessionId = chatAllConversations[0].sessionId;

                }

              }

            }

            renderAllChatWidgets();

          } catch (err) {

            console.warn('Chat fetch warning:', err);

          }

        }

 

        function markCurrentChatAsRead() {

          const targetSessionId =

            chatActiveRole === 'seller' ? chatSellerSelectedSessionId : chatCustomerSessionId;

          if (!targetSessionId) return;

          fetch('/api/chat/read', {

            method: 'POST',

            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

            body: JSON.stringify({

              sessionId: targetSessionId,

              readerRole: chatActiveRole

            })

          }).catch(() => {});

        }

 

        async function sendChatMessageFromWidget(prefix) {

          const textInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-text-input`);

          const sendBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-send-btn`);

          const nameInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-name-input`);

          const phoneInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-phone-input`);

 

          if (nameInput && nameInput.value.trim()) {

            chatCustomerName = nameInput.value.trim();

            try {

              localStorage.setItem('vv_chat_cust_name', chatCustomerName);

            } catch (e) {}

          }

          if (phoneInput && phoneInput.value.trim()) {

            chatCustomerPhone = phoneInput.value.trim();

            try {

              localStorage.setItem('vv_chat_cust_phone', chatCustomerPhone);

            } catch (e) {}

          }

 

          const rawText = textInput ? textInput.value.trim() : '';

          const staged = stagedChatMedia[prefix];

 

          if (!rawText && !staged) {

            if (textInput) textInput.focus();

            return;

          }

 

          const targetSessionId =

            chatActiveRole === 'seller'

              ? chatSellerSelectedSessionId || chatCustomerSessionId

              : chatCustomerSessionId;

 

          const contextProduct =

            prefix === 'modal' && activeModalProduct

              ? getLocalizedProduct(activeModalProduct, currentLang)

              : null;

 

          if (sendBtn) sendBtn.disabled = true;

 

          try {

            const payload = {

              sessionId: targetSessionId,

              sender: chatActiveRole,

              senderName:

                chatActiveRole === 'seller'

                  ? `${storeSettings.contactName || 'გოჩა'} (${currentLang === 'en' ? 'Seller' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Продавец' : 'გამყიდველი'})`

                  : chatCustomerName || (currentLang === 'en' ? 'Customer' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Покупатель' : 'მომხმარებელი'),

              customerName: chatCustomerName || (currentLang === 'en' ? 'Customer' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Покупатель' : 'მომხმარებელი'),

              customerPhone: chatCustomerPhone,

              text: rawText,

              mediaData: staged ? staged.dataUrl : undefined,

              mediaType: staged ? staged.mediaType : undefined,

              productId: activeModalProduct ? activeModalProduct.id : undefined,

              productName: contextProduct ? contextProduct.name : undefined

            };

 

            const resp = await fetch('/api/chat/message', {

              method: 'POST',

              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

              body: JSON.stringify(payload)

            });

 

            if (resp.ok) {

              const data = await resp.json();

              if (data && data.ok) {

                if (textInput) textInput.value = '';

                stagedChatMedia[prefix] = null;

                if (data.conversation && data.conversation.sessionId === chatCustomerSessionId) {

                  chatCustomerConversation = data.conversation;

                }

                if (Array.isArray(data.conversations)) {

                  chatAllConversations = data.conversations;

                }

                renderAllChatWidgets();

              }

            }

          } catch (err) {

            console.error('Failed to send chat message:', err);

          } finally {

            if (sendBtn) sendBtn.disabled = false;

          }

        }

 

        function openSingleChatImageInLightbox(imgUrl) {

          if (!imgUrl || !lightboxModalBackdrop || !lightboxImg) return;

          lightboxImg.src = imgUrl;

          lightboxImg.alt = 'Chat Photo';

          if (lightboxProductTitle) {

            lightboxProductTitle.textContent =

              currentLang === 'en' ? 'Photo from Chat' : currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Фото из чата' : 'ჩატში გამოგზავნილი სურათი';

          }

          if (lightboxCounterBadge) {

            lightboxCounterBadge.textContent = '📷';

          }

          lightboxModalBackdrop.classList.remove('hidden');

          document.body.classList.add('overflow-hidden');

        }

 

        // Rich Smiley / Emoji Sets for Chat

        const QUICK_CHAT_EMOJIS = [

          '😊', '😂', '❤️', '👍', '🔥', '🎉', '🙏', '🎤', '🔊', '☀️', '⚡', '💯', '🤝', '🚚', '✨'

        ];

        const FULL_CHAT_EMOJIS = [

          '😊', '😀', '😃', '😄', '😁', '😆', '😂', '🤣', '😉', '😍', '🥰', '😘',

          '😎', '🤩', '🥳', '🤗', '🤔', '😮', '😲', '🙌', '👏', '👍', '👌', '✌️',

          '🤞', '🤝', '🙏', '💪', '❤️', '🧡', '💛', '💚', '💙', '💜', '🖤', '💖',

          '💯', '🔥', '✨', '⭐', '🌟', '⚡', '☀️', '🌤️', '🌧️', '❄️', '🌈', '🎉',

          '🎊', '🎁', '🎈', '🎤', '🎧', '🔊', '🎶', '🎵', '🎸', '🥁', '🔋', '🔌',

          '💡', '📦', '🚚', '🏠', '🏕️', '⛰️', '🇬🇪', '✅', '💬', '📞', '📱', '💰'

        ];

 

        function insertEmojiIntoChatInput(textInput, emoji) {

          if (!textInput) return;

          const start = typeof textInput.selectionStart === 'number' ? textInput.selectionStart : textInput.value.length;

          const end = typeof textInput.selectionEnd === 'number' ? textInput.selectionEnd : textInput.value.length;

          const before = textInput.value.slice(0, start);

          const after = textInput.value.slice(end);

          textInput.value = before + emoji + after;

          const nextPos = start + emoji.length;

          textInput.focus();

          try {

            textInput.setSelectionRange(nextPos, nextPos);

          } catch (e) {}

        }

 

        function bindChatWidgetEvents(prefix) {

          const roleCustBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-role-customer`);

          const roleSellerBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-role-seller`);

          const nameInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-name-input`);

          const phoneInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-phone-input`);

          const threadsList = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-threads-list`);

          const messagesEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-messages`);

          const photoBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-attach-photo-btn`);

          const videoBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-attach-video-btn`);

          const photoFile = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-photo-file`);

          const videoFile = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-video-file`);

          const clearMediaBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-media-clear-btn`);

          const textInput = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-text-input`);

          const sendBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-send-btn`);

 

          // Smiley / Emoji UI Elements

          const quickEmojisEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-quick-emojis`);

          const emojiToggleBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-emoji-toggle-btn`);

          const emojiPanelEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-emoji-panel`);

          const emojiGridEl = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-emoji-grid`);

          const emojiCloseBtn = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chat-emoji-close-btn`);

 

          if (quickEmojisEl) {

            const emojiBtnSize = prefix === 'home' ? 'w-6 h-6 text-xs rounded-md' : 'w-7 h-7 sm:w-8 sm:h-8 text-sm sm:text-base rounded-lg';

            quickEmojisEl.innerHTML = QUICK_CHAT_EMOJIS.map(

              (em) => `

                <button

                  type="button"

                  data-chat-emoji="${em}"

                  class="${emojiBtnSize} bg-white hover:bg-amber-50 border border-zinc-200 hover:border-amber-300 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-90 fast-transition shrink-0"

                  title="სმაილის ჩასმა ${em}"

                >${em}</button>

              `

            ).join('');

 

            quickEmojisEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

              const btn = e.target.closest('[data-chat-emoji]');

              if (!btn) return;

              insertEmojiIntoChatInput(textInput, btn.getAttribute('data-chat-emoji'));

            });

          }

 

          if (prefix === 'home') {

            const collapseBtn = document.getElementById('home-chat-collapse-btn');

            const collapseIcon = document.getElementById('home-chat-collapse-icon');

            const chatBody = document.getElementById('home-chat-body');

            if (collapseBtn && chatBody) {

              collapseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

                const isHidden = chatBody.classList.toggle('hidden');

                if (collapseIcon) collapseIcon.textContent = isHidden ? '▸' : '▾';

              });

            }

          }

 

          if (emojiGridEl) {

            emojiGridEl.innerHTML = FULL_CHAT_EMOJIS.map(

              (em) => `

                <button

                  type="button"

                  data-chat-emoji="${em}"

                  class="h-8 rounded-lg hover:bg-amber-50 border border-transparent hover:border-amber-200 flex items-center justify-center text-base sm:text-lg cursor-pointer active:scale-90 fast-transition"

                >${em}</button>

              `

            ).join('');

 

            emojiGridEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

              const btn = e.target.closest('[data-chat-emoji]');

              if (!btn) return;

              insertEmojiIntoChatInput(textInput, btn.getAttribute('data-chat-emoji'));

            });

          }

 

          if (emojiToggleBtn && emojiPanelEl) {

            emojiToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

              emojiPanelEl.classList.toggle('hidden');

            });

          }

 

          if (emojiCloseBtn && emojiPanelEl) {

            emojiCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

              emojiPanelEl.classList.add('hidden');

            });

          }

 

          if (roleCustBtn) {

            roleCustBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

              chatActiveRole = 'customer';

              markCurrentChatAsRead();

              renderAllChatWidgets();

            });

          }

 

          if (roleSellerBtn) {

            roleSellerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

              chatActiveRole = 'seller';

              if (

                chatAllConversations.length > 0 &&

                !chatAllConversations.some((c) => c.sessionId === chatSellerSelectedSessionId)

              ) {

                chatSellerSelectedSessionId = chatAllConversations[0].sessionId;

              }

              markCurrentChatAsRead();

              renderAllChatWidgets();

            });

          }

 

          if (nameInput) {

            nameInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {

              chatCustomerName = e.target.value;

              try {

                localStorage.setItem('vv_chat_cust_name', chatCustomerName);

              } catch (err) {}

            });

          }

 

          if (phoneInput) {

            phoneInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {

              chatCustomerPhone = e.target.value;

              try {

                localStorage.setItem('vv_chat_cust_phone', chatCustomerPhone);

              } catch (err) {}

            });

          }

 

          if (threadsList) {

            threadsList.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {

              const delBtn = e.target.closest('[data-delete-chat-session]');

              if (delBtn) {

                e.stopPropagation();

                const sessId = delBtn.getAttribute('data-delete-chat-session');

                if (sessId) {

                  try {

                    const r = await fetch(`/api/chat/${encodeURIComponent(sessId)}`, {

                      method: 'DELETE'

                    });

                    if (r.ok) {

                      const d = await r.json();

                      if (d && Array.isArray(d.conversations)) {

                        chatAllConversations = d.conversations;

                      }

                      if (sessId === chatCustomerSessionId) {

                        chatCustomerConversation = null;

                      }

                      chatSellerSelectedSessionId =

                        chatAllConversations[0]?.sessionId || chatCustomerSessionId;

                      renderAllChatWidgets();

                    }

                  } catch (err) {}

                }

                return;

              }

 

              const selBtn = e.target.closest('[data-select-chat-session]');

              if (selBtn) {

                const sessId = selBtn.getAttribute('data-select-chat-session');

                if (sessId) {

                  chatSellerSelectedSessionId = sessId;

                  markCurrentChatAsRead();

                  renderAllChatWidgets();

                }

              }

            });

          }

 

          if (messagesEl) {

            messagesEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

              const zoomImg = e.target.closest('[data-chat-zoom-img]');

              if (zoomImg) {

                openSingleChatImageInLightbox(zoomImg.getAttribute('data-chat-zoom-img'));

                return;

              }

              const prodBtn = e.target.closest('[data-chat-open-prod]');

              if (prodBtn) {

                const pid = prodBtn.getAttribute('data-chat-open-prod');

                if (pid && productsList.some((p) => p.id === pid)) {

                  openProductModal(pid);

                }

              }

            });

          }

 

          if (photoBtn && photoFile) {

            photoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => photoFile.click());

            photoFile.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {

              const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];

              if (!file) return;

              try {

                const compressed = await compressImageFileToDataUrl(file);

                stagedChatMedia[prefix] = {

                  dataUrl: compressed,

                  mediaType: 'image',

                  fileName: file.name

                };

                renderChatMediaPreview(prefix);

                if (textInput) textInput.focus();

              } catch (err) {

                console.error('Chat photo read error:', err);

              }

              photoFile.value = '';

            });

          }

 

          if (videoBtn && videoFile) {

            videoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => videoFile.click());

            videoFile.addEventListener('change', (e) => {

              const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];

              if (!file) return;

              const reader = new FileReader();

              reader.onload = () => {

                if (typeof reader.result === 'string') {

                  stagedChatMedia[prefix] = {

                    dataUrl: reader.result,

                    mediaType: 'video',

                    fileName: file.name

                  };

                  renderChatMediaPreview(prefix);

                  if (textInput) textInput.focus();

                }

              };

              reader.readAsDataURL(file);

              videoFile.value = '';

            });

          }

 

          if (clearMediaBtn) {

            clearMediaBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

              stagedChatMedia[prefix] = null;

              renderChatMediaPreview(prefix);

            });

          }

 

          if (sendBtn) {

            sendBtn.addEventListener('click', () => sendChatMessageFromWidget(prefix));

          }

 

          if (textInput) {

            textInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

              if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {

                e.preventDefault();

                sendChatMessageFromWidget(prefix);

              }

            });

            textInput.addEventListener('focus', () => {

              markCurrentChatAsRead();

            });

          }

        }

 

        // Toolbar & Modal Quick Jump Buttons to Chat

        const toolbarOpenChatBtn = document.getElementById('toolbar-open-chat-btn');

        if (toolbarOpenChatBtn) {

          toolbarOpenChatBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            const homeChatEl = document.getElementById('home-seller-chat-box');

            const homeChatInp = document.getElementById('home-chat-text-input');

            if (homeChatEl) {

              homeChatEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });

            }

            if (homeChatInp) {

              setTimeout(() => homeChatInp.focus(), 200);

            }

          });

        }

 

        const modalJumpToChatBtn = document.getElementById('modal-jump-to-chat-btn');

        if (modalJumpToChatBtn) {

          modalJumpToChatBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            const modalChatEl = document.getElementById('modal-seller-chat-box');

            const modalChatInp = document.getElementById('modal-chat-text-input');

            if (modalChatEl) {

              modalChatEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });

            }

            if (modalChatInp) {

              setTimeout(() => modalChatInp.focus(), 200);

            }

          });

        }

 

        function connectChatWebSocket() {

          try {

            const proto = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';

            const wsUrl = `${proto}//${window.location.host}/ws-chat`;

            const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);

 

            ws.addEventListener('message', (event) => {

              try {

                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);

                if (

                  data.type === 'chat:message' ||

                  data.type === 'chat:read' ||

                  data.type === 'chat:deleted'

                ) {

                  if (Array.isArray(data.conversations)) {

                    chatAllConversations = data.conversations;

                  }

                  if (data.sessionId === chatCustomerSessionId) {

                    chatCustomerConversation =

                      data.type === 'chat:deleted' ? null : data.conversation || chatCustomerConversation;

                  }

                  if (

                    chatActiveRole === 'seller' &&

                    data.sessionId &&

                    (!chatSellerSelectedSessionId || data.type === 'chat:message')

                  ) {

                    if (!chatAllConversations.some((c) => c.sessionId === chatSellerSelectedSessionId)) {

                      chatSellerSelectedSessionId = data.sessionId;

                    }

                  }

                  renderAllChatWidgets();

                }

 

                // Real-time synchronization of products & photos across devices (Phone, PC 1, PC 2)

                if (data.type === 'store:sync') {

                  if (Array.isArray(data.productsList) && data.productsList.length > 0) {

                    productsList = data.productsList;

                    productsList.forEach(ensureFiveImagesArray);

                    mergeImagesMapIntoProductsList(productsList, data.imagesMap || null);

                    try {

                      localStorage.setItem('vv_store_products_v1', JSON.stringify(productsList));

                    } catch (e) {}

                  } else if (data.imagesMap) {

                    mergeImagesMapIntoProductsList(productsList, data.imagesMap);

                  }

                  if (data.storeSettings) {

                    storeSettings = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, data.storeSettings);

                    try {

                      localStorage.setItem('vv_store_settings_v1', JSON.stringify(storeSettings));

                    } catch (e) {}

                  }

                  if (data.themeColor && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(data.themeColor)) {

                    activeThemeColor = data.themeColor;

                    try {

                      localStorage.setItem('vv_theme_color', activeThemeColor);

                    } catch (e) {}

                  }

                  preserveScroll(() => {

                    renderProducts();

                    applyStoreSettingsToDOM();

                    updateCategoryTabCounts();

                    if (activeModalProduct) {

                      const updated = productsList.find((p) => p.id === activeModalProduct.id);

                      if (updated) {

                        activeModalProduct = updated;

                        renderModalGalleryState();

                      }

                    }

                    if (cpBackdrop && !cpBackdrop.classList.contains('hidden')) {

                      renderCpProductsList();

                    }

                  });

                  showCpToast('🔄 მონაცემები და ფოტოები განახლდა მეორე მოწყობილობიდან!');

                }

              } catch (e) {}

            });

 

            ws.addEventListener('close', () => {

              setTimeout(connectChatWebSocket, 3500);

            });

          } catch (e) {}

        }

 

        // =========================================================================

        // INTERACTIVE SITE WEATHER ENGINE (SUN ☀️, RAIN 🌧️, SNOW ❄️, OFF 🌤️)

        // =========================================================================

        const weatherCanvas = document.getElementById('weather-canvas');

        const weatherSunOverlay = document.getElementById('weather-sun-overlay');

        const weatherAtmosphereTint = document.getElementById('weather-atmosphere-tint');

        const toolbarWeatherSlider = document.getElementById('toolbar-weather-intensity');

        const cpWeatherSlider = document.getElementById('cp-set-weather-intensity');

 

        let activeWeatherMode = storeSettings.weatherMode || 'snow';

        let activeWeatherIntensity = Number(storeSettings.weatherIntensity ?? 65);

        let weatherParticles = [];

        let weatherSplashes = [];

        let weatherAnimFrameId = null;

 

        function resizeWeatherCanvas() {

          if (!weatherCanvas) return;

          weatherCanvas.width = window.innerWidth || 1280;

          weatherCanvas.height = window.innerHeight || 800;

        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeWeatherCanvas);

        resizeWeatherCanvas();

 

        function createWeatherParticles() {

          weatherParticles = [];

          weatherSplashes = [];

          if (!weatherCanvas || activeWeatherMode === 'off') return;

 

          const w = weatherCanvas.width || window.innerWidth;

          const h = weatherCanvas.height || window.innerHeight;

          const factor = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(1, activeWeatherIntensity / 100));

 

          if (activeWeatherMode === 'snow') {

            const count = Math.round(45 + factor * 140);

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

              weatherParticles.push({

                x: Math.random() * w,

                y: Math.random() * h,

                r: 2 + Math.random() * 4.5,

                vy: 0.7 + Math.random() * 1.9 * (0.6 + factor * 0.6),

                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.9,

                swayAmp: 0.4 + Math.random() * 1.2,

                swaySpeed: 0.01 + Math.random() * 0.025,

                phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,

                alpha: 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.45

              });

            }

          } else if (activeWeatherMode === 'rain') {

            const count = Math.round(60 + factor * 180);

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

              weatherParticles.push({

                x: Math.random() * w,

                y: Math.random() * h,

                len: 14 + Math.random() * 20,

                vy: 11 + Math.random() * 10 * (0.7 + factor * 0.5),

                vx: -1.8 - Math.random() * 1.2,

                alpha: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.45,

                thickness: 1 + Math.random() * 1.2

              });

            }

          } else if (activeWeatherMode === 'sun') {

            const count = Math.round(25 + factor * 55);

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

              weatherParticles.push({

                x: Math.random() * w,

                y: Math.random() * h,

                r: 2 + Math.random() * 5,

                vy: -0.25 - Math.random() * 0.45,

                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,

                phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,

                alpha: 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.5

              });

            }

          }

        }

 

        function updateWeatherButtonsUI() {

          document.querySelectorAll('[data-weather-btn]').forEach((btn) => {

            const mode = btn.getAttribute('data-weather-btn');

            const isActive = mode === activeWeatherMode;

            if (isActive) {

              if (mode === 'sun') {

                btn.className =

                  'weather-mode-btn min-h-[34px] px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer fast-transition ring-2 ring-amber-300';

              } else if (mode === 'rain') {

                btn.className =

                  'weather-mode-btn min-h-[34px] px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold bg-sky-600 text-white shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer fast-transition ring-2 ring-sky-300';

              } else if (mode === 'snow') {

                btn.className =

                  'weather-mode-btn min-h-[34px] px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer fast-transition ring-2 ring-indigo-300';

              } else {

                btn.className =

                  'weather-mode-btn min-h-[34px] px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold bg-zinc-900 text-white shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer fast-transition';

              }

            } else {

              btn.className =

                'weather-mode-btn min-h-[34px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-zinc-700 hover:bg-white/80 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer fast-transition';

            }

          });

 

          if (toolbarWeatherSlider && Number(toolbarWeatherSlider.value) !== activeWeatherIntensity) {

            toolbarWeatherSlider.value = String(activeWeatherIntensity);

          }

          if (cpWeatherSlider && Number(cpWeatherSlider.value) !== activeWeatherIntensity) {

            cpWeatherSlider.value = String(activeWeatherIntensity);

          }

 

          if (weatherSunOverlay) {

            if (activeWeatherMode === 'sun') {

              weatherSunOverlay.classList.remove('opacity-0');

              weatherSunOverlay.classList.add('opacity-100');

            } else {

              weatherSunOverlay.classList.add('opacity-0');

              weatherSunOverlay.classList.remove('opacity-100');

            }

          }

 

          if (weatherAtmosphereTint) {

            if (activeWeatherMode === 'snow') {

              weatherAtmosphereTint.style.background =

                'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(186,230,253,0.22) 0%, rgba(224,242,254,0.08) 45%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%)';

            } else if (activeWeatherMode === 'rain') {

              weatherAtmosphereTint.style.background =

                'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(51,65,85,0.16) 0%, rgba(14,116,144,0.07) 55%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%)';

            } else if (activeWeatherMode === 'sun') {

              weatherAtmosphereTint.style.background =

                'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(251,191,36,0.14) 0%, rgba(254,243,199,0.06) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 100%)';

            } else {

              weatherAtmosphereTint.style.background = 'transparent';

            }

          }

        }

 

        function renderWeatherFrame() {

          if (!weatherCanvas) return;

          const ctx = weatherCanvas.getContext('2d');

          const w = weatherCanvas.width;

          const h = weatherCanvas.height;

          ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

 

          if (activeWeatherMode === 'off') {

            weatherAnimFrameId = null;

            return;

          }

 

          if (activeWeatherMode === 'snow') {

            for (let i = 0; i < weatherParticles.length; i++) {

              const p = weatherParticles[i];

              p.phase += p.swaySpeed;

              p.y += p.vy;

              p.x += p.vx + Math.sin(p.phase) * p.swayAmp;

 

              if (p.y > h + 12) {

                p.y = -10;

                p.x = Math.random() * w;

              }

              if (p.x > w + 12) p.x = -10;

              if (p.x < -12) p.x = w + 10;

 

              // Draw crisp snowflake with soft frosty halo so it is visible on light & dark backgrounds

              ctx.save();

              ctx.beginPath();

              const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0.5, p.x, p.y, p.r * 1.4);

              grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${p.alpha})`);

              grad.addColorStop(0.65, `rgba(224, 242, 254, ${p.alpha * 0.85})`);

              grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(56, 189, 248, 0)`);

              ctx.fillStyle = grad;

              ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);

              ctx.fill();

 

              // Subtle outline for visibility against white cards

              ctx.beginPath();

              ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * 0.75, 0, Math.PI * 2);

              ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${p.alpha})`;

              ctx.fill();

              ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;

              ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(125, 211, 252, ${p.alpha * 0.65})`;

              ctx.stroke();

              ctx.restore();

            }

          } else if (activeWeatherMode === 'rain') {

            ctx.save();

            ctx.lineCap = 'round';

            for (let i = 0; i < weatherParticles.length; i++) {

              const p = weatherParticles[i];

              p.x += p.vx;

              p.y += p.vy;

 

              ctx.beginPath();

              ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);

              ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.vx * 1.35, p.y + p.len);

              ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${p.alpha})`;

              ctx.lineWidth = p.thickness;

              ctx.stroke();

 

              if (p.y > h - 8) {

                if (Math.random() < 0.35 && weatherSplashes.length < 45) {

                  weatherSplashes.push({

                    x: p.x,

                    y: h - 4 - Math.random() * 10,

                    r: 1,

                    maxR: 6 + Math.random() * 8,

                    alpha: 0.55

                  });

                }

                p.y = -20;

                p.x = Math.random() * (w + 120);

              }

              if (p.x < -30) {

                p.x = w + 20;

              }

            }

 

            // Render raindrop splashes

            for (let j = weatherSplashes.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {

              const s = weatherSplashes[j];

              s.r += 0.55;

              s.alpha -= 0.035;

              if (s.alpha <= 0 || s.r >= s.maxR) {

                weatherSplashes.splice(j, 1);

                continue;

              }

              ctx.beginPath();

              ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, s.r * 1.6, s.r * 0.45, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

              ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56, 189, 248, ${s.alpha})`;

              ctx.lineWidth = 1;

              ctx.stroke();

            }

            ctx.restore();

          } else if (activeWeatherMode === 'sun') {

            for (let i = 0; i < weatherParticles.length; i++) {

              const p = weatherParticles[i];

              p.phase += 0.025;

              p.x += p.vx + Math.cos(p.phase) * 0.25;

              p.y += p.vy;

 

              if (p.y < -15) {

                p.y = h + 10;

                p.x = Math.random() * w;

              }

 

              const pulseAlpha = p.alpha * (0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(p.phase));

              const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0.5, p.x, p.y, p.r * 2.2);

              grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(254, 240, 138, ${pulseAlpha})`);

              grad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(251, 191, 36, ${pulseAlpha * 0.65})`);

              grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0)');

 

              ctx.beginPath();

              ctx.fillStyle = grad;

              ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);

              ctx.fill();

            }

          }

 

          weatherAnimFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(renderWeatherFrame);

        }

 

        function startOrStopWeatherLoop() {

          if (weatherAnimFrameId) {

            cancelAnimationFrame(weatherAnimFrameId);

            weatherAnimFrameId = null;

          }

          createWeatherParticles();

          updateWeatherButtonsUI();

          if (activeWeatherMode !== 'off') {

            weatherAnimFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(renderWeatherFrame);

          } else if (weatherCanvas) {

            const ctx = weatherCanvas.getContext('2d');

            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, weatherCanvas.width, weatherCanvas.height);

          }

        }

 

        function setWeatherMode(mode, shouldSave = true) {

          const validModes = ['sun', 'rain', 'snow', 'off'];

          activeWeatherMode = validModes.includes(mode) ? mode : 'off';

          storeSettings.weatherMode = activeWeatherMode;

          startOrStopWeatherLoop();

          if (shouldSave) {

            saveStateEverywhere();

            const labels = {

              sun: '☀️ ჩაირთო მზიანი ამინდი საიტზე!',

              rain: '🌧️ ჩაირთო წვიმის ეფექტი საიტზე!',

              snow: '❄️ ჩაირთო თოვლის ეფექტი საიტზე!',

              off: '🌤️ ამინდის ეფექტი გამოირთო.'

            };

            showCpToast(labels[activeWeatherMode] || 'ამინდი განახლდა!');

          }

        }

 

        function setWeatherIntensity(val, shouldSave = true) {

          activeWeatherIntensity = Math.max(15, Math.min(100, Number(val) || 65));

          storeSettings.weatherIntensity = activeWeatherIntensity;

          createWeatherParticles();

          updateWeatherButtonsUI();

          if (shouldSave) {

            saveStateEverywhere();

          }

        }

 

        function syncWeatherStateFromSettings() {

          const nextMode = storeSettings.weatherMode || 'snow';

          const nextInt = Number(storeSettings.weatherIntensity ?? 65);

          if (nextMode !== activeWeatherMode || nextInt !== activeWeatherIntensity || !weatherAnimFrameId) {

            activeWeatherMode = nextMode;

            activeWeatherIntensity = nextInt;

            startOrStopWeatherLoop();

          } else {

            updateWeatherButtonsUI();

          }

        }

 

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          const weatherBtn = e.target.closest('[data-weather-btn]');

          if (weatherBtn) {

            const mode = weatherBtn.getAttribute('data-weather-btn');

            setWeatherMode(mode, true);

          }

        });

 

        if (toolbarWeatherSlider) {

          toolbarWeatherSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {

            setWeatherIntensity(e.target.value, true);

          });

        }

        if (cpWeatherSlider) {

          cpWeatherSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {

            setWeatherIntensity(e.target.value, true);

          });

        }

 

        // =========================================================================

        // LIVE ON-PAGE VISUAL TEXT EDITOR (✏️ ტექსტების ხელით ჩასწორება პირდაპირ საიტზე)

        // =========================================================================

        let isLiveVisualEditActive = false;

        const toggleLiveEditBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-live-edit-btn');

        const toggleLiveEditLabel = document.getElementById('toggle-live-edit-label');

        const cpEnableVisualEditBtn = document.getElementById('cp-enable-visual-edit-from-panel-btn');

 

        const LIVE_EDITABLE_MAP = [

          { id: 'header-brand-name', key: 'brandName' },

          { id: 'footer-brand-name', key: 'brandName' },

          { id: 'nav-link-catalog', key: 'navCatalog' },

          { id: 'nav-link-karaoke', key: 'navKaraoke' },

          { id: 'nav-link-solar', key: 'navSolar' },

          { id: 'nav-link-service', key: 'navService' },

          { id: 'catalog-heading-title', key: 'catalogTitle' },

          { id: 'home-chat-title', key: 'chatTitle' },

          { id: 'home-chat-subtitle', key: 'chatSubtitle' },

          { id: 'serv-1-tag', key: 'serv1Tag' },

          { id: 'serv-1-title', key: 'serv1Title' },

          { id: 'serv-1-desc', key: 'serv1Desc' },

          { id: 'serv-2-tag', key: 'serv2Tag' },

          { id: 'serv-2-title', key: 'serv2Title' },

          { id: 'serv-2-desc', key: 'serv2Desc' },

          { id: 'serv-3-tag', key: 'serv3Tag' },

          { id: 'serv-3-title', key: 'serv3Title' },

          { id: 'serv-3-desc', key: 'serv3Desc' },

          { id: 'fb-banner-title', key: 'fbBannerTitle' },

          { id: 'fb-banner-subtitle', key: 'fbBannerSubtitle' },

          { id: 'fb-banner-btn-text', key: 'fbBannerBtn' },

          { id: 'footer-tagline-text', key: 'footerTagline' }

        ];

 

        function setLiveVisualEditMode(enable) {

          isLiveVisualEditActive = Boolean(enable);

 

          if (toggleLiveEditBtn && toggleLiveEditLabel) {

            if (isLiveVisualEditActive) {

              toggleLiveEditBtn.className =

                'min-h-[38px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-zinc-950 border border-amber-600 text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-sm ring-2 ring-amber-300 fast-transition';

              toggleLiveEditLabel.textContent = '✅ ჩასწორების დასრულება (შენახულია)';

            } else {

              toggleLiveEditBtn.className =

                'min-h-[38px] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-950 border border-amber-300 text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer fast-transition';

              toggleLiveEditLabel.textContent = 'ტექსტების ხელით ჩასწორება';

            }

          }

 

          LIVE_EDITABLE_MAP.forEach(({ id, key }) => {

            const el = document.getElementById(id);

            if (!el) return;

            if (isLiveVisualEditActive) {

              el.setAttribute('contenteditable', 'true');

              el.classList.add(

                'outline-2',

                'outline-dashed',

                'outline-amber-500',

                'bg-amber-50/70',

                'text-zinc-950',

                'rounded-lg',

                'px-1.5',

                'cursor-text'

              );

              if (!el.dataset.boundLiveEdit) {

                el.dataset.boundLiveEdit = '1';

                el.addEventListener('input', () => {

                  const val = el.textContent.trim();

                  if (val) {

                    storeSettings[key] = val;

                    saveStateEverywhere();

                  }

                });

                el.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {

                  if (isLiveVisualEditActive) {

                    ev.preventDefault();

                    ev.stopPropagation();

                  }

                });

              }

            } else {

              el.removeAttribute('contenteditable');

              el.classList.remove(

                'outline-2',

                'outline-dashed',

                'outline-amber-500',

                'bg-amber-50/70',

                'text-zinc-950',

                'rounded-lg',

                'px-1.5',

                'cursor-text'

              );

            }

          });

 

          if (!isLiveVisualEditActive) {

            applyStoreSettingsToDOM();

          }

        }

 

        if (toggleLiveEditBtn) {

          toggleLiveEditBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            setLiveVisualEditMode(!isLiveVisualEditActive);

          });

        }

 

        if (cpEnableVisualEditBtn) {

          cpEnableVisualEditBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            closeControlPanel();

            setLiveVisualEditMode(true);

            showCpToast('დააწკაპუნეთ ნებისმიერ მონიშნულ წარწერაზე საიტზე და შეცვალეთ ტექსტი ხელით!');

          });

        }

 

        // =========================================================================

        // MANUAL DRAG & REORDER ENGINE FOR ALL SECTIONS, BOXES & PRODUCT CARDS

        // ("გრაფების ხელით გადაადგილება")

        // =========================================================================

        let isMoveBlocksModeActive = false;

        const toggleMoveBlocksBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-move-blocks-btn');

        const moveBlocksBtnLabel = document.getElementById('move-blocks-btn-label');

        const resetBlocksLayoutBtn = document.getElementById('reset-blocks-layout-btn');

        const moveModeHelperBanner = document.getElementById('move-mode-helper-banner');

        const bannerResetLayoutBtn = document.getElementById('banner-reset-layout-btn');

        const bannerFinishMoveBtn = document.getElementById('banner-finish-move-btn');

        const cpEnableMoveModeBtn = document.getElementById('cp-enable-move-mode-btn');

        const cpResetLayoutOrderBtn = document.getElementById('cp-reset-layout-order-btn');

 

        const HOME_BLOCK_TITLES = {

          'fb-banner': '1. Facebook გვერდის გრაფა',

          'catalog-header': '2. კატალოგის სათაურის გრაფა',

          'product-grid': '3. პროდუქციის კატალოგის გრაფა',

          'service-standards': '4. მიწოდების და გარანტიის გრაფა'

        };

 

        function ensureLayoutSettingsArrays() {

          if (!Array.isArray(storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder) || storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder.length === 0) {

            storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder = [...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.homeBlocksOrder];

          }

          storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder = storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder.filter((key) => key !== 'home-chat');

          DEFAULT_SETTINGS.homeBlocksOrder.forEach((key) => {

            if (!storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder.includes(key)) {

              storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder.push(key);

            }

          });

 

          if (!Array.isArray(storeSettings.modalBlocksOrder) || storeSettings.modalBlocksOrder.length === 0) {

            storeSettings.modalBlocksOrder = [...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.modalBlocksOrder];

          }

          DEFAULT_SETTINGS.modalBlocksOrder.forEach((key) => {

            if (!storeSettings.modalBlocksOrder.includes(key)) {

              storeSettings.modalBlocksOrder.push(key);

            }

          });

 

          if (!Array.isArray(storeSettings.serviceCardsOrder) || storeSettings.serviceCardsOrder.length === 0) {

            storeSettings.serviceCardsOrder = [...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serviceCardsOrder];

          }

          DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serviceCardsOrder.forEach((key) => {

            if (!storeSettings.serviceCardsOrder.includes(key)) {

              storeSettings.serviceCardsOrder.push(key);

            }

          });

 

          if (!storeSettings.blockOffsets || typeof storeSettings.blockOffsets !== 'object') {

            storeSettings.blockOffsets = {};

          }

        }

 

        function applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets() {

          ensureLayoutSettingsArrays();

 

          // 1. Reorder Home Sections

          const homeContainer = document.getElementById('home-movable-sections-container');

          if (homeContainer) {

            storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder.forEach((blockKey) => {

              const el = homeContainer.querySelector(`[data-home-block="${blockKey}"]`);

              if (el) homeContainer.appendChild(el);

            });

          }

 

          // 2. Reorder Service Cards

          const serviceGrid = document.getElementById('service-cards-grid');

          if (serviceGrid) {

            storeSettings.serviceCardsOrder.forEach((cardKey) => {

              const el = serviceGrid.querySelector(`[data-service-card="${cardKey}"]`);

              if (el) serviceGrid.appendChild(el);

            });

          }

 

          // 3. Reorder Product Detail Modal Sections

          const modalContainer = document.getElementById('modal-movable-sections-container');

          if (modalContainer) {

            storeSettings.modalBlocksOrder.forEach((blockKey) => {

              const el = modalContainer.querySelector(`[data-modal-block="${blockKey}"]`);

              if (el) modalContainer.appendChild(el);

            });

          }

 

          // 4. Apply any free X/Y drag offsets

          document.querySelectorAll('[data-home-block], [data-modal-block], [data-service-card]').forEach((el) => {

            const key =

              el.getAttribute('data-home-block') ||

              el.getAttribute('data-modal-block') ||

              el.getAttribute('data-service-card');

            const off = key && storeSettings.blockOffsets ? storeSettings.blockOffsets[key] : null;

            if (off && (Number(off.x) || Number(off.y))) {

              el.style.transform = `translate(${Number(off.x) || 0}px, ${Number(off.y) || 0}px)`;

              el.style.position = 'relative';

              el.style.zIndex = '15';

            } else {

              el.style.transform = '';

              el.style.zIndex = '';

            }

          });

 

          renderMoveHandlesOnAllBlocks();

          renderCpHomeBlocksOrderList();

        }
