        function moveArrayElement(arr, index, direction) {

          const targetIdx = index + direction;

          if (targetIdx < 0 || targetIdx >= arr.length) return false;

          const temp = arr[index];

          arr[index] = arr[targetIdx];

          arr[targetIdx] = temp;

          return true;

        }

 

        function moveBlockByKey(groupType, blockKey, direction) {

          ensureLayoutSettingsArrays();

          let arr = null;

          if (groupType === 'home') arr = storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder;

          else if (groupType === 'modal') arr = storeSettings.modalBlocksOrder;

          else if (groupType === 'service') arr = storeSettings.serviceCardsOrder;

          if (!arr) return;

 

          const idx = arr.indexOf(blockKey);

          if (idx === -1) return;

          if (moveArrayElement(arr, idx, direction)) {

            applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets();

            saveStateEverywhere();

          }

        }

 

        function nudgeBlockOffset(blockKey, dx, dy) {

          ensureLayoutSettingsArrays();

          const cur = storeSettings.blockOffsets[blockKey] || { x: 0, y: 0 };

          storeSettings.blockOffsets[blockKey] = {

            x: Math.round((Number(cur.x) || 0) + dx),

            y: Math.round((Number(cur.y) || 0) + dy)

          };

          applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets();

          saveStateEverywhere();

        }

 

        function resetSingleBlockOffset(blockKey) {

          ensureLayoutSettingsArrays();

          if (storeSettings.blockOffsets && storeSettings.blockOffsets[blockKey]) {

            delete storeSettings.blockOffsets[blockKey];

            applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets();

            saveStateEverywhere();

          }

        }

 

        function resetAllLayoutOrderAndOffsets() {

          storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder = [...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.homeBlocksOrder];

          storeSettings.modalBlocksOrder = [...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.modalBlocksOrder];

          storeSettings.serviceCardsOrder = [...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.serviceCardsOrder];

          storeSettings.blockOffsets = {};

          applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets();

          saveStateEverywhere();

          showCpToast('ყველა გრაფა დაუბრუნდა საწყის განლაგებას!');

        }

 

        function renderCpHomeBlocksOrderList() {

          const listEl = document.getElementById('cp-home-blocks-order-list');

          if (!listEl) return;

          ensureLayoutSettingsArrays();

          listEl.innerHTML = storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder

            .map((key, idx) => {

              const title = HOME_BLOCK_TITLES[key] || key;

              return `

                <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-indigo-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between gap-2">

                  <div class="text-xs font-extrabold text-zinc-900 leading-snug">

                    <span class="inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-900 font-mono-num mr-1">#${idx + 1}</span>

                    ${title}

                  </div>

                  <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 pt-1 border-t border-zinc-100">

                    <button

                      type="button"

                      data-cp-block-move="${key}"

                      data-cp-block-dir="-1"

                      class="flex-1 py-1 px-2 rounded-lg bg-stone-100 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-zinc-800 text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer"

                      title="წინ / ზემოთ გადაწევა"

                    >⬆️ ზემოთ</button>

                    <button

                      type="button"

                      data-cp-block-move="${key}"

                      data-cp-block-dir="1"

                      class="flex-1 py-1 px-2 rounded-lg bg-stone-100 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-zinc-800 text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer"

                      title="უკან / ქვემოთ გადაწევა"

                    >⬇️ ქვემოთ</button>

                  </div>

                </div>

              `;

            })

            .join('');

        }

 

        const cpHomeBlocksListEl = document.getElementById('cp-home-blocks-order-list');

        if (cpHomeBlocksListEl) {

          cpHomeBlocksListEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

            const btn = e.target.closest('[data-cp-block-move]');

            if (!btn) return;

            const key = btn.getAttribute('data-cp-block-move');

            const dir = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-cp-block-dir')) || 0;

            if (key && dir) {

              moveBlockByKey('home', key, dir);

              showCpToast('გრაფის ადგილი განახლდა!');

            }

          });

        }

 

        function renderMoveHandlesOnAllBlocks() {

          // Remove existing injected handles first

          document.querySelectorAll('.injected-block-move-toolbar').forEach((el) => el.remove());

 

          const allBlocks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-home-block], [data-modal-block], [data-service-card]');

          allBlocks.forEach((blockEl) => {

            const groupType = blockEl.hasAttribute('data-home-block')

              ? 'home'

              : blockEl.hasAttribute('data-modal-block')

              ? 'modal'

              : 'service';

            const blockKey =

              blockEl.getAttribute('data-home-block') ||

              blockEl.getAttribute('data-modal-block') ||

              blockEl.getAttribute('data-service-card');

            const label = blockEl.getAttribute('data-block-label') || blockKey;

 

            if (!isMoveBlocksModeActive) {

              blockEl.removeAttribute('draggable');

              blockEl.classList.remove(

                'ring-2',

                'ring-indigo-500',

                'ring-offset-2',

                'transition-transform'

              );

              return;

            }

 

            blockEl.setAttribute('draggable', 'true');

            blockEl.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-indigo-500', 'ring-offset-2');

 

            const bar = document.createElement('div');

            bar.className =

              'injected-block-move-toolbar mb-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-950 text-white text-xs font-bold flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 shadow-md select-none cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing z-20';

            bar.setAttribute('data-free-drag-handle', blockKey);

            bar.innerHTML = `

              <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">

                <span class="text-sm">⠿</span>

                <span class="font-extrabold text-amber-300">${label}</span>

                <span class="hidden sm:inline text-[11px] text-indigo-200">(მოკიდეთ მაუსი/თითი და გადაადგილეთ)</span>

              </div>

              <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">

                <button type="button" data-move-act="order" data-move-group="${groupType}" data-move-key="${blockKey}" data-move-dir="-1" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-indigo-800 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-[11px] font-extrabold cursor-pointer" title="რიგითობით ზემოთ / მარცხნივ">⬆️ ზემოთ</button>

                <button type="button" data-move-act="order" data-move-group="${groupType}" data-move-key="${blockKey}" data-move-dir="1" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-indigo-800 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-[11px] font-extrabold cursor-pointer" title="რიგითობით ქვემოთ / მარჯვნივ">⬇️ ქვემოთ</button>

                <span class="mx-0.5 opacity-40">|</span>

                <button type="button" data-move-act="nudge" data-move-key="${blockKey}" data-dx="-20" data-dy="0" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer" title="მარცხნივ გაწევა">⬅️</button>

                <button type="button" data-move-act="nudge" data-move-key="${blockKey}" data-dx="20" data-dy="0" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer" title="მარჯვნივ გაწევა">➡️</button>

                <button type="button" data-move-act="nudge" data-move-key="${blockKey}" data-dx="0" data-dy="-20" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer" title="ზემოთ აწევა">⬆️</button>

                <button type="button" data-move-act="nudge" data-move-key="${blockKey}" data-dx="0" data-dy="20" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer" title="ქვემოთ ჩამოწევა">⬇️</button>

                <button type="button" data-move-act="reset-one" data-move-key="${blockKey}" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-600 text-white text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer" title="ამ გრაფის საწყის პოზიციაზე დაბრუნება">↺</button>

              </div>

            `;

            blockEl.insertBefore(bar, blockEl.firstChild);

          });

 

          // Also add move controls on Product Cards when Move Mode is active

          document.querySelectorAll('.injected-card-move-bar').forEach((el) => el.remove());

          document.querySelectorAll('#product-grid [data-product-id]').forEach((cardEl) => {

            const prodId = cardEl.getAttribute('data-product-id');

            if (!isMoveBlocksModeActive) {

              cardEl.removeAttribute('draggable');

              cardEl.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-indigo-500');

              return;

            }

            cardEl.setAttribute('draggable', 'true');

            cardEl.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-indigo-500');

            const cBar = document.createElement('div');

            cBar.className =

              'injected-card-move-bar px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-950 text-white text-[11px] font-extrabold flex items-center justify-between gap-1 border-b border-indigo-800 cursor-grab';

            cBar.innerHTML = `

              <span>⠿ გადაადგილეთ პროდუქტი</span>

              <div class="flex items-center gap-1">

                <button type="button" data-card-move-id="${prodId}" data-card-move-dir="-1" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold cursor-pointer">⬅️ წინ</button>

                <button type="button" data-card-move-id="${prodId}" data-card-move-dir="1" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold cursor-pointer">უკან ➡️</button>

              </div>

            `;

            cardEl.insertBefore(cBar, cardEl.firstChild);

          });

        }

 

        function setMoveBlocksMode(enable) {

          isMoveBlocksModeActive = Boolean(enable);

 

          if (toggleMoveBlocksBtn && moveBlocksBtnLabel) {

            if (isMoveBlocksModeActive) {

              toggleMoveBlocksBtn.className =

                'min-h-[36px] px-3 py-1 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white border border-indigo-700 text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm ring-2 ring-indigo-300 cursor-pointer fast-transition';

              moveBlocksBtnLabel.textContent = '✅ გრაფების გადაადგილება: ჩართულია (დასრულება)';

            } else {

              toggleMoveBlocksBtn.className =

                'min-h-[36px] px-3 py-1 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-950 border border-indigo-300 text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer fast-transition';

              moveBlocksBtnLabel.textContent = 'გრაფების ხელით გადაადგილება: გამორთულია';

            }

          }

 

          if (resetBlocksLayoutBtn) {

            if (isMoveBlocksModeActive) {

              resetBlocksLayoutBtn.classList.remove('hidden');

              resetBlocksLayoutBtn.classList.add('inline-flex');

            } else {

              resetBlocksLayoutBtn.classList.add('hidden');

              resetBlocksLayoutBtn.classList.remove('inline-flex');

            }

          }

 

          if (moveModeHelperBanner) {

            if (isMoveBlocksModeActive) {

              moveModeHelperBanner.classList.remove('hidden');

            } else {

              moveModeHelperBanner.classList.add('hidden');

            }

          }

 

          renderMoveHandlesOnAllBlocks();

        }

 

        if (toggleMoveBlocksBtn) {

          toggleMoveBlocksBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            setMoveBlocksMode(!isMoveBlocksModeActive);

          });

        }

        if (bannerFinishMoveBtn) {

          bannerFinishMoveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            setMoveBlocksMode(false);

          });

        }

        if (resetBlocksLayoutBtn) {

          resetBlocksLayoutBtn.addEventListener('click', resetAllLayoutOrderAndOffsets);

        }

        if (bannerResetLayoutBtn) {

          bannerResetLayoutBtn.addEventListener('click', resetAllLayoutOrderAndOffsets);

        }

        if (cpResetLayoutOrderBtn) {

          cpResetLayoutOrderBtn.addEventListener('click', resetAllLayoutOrderAndOffsets);

        }

        if (cpEnableMoveModeBtn) {

          cpEnableMoveModeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

            closeControlPanel();

            setMoveBlocksMode(true);

          });

        }

 

        // Handle clicks on injected move toolbars (Up/Down/Left/Right/Reset & Product Card Move)

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

          const moveActBtn = e.target.closest('[data-move-act]');

          if (moveActBtn) {

            e.preventDefault();

            e.stopPropagation();

            const act = moveActBtn.getAttribute('data-move-act');

            const key = moveActBtn.getAttribute('data-move-key');

            if (act === 'order') {

              const group = moveActBtn.getAttribute('data-move-group');

              const dir = Number(moveActBtn.getAttribute('data-move-dir')) || 0;

              moveBlockByKey(group, key, dir);

            } else if (act === 'nudge') {

              const dx = Number(moveActBtn.getAttribute('data-dx')) || 0;

              const dy = Number(moveActBtn.getAttribute('data-dy')) || 0;

              nudgeBlockOffset(key, dx, dy);

            } else if (act === 'reset-one') {

              resetSingleBlockOffset(key);

            }

            return;

          }

 

          const cardMoveBtn = e.target.closest('[data-card-move-id]');

          if (cardMoveBtn) {

            e.preventDefault();

            e.stopPropagation();

            const prodId = cardMoveBtn.getAttribute('data-card-move-id');

            const dir = Number(cardMoveBtn.getAttribute('data-card-move-dir')) || 0;

            const idx = productsList.findIndex((p) => p.id === prodId);

            if (idx !== -1 && moveArrayElement(productsList, idx, dir)) {

              saveStateEverywhere();

              preserveScroll(() => renderProducts());

              renderMoveHandlesOnAllBlocks();

            }

          }

        });

 

        // HTML5 Drag-and-Drop Reordering for Home Blocks, Modal Blocks, Service Cards & Product Cards

        let draggedItemInfo = null;

 

        document.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {

          if (!isMoveBlocksModeActive) return;

          const prodCard = e.target.closest('#product-grid [data-product-id]');

          if (prodCard) {

            draggedItemInfo = { type: 'product', key: prodCard.getAttribute('data-product-id') };

            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';

            return;

          }

          const servCard = e.target.closest('[data-service-card]');

          if (servCard) {

            draggedItemInfo = { type: 'service', key: servCard.getAttribute('data-service-card') };

            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';

            return;

          }

          const modalBlock = e.target.closest('[data-modal-block]');

          if (modalBlock) {

            draggedItemInfo = { type: 'modal', key: modalBlock.getAttribute('data-modal-block') };

            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';

            return;

          }

          const homeBlock = e.target.closest('[data-home-block]');

          if (homeBlock) {

            draggedItemInfo = { type: 'home', key: homeBlock.getAttribute('data-home-block') };

            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';

          }

        });

 

        document.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => {

          if (!isMoveBlocksModeActive || !draggedItemInfo) return;

          e.preventDefault();

          e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';

        });

 

        document.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {

          if (!isMoveBlocksModeActive || !draggedItemInfo) return;

          e.preventDefault();

 

          if (draggedItemInfo.type === 'product') {

            const targetCard = e.target.closest('#product-grid [data-product-id]');

            if (targetCard) {

              const targetId = targetCard.getAttribute('data-product-id');

              const fromIdx = productsList.findIndex((p) => p.id === draggedItemInfo.key);

              const toIdx = productsList.findIndex((p) => p.id === targetId);

              if (fromIdx !== -1 && toIdx !== -1 && fromIdx !== toIdx) {

                const [moved] = productsList.splice(fromIdx, 1);

                productsList.splice(toIdx, 0, moved);

                saveStateEverywhere();

                preserveScroll(() => renderProducts());

                renderMoveHandlesOnAllBlocks();

              }

            }

          } else if (draggedItemInfo.type === 'home') {

            const targetBlock = e.target.closest('[data-home-block]');

            if (targetBlock) {

              const targetKey = targetBlock.getAttribute('data-home-block');

              ensureLayoutSettingsArrays();

              const arr = storeSettings.homeBlocksOrder;

              const fromIdx = arr.indexOf(draggedItemInfo.key);

              const toIdx = arr.indexOf(targetKey);

              if (fromIdx !== -1 && toIdx !== -1 && fromIdx !== toIdx) {

                const [moved] = arr.splice(fromIdx, 1);

                arr.splice(toIdx, 0, moved);

                applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets();

                saveStateEverywhere();

              }

            }

          } else if (draggedItemInfo.type === 'modal') {

            const targetBlock = e.target.closest('[data-modal-block]');

            if (targetBlock) {

              const targetKey = targetBlock.getAttribute('data-modal-block');

              ensureLayoutSettingsArrays();

              const arr = storeSettings.modalBlocksOrder;

              const fromIdx = arr.indexOf(draggedItemInfo.key);

              const toIdx = arr.indexOf(targetKey);

              if (fromIdx !== -1 && toIdx !== -1 && fromIdx !== toIdx) {

                const [moved] = arr.splice(fromIdx, 1);

                arr.splice(toIdx, 0, moved);

                applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets();

                saveStateEverywhere();

              }

            }

          } else if (draggedItemInfo.type === 'service') {

            const targetCard = e.target.closest('[data-service-card]');

            if (targetCard) {

              const targetKey = targetCard.getAttribute('data-service-card');

              ensureLayoutSettingsArrays();

              const arr = storeSettings.serviceCardsOrder;

              const fromIdx = arr.indexOf(draggedItemInfo.key);

              const toIdx = arr.indexOf(targetKey);

              if (fromIdx !== -1 && toIdx !== -1 && fromIdx !== toIdx) {

                const [moved] = arr.splice(fromIdx, 1);

                arr.splice(toIdx, 0, moved);

                applySavedLayoutOrderAndOffsets();

                saveStateEverywhere();

              }

            }

          }

 

          draggedItemInfo = null;

        });

 

        // Pointer / Touch Free-Drag on [data-free-drag-handle] so mobile & desktop users can also freely drag boxes

        let activePointerDrag = null;

        document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {

          if (!isMoveBlocksModeActive) return;

          if (e.target.closest('button')) return;

          const handle = e.target.closest('[data-free-drag-handle]');

          if (!handle) return;

          const blockKey = handle.getAttribute('data-free-drag-handle');

          const blockEl = handle.parentElement;

          if (!blockKey || !blockEl) return;

 

          ensureLayoutSettingsArrays();

          const cur = storeSettings.blockOffsets[blockKey] || { x: 0, y: 0 };

          activePointerDrag = {

            blockKey,

            blockEl,

            startX: e.clientX,

            startY: e.clientY,

            origX: Number(cur.x) || 0,

            origY: Number(cur.y) || 0,

            moved: false

          };

        });

 

        document.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {

          if (!activePointerDrag) return;

          const dx = e.clientX - activePointerDrag.startX;

          const dy = e.clientY - activePointerDrag.startY;

          if (Math.abs(dx) > 4 || Math.abs(dy) > 4) {

            activePointerDrag.moved = true;

          }

          if (!activePointerDrag.moved) return;

          const nx = Math.round(activePointerDrag.origX + dx);

          const ny = Math.round(activePointerDrag.origY + dy);

          activePointerDrag.blockEl.style.transform = `translate(${nx}px, ${ny}px)`;

          activePointerDrag.blockEl.style.position = 'relative';

          activePointerDrag.blockEl.style.zIndex = '25';

          storeSettings.blockOffsets[activePointerDrag.blockKey] = { x: nx, y: ny };

        });

 

        document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {

          if (!activePointerDrag) return;

          if (activePointerDrag.moved) {

            saveStateEverywhere();

          }

          activePointerDrag = null;

        });

 

        // =========================================================================

        // REAL-TIME CLOCK, TODAY'S LIVE DATE & OPEN-METEO WEATHER ENGINE IN CELSIUS

        // =========================================================================

        const DATE_LOCALIZATION = {

          ka: {

          82: { icon: '⛈️', ka: 'ძლიერი თავსხმა', en: 'Violent showers', ru: 'Сильный ливень' },

        const GEORGIAN_CITIES = {

        let activeCityChoice = 'tbilisi';

        function updateLiveDateTime() {

          const now = new Date();

          const lang = DATE_LOCALIZATION[currentLang] ? currentLang : 'ka';

          const loc = DATE_LOCALIZATION[lang];

 

          const dayOfWeek = loc.days[now.getDay()];

          const dayNum = now.getDate();

          const monthName = loc.months[now.getMonth()];

          const yearNum = now.getFullYear();

 

          const weekdayEl = document.getElementById('live-weekday');

          const dateEl = document.getElementById('live-date');

          const clockEl = document.getElementById('live-clock');

 

          if (weekdayEl) weekdayEl.textContent = dayOfWeek;

          if (dateEl) {

            if (lang === 'en') {

              dateEl.textContent = `${monthName} ${dayNum}, ${yearNum}`;

            } else if (lang === 'ru') {

              dateEl.textContent = `${dayNum} ${monthName} ${yearNum} г.`;

            } else {

              dateEl.textContent = `${dayNum} ${monthName} ${yearNum}`;

            }

          }

 

          if (clockEl) {

            const hh = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');

            const mm = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');

            const ss = String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');

            clockEl.textContent = `${hh}:${mm}:${ss}`;

          }

        }

 

        function renderWeatherDisplay() {

          const tempEl = document.getElementById('live-weather-temp');

          const iconEl = document.getElementById('live-weather-icon');

          const cityEl = document.getElementById('live-weather-city');

          const descEl = document.getElementById('live-weather-desc');

          const detailsEl = document.getElementById('live-weather-details');

          const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

 

          // City button highlight

          document.querySelectorAll('.weather-city-btn').forEach((btn) => {

            const choice = btn.getAttribute('data-city-choice');

            if (!customGeoCoords && choice === activeCityChoice) {

              btn.className = 'weather-city-btn min-h-[34px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-amber-500/25 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/50 shadow-sm active:scale-95 fast-transition cursor-pointer';

            } else {

              btn.className = 'weather-city-btn min-h-[34px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-800 active:scale-95 fast-transition cursor-pointer';

            }

          });

 

          const geoBtn = document.getElementById('weather-geo-btn');

          if (geoBtn) {

            if (customGeoCoords) {

              geoBtn.className = 'min-h-[34px] px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500/25 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/50 shadow-sm active:scale-95 fast-transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1';

            } else {

              geoBtn.className = 'min-h-[34px] px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-800 active:scale-95 fast-transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1';

            }

          }

 

          let cityName = '';

          if (customGeoCoords) {

            cityName = customGeoCoords.label || strings.weatherGeoBtn;

          } else {

            const cityObj = GEORGIAN_CITIES[activeCityChoice] || GEORGIAN_CITIES.tbilisi;

            cityName = cityObj[currentLang] || cityObj.ka;

          }

          if (cityEl) cityEl.textContent = cityName;

 

          if (!cachedWeatherData) {

            if (tempEl) tempEl.textContent = '--°C';

            if (descEl) descEl.textContent = strings.weatherLoading;

            return;

          }

 

          const { temp, code, wind, tempMax, tempMin } = cachedWeatherData;

 

          // Format Celsius temperature

          const roundedTemp = Math.round(temp);

          const tempDisplay = roundedTemp > 0 ? `+${roundedTemp}°C` : `${roundedTemp}°C`;

          if (tempEl) tempEl.textContent = tempDisplay;

 

          // Condition info

          const cond = WEATHER_CODE_MAP[code] || { icon: '🌤️', ka: 'ნაწილობრივ ღრუბლიანი', en: 'Partly cloudy', ru: 'Облачно' };

          if (iconEl) iconEl.textContent = cond.icon;

          if (descEl) descEl.textContent = cond[currentLang] || cond.ka;

 

          // Details: wind and daily range

          if (detailsEl) {

            const windPart = `${strings.weatherWindLabel}: ${Math.round(wind)} ${strings.weatherKmH}`;

            const rangePart = (tempMin != null && tempMax != null)

              ? ` · ${Math.round(tempMin)}° / ${Math.round(tempMax)}°C`

              : '';

            detailsEl.textContent = `· ${windPart}${rangePart}`;

          }

        }

 

        async function fetchLiveWeather(force = false) {

          if (isFetchingWeather) return;

          const refreshBtn = document.getElementById('weather-refresh-btn');

          if (refreshBtn) refreshBtn.classList.add('animate-spin');

 

          let lat = 41.7151;

          let lon = 44.8271;

          let storageKey = `vv_weather_${activeCityChoice}`;

 

          if (customGeoCoords) {

            lat = customGeoCoords.lat;

            lon = customGeoCoords.lon;

            storageKey = `vv_weather_geo_${lat.toFixed(2)}_${lon.toFixed(2)}`;

          } else {

            const cityObj = GEORGIAN_CITIES[activeCityChoice] || GEORGIAN_CITIES.tbilisi;

            lat = cityObj.lat;

            lon = cityObj.lon;

          }

 

          // Check 15-minute sessionStorage cache

          if (!force) {

            try {

              const cached = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey);

              if (cached) {

                const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);

                if (parsed && Date.now() - parsed.timestamp < 15 * 60 * 1000) {

                  cachedWeatherData = parsed.data;

                  renderWeatherDisplay();

                  if (refreshBtn) refreshBtn.classList.remove('animate-spin');

                  return;

                }

              }

            } catch (e) {}

          }

 

          isFetchingWeather = true;

          renderWeatherDisplay();

 

          try {

            const url = `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${lat}&longitude=${lon}&current_weather=true&daily=temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min&timezone=auto`;

            const res = await fetch(url);

            if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Weather fetch status: ${res.status}`);

            const data = await res.json();

 

            if (data && data.current_weather) {

              const temp = data.current_weather.temperature;

              const code = data.current_weather.weathercode;

              const wind = data.current_weather.windspeed;

              let tempMax = null;

              let tempMin = null;

              if (data.daily && Array.isArray(data.daily.temperature_2m_max) && data.daily.temperature_2m_max.length > 0) {

                tempMax = data.daily.temperature_2m_max[0];

                tempMin = data.daily.temperature_2m_min[0];

              }

 

              cachedWeatherData = { temp, code, wind, tempMax, tempMin };

              try {

                sessionStorage.setItem(

                  storageKey,

                  JSON.stringify({ timestamp: Date.now(), data: cachedWeatherData })

                );

              } catch (e) {}

 

              renderWeatherDisplay();

            }

          } catch (err) {

            console.warn('Live weather fetch error:', err);

            // Fallback realistic spring/autumn weather for Georgia if client is offline

            if (!cachedWeatherData) {

              cachedWeatherData = { temp: 18, code: 0, wind: 10, tempMax: 21, tempMin: 12 };

              renderWeatherDisplay();

            }

          } finally {

            isFetchingWeather = false;

            if (refreshBtn) {

              setTimeout(() => refreshBtn.classList.remove('animate-spin'), 300);

            }

          }

        }

 

        function initLiveInfoWidgets() {

          updateLiveDateTime();

          setInterval(updateLiveDateTime, 1000);

 

          // City button clicks

          document.querySelectorAll('[data-city-choice]').forEach((btn) => {

            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {

              const choice = btn.getAttribute('data-city-choice');

              if (choice && GEORGIAN_CITIES[choice]) {

                activeCityChoice = choice;

                customGeoCoords = null;

                cachedWeatherData = null;

                fetchLiveWeather(true);

              }

            });

          });

 

          // Refresh button

          const refreshBtn = document.getElementById('weather-refresh-btn');

          if (refreshBtn) {

            refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', () => fetchLiveWeather(true));

          }

 

          // Browser Geolocation button

          const geoBtn = document.getElementById('weather-geo-btn');

          if (geoBtn) {

            geoBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

              if (!navigator.geolocation) {

                alert(currentLang === 'en' ? 'Geolocation is not supported by your browser' : (currentLang === 'ru' ? 'Геолокация не поддерживается вашим браузером' : 'გეოლოკაცია არ არის მხარდაჭერილი თქვენს ბრაუზერში'));

                return;

              }

              const strings = UI_STRINGS[currentLang] || UI_STRINGS.ka;

              const geoBtnText = document.getElementById('weather-geo-btn-text');

              if (geoBtnText) geoBtnText.textContent = '...';

 

              navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(

                (pos) => {

                  customGeoCoords = {

                    lat: pos.coords.latitude,

                    lon: pos.coords.longitude,

                    label: strings.weatherGeoBtn

                  };

                  cachedWeatherData = null;

                  fetchLiveWeather(true);

                },

                (err) => {

                  console.warn('Geolocation denied or failed:', err);

                  if (geoBtnText) geoBtnText.textContent = strings.weatherGeoBtn;

                },

                { timeout: 8000 }

              );

            });

          }

 

          // Initial weather fetch

          fetchLiveWeather(false);

        }

 

        bindChatWidgetEvents('home');

        bindChatWidgetEvents('modal');

        renderAllChatWidgets();

        fetchChatStateFromServer();

        connectChatWebSocket();

 

        // Initial Boot

        resetProductForm();

        applyLanguageToDOM();

        applyStoreSettingsToDOM();

        applyThemeColor(activeThemeColor, null, false);

        syncWeatherStateFromSettings();

        syncBakedStateTag();

        updateWishlistUI();

        checkSharedProductUrlParam();

        initLiveInfoWidgets();

 

        // Fetch server-persisted store state (/api/store) with smart per-product image merging

        async function syncInitialStateFromServer() {

          try {

            const r = await fetch('/api/store?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' });

            if (r.ok) {

              const serverData = await r.json();

              if (serverData && (serverData.hasSavedState || serverData.imagesMap)) {

                if (serverData.storeSettings) {

                  storeSettings = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, serverData.storeSettings);

                }

                if (serverData.themeColor) {

                  activeThemeColor = serverData.themeColor;

                }

 

                let localHadMissingCustoms = false;

                const localBackup = loadLocalImagesBackupMap();

 

                if (Array.isArray(serverData.productsList) && serverData.productsList.length > 0) {

                  // Merge any local custom products or images into serverData.productsList

                  productsList.forEach((localProd) => {

                    const serverProd = serverData.productsList.find((sp) => sp.id === localProd.id);

                    if (serverProd && Array.isArray(localProd.images)) {

                      ensureFiveImagesArray(serverProd);

                      localProd.images.forEach((img, idx) => {

                        const cleanLocal = (img || '').trim() || ((localBackup[localProd.id] && localBackup[localProd.id][idx]) || '').trim();

                        if (cleanLocal && (!serverProd.images[idx] || !serverProd.images[idx].trim())) {

                          serverProd.images[idx] = cleanLocal;

                          localHadMissingCustoms = true;

                        }

                      });

                    } else if (!serverProd && localProd && localProd.id) {

                      serverData.productsList.push(localProd);

                      localHadMissingCustoms = true;

                    }

                  });

 

                  productsList = serverData.productsList;

                }

 

                productsList.forEach(ensureFiveImagesArray);

                mergeImagesMapIntoProductsList(productsList, serverData.imagesMap || null);

 

                // Check if local backup has any photos that serverData.imagesMap didn't have

                const srvMap = serverData.imagesMap || {};

                productsList.forEach((p) => {

                  const sSlots = Array.isArray(srvMap[p.id]) ? srvMap[p.id] : [];

                  p.images.forEach((img, idx) => {

                    if (img && img.trim() && (!sSlots[idx] || !String(sSlots[idx]).trim())) {

                      localHadMissingCustoms = true;

                    }

                  });

                });

 

                try {

                  localStorage.setItem('vv_store_products_v1', JSON.stringify(productsList));

                  localStorage.setItem('vv_store_settings_v1', JSON.stringify(storeSettings));

                  localStorage.setItem('vv_theme_color', activeThemeColor);

                } catch (e) {}

 

                isServerStateLoaded = true;

 

                if (localHadMissingCustoms) {

                  saveStateEverywhere();

                }

 

                applyStoreSettingsToDOM();

                applyLanguageToDOM();

                applyThemeColor(activeThemeColor, null, false);

                renderProducts();

                syncBakedStateTag();

                if (cpBackdrop && !cpBackdrop.classList.contains('hidden')) {

                  renderCpProductsList();

                }

                checkSharedProductUrlParam();

                return;

              }

            }

          } catch (err) {

            console.warn('Could not contact /api/store on boot:', err);

          }

          isServerStateLoaded = true;

          const localCustoms = productsList.reduce((sum, p) => sum + countCustomUploadedImages(p), 0);

          if (localCustoms > 0) {

            saveStateEverywhere();

          }

        }

 

        syncInitialStateFromServer();

      })();

    </script>

 

 

</body></html>
